name: Lapataganj
description:
Based in an imaginary small town called “Lapataganj” (means a lost place), the story is inspired from the writings of Sharad Joshi-who was an eminent Hindi satirist. His wide range of work has highlighted the bitter truth of our society with a satirical punch. These stories while making us laugh; also make us empathize with the situations we face in our daily lives.

“Lapataganj” is a town in some part of India which has been long forgotten by the system. The town struggles daily for basic facilities yet the people residing there are the happiest of the lot. The show captures the spirit of a common man to lead a happy life against all odds.

videos.title: Water Crisis
videos.overview: Mukundi and other villagers are tensed as there is again no water supply. The man who has come to see Sureeli for marriage, rejects her because she is dumb.

videos.title: Pappu Sneaks Into Sureeli's Room
videos.overview: Mukundi starts his day with a fight with Indumati which spoils his mood. Pappu sneaks into Sureeli's room and starts flirting with her.

videos.title: The Election Day
videos.overview: Everyone in Lapataganj is busy discussing the upcoming elections in the village. There arises a debate over whether or not the women in the village should cast a vote or not.

videos.title: Guddu to Write a Love Letter
videos.overview: Pappu tells Guddu that he is scared of expressing his love for Sureeli. He decides to pen down his feelings in a letter. He goes around the village asking for a pen and paper.

videos.title: Movie Buffs
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are extremely happy to see that there is a new movie to watch. Indu insists Mukundi takes her to watch the movie whereas Pappu tries his best to take Sureeli for the movie.

videos.title: The Theatre Shuts Down
videos.overview: The local theatre is overcrowded as everyone is too excited to watch the movie which is currently being shown. The theatre manager is devastated after the district collector gives an order to shut down the theatre permanently.

videos.title: Malan Devi's Surrender
videos.overview: There are announcements made in the village about Malan Devi surrendering herself near the lake. Indu shows a lot of interest in this and asks Mukundi hundreds of questions regarding the same.

videos.title: Indu's Wish to See a Dacoit
videos.overview: Most of the people in the village travel to watch Malan Devi's surrender. Indu wakes Mukundi up from his sleep, asking him to take her to watch the surrender. Mukundi ends up giving in when he learns that the entire village is going.

videos.title: Mukundi Becomes a Scape Goat
videos.overview: Seeing Indu trade chocolate to get her work done from their son, Mukundi opposes her act. Mukundi gets stuck between his two bosses as they mistreat him for disrespecting them.

videos.title: Neta Pandey's Dilemma
videos.overview: Neta Pandey is disturbed after seeing a letter missing from his name outside his house. He begins to look for the person who is responsible for meddling with his name.

videos.title: Santosh is In Town
videos.overview: Mishri and Kachua are excited to meet Mukundi's brother, Santosh. Mishri makes Sureeli get ready and takes her to meet Santosh with an objective to get them hitched.

videos.title: Santosh Flirts With Laali
videos.overview: Santosh tries to woo Laali but Mishri takes her to her house just in time. Indu is surprised to see Santosh suddenly showing interest in marriage. He tries impressing Laali all day.

videos.title: Finding a Colossus
videos.overview: Seeing problems increase at a high rate in Lapataganj, Baba says that only a colossus can save the village. All the villagers start looking for one for the upliftment of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Growing Adulteration
videos.overview: Indu yells at the milkman for giving her diluted milk and warns him one last time. Other people in the village notice adulteration in certain food items being sold in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Mukundi Protests Against Adulteration
videos.overview: Mukundi is forced to observe a fast to protest against growing adulteration in the village. The people in Lapataganj aim towards making the local minister take an action against the same.

videos.title: Mukundi to Take a Casual Leave
videos.overview: As Mukundi is lost in deep thoughts, people around him mistake him for having a toothache. Mukundi is in reality thinking whether he should take a casual leave from work or not.

videos.title: Mukundi Gets Threatened
videos.overview: Mukundi is kicked out of the ration shop when he asks for sugar. He is also threatened to not open his mouth, otherwise he will be beaten up.

videos.title: The Ashamed Minister
videos.overview: Everyone in Lapataganj wonders why the minister is ashamed. Indu insists Mukundi takes her to see the ashamed minister. Many people go to visit the minister to find out why he is ashamed.

videos.title: Destruction Due to Worms
videos.overview: Indu gives Mukundi a task to keep the wheat out for drying as it is attacked by worms. Mishri assigns Kachua a similar task as a few of their food items have caught fungus.

videos.title: Struggle to Pass Higher Secondary
videos.overview: Indu's uncle is in power and offers to help Chukundi. Pappu tries to impress Indu in order to get his passing certificate through her uncle's source.

videos.title: Mukundi Gets an Award
videos.overview: Mukundi's honesty gets the rightful reward and is interviewed by the media. Lapataganj is in a mood to celebrate when this news spreads like haywire.

videos.title: Miseries Of Marriage
videos.overview: Indu and Mukundi are on different note about wedding expenses. Everyone is set for Poonam's marriage when the groom's family starts demanding more dowry.

videos.title: Intellectuals Come to Rescue
videos.overview: Kachua takes the Politician's speech too seriously. By calling himself an intellectual, he sets out to solve various problems of the residents.

videos.title: Mystery Of The Neem Tree
videos.overview: A film crew comes across Lapataganj for shooting and finds it ideal. The residents get busy to fill up the dried up lake but the heroine's whims and fancies are elsewhere.

videos.title: The Heroine's Demand
videos.overview: A film crew comes across Lapataganj for shooting and finds it ideal. The residents get busy to fill up the dried up lake but the heroine's whims and fancies are elsewhere.

videos.title: Chaubey From Lena Bank
videos.overview: A loan agent arrives at Lapataganj and targets Pappu. Pappu feels Mukundi is the perfect person for Chaubey to pursue and explains about the loan to the residents.

videos.title: Every Husband's Problem
videos.overview: Mukundi is irritated with Indu's questioning and decides to go to Asansol. The disagreement accelerates when the different residents give their opinions in this regard.

videos.title: Hanumanji's Arrival
videos.overview: The villagers have their own unique way of worshipping. Pappu and Indu fight over a newspaper that encloses a vacancy for the priest.

videos.title: Interview For Priest's Role
videos.overview: Pappu is depressed about his voice but with Hanuman's blessing, he recovers. Mukundi suggests to him how to apply for the role of the priest.

videos.title: Pappu's Transformation
videos.overview: The villagers are shocked to see Pappu's change and dedication towards his profession. Sureeli is heartbroken to know Pappu's decision but still pursues him.

videos.title: Vasanti Visits
videos.overview: Indu's sister, Vasanti, comes to Lapataganj to visit her. Mishri has lost her goat and files a report. Vasanti and Mukundi team up to preach the villagers about poetry.

videos.title: Kachua's Laziness
videos.overview: Kachua oversleeps amidst the rush in the morning, so Pappu pulls a prank on him. Mukundi reminds Kachua of all the things he has lost due to his laziness.

videos.title: Playboy Pappu
videos.overview: Mishri and Kachua go to the river to get water and Pappu uses this opportunity to spend time with Sureeli. Later on, Pappu gets lost in his thoughts of his previous lover.

videos.title: Sukumari is In Crisis
videos.overview: Pappu is collecting the donation from the villagers when he catches a glimpse of Sukumari. Sureeli starts doubting Pappu but he still sorts out Sukumari's problem.

videos.title: Combating Robbery
videos.overview: Kachua, Pappu, and Guddu stay at Mishri's place to catch the thieves. Once they catch the thieves, a much bigger problem arises at the police station.

videos.title: Mango Desire
videos.overview: At times, even the common man wishes to feel special. With a lot of hardship, Lapataganj indulges in cherishing the off-seasonal mango.

videos.title: The All Knowing Stranger
videos.overview: A stranger arrives at Lapataganj who recognises each and every member of the village. Was he previously a resident too?

videos.title: New Age Teacher
videos.overview: The old-school preaching needs dusting now, so Mukundi puts his effort to impart his son with few ethics. Mukundi stands against the wrong procedure used by the teachers of today and tries to bridge the gap.

videos.title: The Lost Party
videos.overview: Pappu is upset as his party has lost the elections. The villagers start debating over the pros and cons of the parties have and how could one win over another.

videos.title: New Year
videos.overview: In Lapataganj, the new year brings new hopes with water. Mishri's husband decides to return on this occasion and the villagers celebrate their new emerging sun.

videos.title: Lapataganj In Competition
videos.overview: Mukundi's poetic uncle arrives at Lapataganj and Chukundi is excited to receive gifts. Pappu along with the villagers bet over a kite flying competition.

videos.title: Advent Of Mama Ji
videos.overview: Ghasita Mamaji's mannerisms are quite unique. The villagers mistakenly perceive him as a stranger trying to steal or spoil their village culture which leads to an attack on him.

videos.title: American Guest
videos.overview: Indian culture works as an attraction for many tourists from across the world. A tourist from New York, Anuradha visits Lapataganj and the villagers are insane to meet her and know about America.

videos.title: Seeing Off The Guest
videos.overview: The villagers perform for Anuradha and Indu dresses her up as an Indian woman. Anuradha falls in love with the unity and close bond of Lapataganj. Anuradha and the villagers get upset on parting.

videos.title: Gandhijis Glasses
videos.overview: A controversy on Gandhiji's glasses getting stolen from the museum. Kachua gets suspected as his glasses have a similar circular frame.

videos.title: Coincidence or Politics
videos.overview: The residents of Lapataganj are infuriated about an outsider being their leader which leads to a fight. The villagers stand together against the false-telling politicians trying to influence them for mere votes.

videos.title: Sugandhilals Umbrella
videos.overview: Mukundi's father keeps his umbrella close to his heart. Suddenly, his umbrella gets misplaced. How will Sugandhi find his special umbrella?

videos.title: Victims Of Corruption
videos.overview: Sugandhi wants to build a school in his village premise and has to visit the government office for permission. Each time Mukundi visits, he has to suffer. Finally, the father-son realise that nothing runs without corruption.

videos.title: Shakkarkandi Against Corruption
videos.overview: Sugandhi shuts himself till his father is brought to Lapataganj. Pappu and Guddu bring Shakkarkandilal, Mukundi's grandfather. Mukundi with the help of the villagers takes revenge from Dubey.

videos.title: How to Pass The Time?
videos.overview: Kachua spends his time by small talking to different residents of Lapataganj. Pappu spends time by flirting with Sureeli and pulling pranks. A stranger fools the villagers to start digging their ground to find his ancestral treasure.

videos.title: Sugandhi Befriends a Crow
videos.overview: Sugandhi sings, feeds and talks to a crow in order to spend his free time. Kachua and Pappu pranks on him to have some fun. Sugandhi feels that his old acquaintance is now a crow.

videos.title: Sureeli's Seeker
videos.overview: Pappu's nightmare comes true as he sees an intruder, Chimpu with Sureeli. Chimpu organises a dance competition and asks Sureeli to participate, but the whole Lapataganj performs in the competition.

videos.title: Pappu Feels Repulsed
videos.overview: The competition gets even better when the villagers are engaged in street practice. Pappu removes the tyres of Chimpu's bike due to his insecurity. Sambha tries to hit on Pappu but he refrains.

videos.title: Dance Competition At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chimpu attempts to impress Mishri and Sureeli which Pappu revolts against. The villagers compete with one another to come to a conclusion.

videos.title: Lapataganj On Republic Day
videos.overview: Mukundi explains the meaning of constitution to Indu. The villagers perform on the theme of Republic Day and Sureeli emerges as the winner.

videos.title: The Smile Week
videos.overview: Mukundi's boss announces that they will be celebrating smile day in the upcoming week, where they have to talk to every client with a smile. Mukundi starts practicing for this right away.

videos.title: The Wishlist
videos.overview: Indu hands over Mukundi a long list of items she needs. When he tries to turn her wish down, she tells him that he never fulfills any of her wishes.

videos.title: The Crisis
videos.overview: Mishri chucks Pappu out of her house seeing him brush his teeth with Sureeli. Mishri and Indu discuss how there are various things in the village but are actually of no use.

videos.title: Winter Takes a Toll On Lapataganj
videos.overview: It is a relatively colder day in Lapataganj and everyone is shivering even after covered in layers. Chotu mama freezes after taking a shower from ice cold water.

videos.title: Pappu Hates Seeing Sureeli Work
videos.overview: Pappu feels bad for Sureeli seeing her sweep the floor and asks her to stop. Mishri assigns him the task of sweeping when she sees this. Pappu passes over the task to Guddu to avoid working.

videos.title: A Match Of Kabaddi
videos.overview: The men in Lapataganj play a match of Kabaddi against the men of Gumshudaganj, a neighbouring village. After a lot of running and injuries, watch which team wins the match.

videos.title: Pappu Gets Injured
videos.overview: The game of Kabaddi leaves Pappu seriously injured, leaving Sureeli extremely worried. Right when Sureeli is about to give Pappu a massage, Chotu mama stops her and starts massaging Pappu himself.

videos.title: Kabaddi Training
videos.overview: Pappu starts selecting eligible people to raise a Kabaddi team in Lapataganj which can compete against other strong teams. All the team members start training for Kabaddi.

videos.title: A Tough Game
videos.overview: As the Lapataganj team begins to play with their opposition which is the national team, their supporters begin to lose hope seeing them play. They try making a comeback but Guddu gets seriously injured.

videos.title: Being a Greater Person
videos.overview: The Lapataganj team loses the game on purpose as they did not want to defeat the national team as that would be a loss for them. The national kabaddi team asks people to support all sports along with cricket.

videos.title: Indu has a Crush
videos.overview: Indu cannot keep calm as her favorite actor, Ramesh Kumar's movie is being shown at the theatre. Mukundi is surprised seeing Indu go gaga over Ramesh Kumar as she sticks his posters in the house.

videos.title: Tips For Begging
videos.overview: A man asks people in Lapataganj to help him with some money as his wallet has been robbed. They give him tips to beg for money so that he can buy a ticket to his destination.

videos.title: Mukundi Sacred Of Going Bald
videos.overview: Mukundi gets worried when a few bald men from the village tell him that even he is getting bald. Mukundi sees a dream where he has lost all his hair and Indu is leaving him forever.

videos.title: Mukundi Gets a Golden Opportunity
videos.overview: Mukundi tells his friends that he has been chosen to deliver a speech on Gandhiji in Gujarat by the postal department. Even though Indu does not insist on taking her along, he wishes to take his family along with him.

videos.title: Growing Obsession For Movie
videos.overview: Pappu imagines himself nothing less than a hero. Mishri tells Indu that she is going for an English movie so Indu starts demanding Mukundi. Later on, the whole Lapataganj gets inside the movie hall.

videos.title: Lapataganj Day
videos.overview: On the occasion of Lapataganj Day, the residents perform to celebrate. The politicians argue on land reform policy and plan to extort the residents of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Silence is a Virtue
videos.overview: Pappu tries to influence Mukundi and Kachua but they, in turn, preach him about silence. Mishri fixed Sureeli's marriage to an influential person from a different village and Pappu goes silent.

videos.title: Holika At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu is against the kids playing with colours and Mukundi argues with Indu on the expenditure of Holi. The women prepare sweets and the village unites to burn the Holika.

videos.title: Celebrating Holi
videos.overview: Mukundi is fooled by Indu into playing Holi and Chotu still complains about Chukundi hitting him with balloons. Pappu rushes to put colour on Sureeli when everyone else is inclined to celebrating.

videos.title: Controversary On Strike
videos.overview: Mukundi influences everyone to work more on the strike day. Everyone doubles up their prices for the sake of loss. Chukundi meets with an accident but there is no doctor to be found.

videos.title: The Quest For Well
videos.overview: The residents wait eternally in front of their village tap. The collector asks them to search for the well in their village. Police start investigating about the lost well.

videos.title: Budget Of The Year
videos.overview: The villagers worship the Finance Minister for a good budget outcome. Mukundi does a lot of shopping before the budget is released. When the politicians are plotting to increase the budget, the villagers try to keep their savings up.

videos.title: Buntys Friendship
videos.overview: Pappu's birthday is in a week and his friend from Delhi arrives at Lapataganj. Bunty tries to distance Pappu from his neighbours and also attempts to change his birthday plan. Will Pappu withstand this?

videos.title: Lapataganj Under Trial
videos.overview: Mukundi and Kachua discuss India's pending development. Pappu catches a man stalking Sureeli and gives it right to him. The politician's maid revolts as she wants to join the party.

videos.title: Consistency Of Drought
videos.overview: Lapataganj is a drought prone area and the villagers want Mukundi to make the government aware of it. Indu and Mukundi have visitors from a flood prone area. Together, the villagers plot a drama to bring awareness.

videos.title: Politicians Amusement
videos.overview: Mukundi's letter was rejected so the politician is invited to Lapataganj. The villagers put across their issues to him but still, nothing is resolved.

videos.title: Dignified Chotu
videos.overview: Chotu finds a bag full of money but has to give it back to Police. Chotu is dignified by the politician for his deed. Pappu decides he also wants to feel respected and takes help from Bajrangbali.

videos.title: Media In Lapataganj
videos.overview: The journalist enquires about the lost idol case. Police refuse to search the idol anymore. The villagers get busy to find the idol all over the area but Chotu takes away the credit.

videos.title: Counting The Stars
videos.overview: Pappu makes notes for Sureeli to help her pass the exam. Mukundi borrows a phone to have a word with Indu. Pappu imagines him and Sureeli as Mukundi and Indu.

videos.title: A Dog's Day
videos.overview: Chotu strikes at a dog mistakenly and injures it. Police arrest him for committing the crime and the Dog Minister takes over the case.

videos.title: The Suspicious Sneeze
videos.overview: The villagers misjudge Chotu's sneeze as something dangerous to their health. What is the reason behind Chotu's sneeze? Is it a box full of spices or a life-threatening disease?

videos.title: The Art Of Bribery
videos.overview: Mukundi complaints about a politician trying to bribe him. Once the media covers the incident, the party members decide to take a firm step ahead.

videos.title: Elizabeth's New Avatar
videos.overview: Lapataganj's residents complain about their still old fashioned ways. Elizabeth's evolution makes them amazingly shocked right at his entry.

videos.title: Friends Turned Into Enemies
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu are in bad terms and fight it out. Lapataganj gets divided into two due to their differences. Mukundi is stuck in between them.

videos.title: Memories Of Indu
videos.overview: The villagers are ecstatic to see Indu back in Lapataganj. Mukundi is lost in Indu's thoughts, so the villagers plan to dress up Guddu like her.

videos.title: Moneyplant and Cactus
videos.overview: The village kids are playing in the ground and Mamaji gets hit on his head. Pappu and his friends start making fun of him. He also tells that he would have been very happy if Mamaji got injured badly and would celebrate by distributing sweets all over Lapataganj.

videos.title: Gods Miracle
videos.overview: Chotu makes his bed and is ready to sleep. Mishri gets him milk, but then two orphaned kids come and ask for food. When Chotu does not give them his milk, they curse him. Later in the night, someone calls Mishri and she is shocked to witness it.

videos.title: Reporters In Hanumanganj
videos.overview: People go crazy as they witness Hanuman Ji drinking milk. Everybody comes in Hanumanganj and start worshipping him. Reporters come as they want to cover this astonishing story.

videos.title: Amitabh In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Amitabh enters Lapatanganj and all the villagers go crazy. Everyone gathers around him and holds him tightly so that he is unable to leave. Sureeli is a big fan and tries to shower her love for him.

videos.title: Mastaana Band In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mastana Band artists are in Lapataganj in hope that they will get some customers. They play and entertain Pappu who keeps on telling them how bad they are as musicians. Later, they go on a hunt to find customers who want to get married.

videos.title: Pappu's Dream
videos.overview: Pappu and Gattu are coming back riding on the bicycle. But Pappu has a dream of owning a motorcycle and how he would impress everyone in Lapataganj. He starts dreaming of how famous he will be if he gets a motorcycle.

videos.title: Trouble On Everyone
videos.overview: Pappu and Gattu find a visitor who falls on the ground suddenly. They tell everyone about this and everyone gets scared how to hide this body. Mukundi gets scared when he sees his father coming back.

videos.title: Police Interrupts The Plan
videos.overview: Everyone in Lapataganj makes a plan to remove the body from their area. So they take him out of Lapataganj in a procession. But then suddenly, police enters Lapataganj. Will the police find out the truth?

videos.title: Kachua is Back
videos.overview: Kachus is back in Lapataganj from his trip. Everyone in the area gets excited and gather around him. Mukundi asks Kachua about his journey and gets to know that Kachua had been to jail as well.

videos.title: Kachuas Truth
videos.overview: Kachua gets beaten by the opposition party. Mishri and Elija put ointment and asks Kachua to take rest. Mishri asks him what did he say such things that he got beaten so badly.

videos.title: Vimla's Ghost
videos.overview: Mishri comes to a peepal tree to offer sweets to Vimla on her death anniversary. As soon as Mishri leaves, the sweets disappear. A few people in the neighborhood feel the presence of a ghost around them.

videos.title: Exorcism Of Chotu Mama
videos.overview: Vimla's ghost continues to haunt the entire village. Everyone is scared of Chotu mama as he starts speaking and acting like late Vimla. Chotu is made to sit through an exorcism by an exorcist.

videos.title: Disturbed Chotu
videos.overview: Mishri and other villagers are worried seeing Chotu collapsed in the middle of the road. The entire day he acts really strange after seeing Vimla with a lantern in her hand, the previous day.

videos.title: Kachua Feels Lonely
videos.overview: After getting ready in the morning, Kachua leaves for a walk in the village but feels ignored by the people. Due to loneliness, Kachua decides to get married leaving the villagers surprised.

videos.title: Mukundi's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Indu starts crying when Mukundi says no to her plea for taking her for a vacation. Mukundi tries to show Indu that he would be in debt if he takes her out, but his plan backfires on him.

videos.title: Unwanted Guests
videos.overview: Indu cannot keep calm seeing her mother, sister, and brother-in-law, who have come to pay her a surprise visit. Mukundi does not seem pleased seeing guests arrive in his house without any prior notice.

videos.title: Mukundi Loses His Calm
videos.overview: Mukundi is already sick of the guests, as they are causing him trouble every minute of the day. He later loses his calm when he finds out that his brother-in-law has been taking debt in his name.

videos.title: Mukundi Disguises As His Father
videos.overview: Mukundi looks for ideas to kick the guests out of his house as they won't leave. Mukundi disguises himself as his father because Indu's mother hates him. He is shocked to see his father in front of him when he is dressed up as him.

videos.title: Chukundi Goes Missing
videos.overview: While leaving for work, Mukundi falls into a manhole and hurts himself. He fights with the contractor for digging a manhole which might be dangerous for pedestrians. In the evening, Mukundi and Indu are extremely worried as Chukundi goes missing.

videos.title: Chukundi Falls Into a Manhole
videos.overview: Mukundi goes crazy after hearing Chukundi talk from inside a big manhole. This becomes a matter of concern and as the media comes to cover the incident. After a lot of chaos, Chukundi is taken out of the manhole.

videos.title: Fake Currency
videos.overview: A fake note owned by Mukundi is circulated around the village before it reaches a policeman. Mukundi gets caught for producing fake currency but the real culprit is somebody else.

videos.title: Mukundi to Get Fired
videos.overview: Mukundi and Indu get into an argument over who does more work throughout the day. After talking to his boss, Mukundi predicts that he is going to be fired soon. He decides to hide this news from his wife.

videos.title: A Surprise For Mukundi
videos.overview: Mukundi is frightened after hearing people's stories after they have got fired from their jobs. He is relieved to find out that they have received a new consignment.

videos.title: The Pickle Story
videos.overview: Mukundi craves for some pickle but is upset to find out that all the pickle in his house is over. Indu, with the help of Mishri, begins to prepare pickle and decides to surprise Mukundi.

videos.title: Blood Donation
videos.overview: A blood donation camp is set in Lapataganj which excites all the villagers. Indu is adamant about donating blood even though Mukundi is against it.

videos.title: Sureeli to Marry a Dog
videos.overview: Mishri gets convinced to get Sureeli married to a dog, which according to the priest will clear the fault in her stars. Sureeli cries her eyes out when she finds out that she is going to get married to a dog.

videos.title: Pappu Accepts a Challenge
videos.overview: Pappu picks up the dog Sureeli is getting married to, and once again asks Mishri if he can marry Sureeli. Pappu accepts the challenge of earning five thousand rupees in a week to get married to Sureeli.

videos.title: Pappu Goes to Extremes
videos.overview: A reward of five thousand rupees is announced to whoever rides a bicycle for five days straight. Pappu takes up the challenge to fulfill Mishri's condition for getting Sureeli married to Pappu.

videos.title: Pappu Refuses to Give Up
videos.overview: Pappu is shocked to know that his drink was spiked by Chotu mama so that he fails to finish the challenge. Even after facing extreme troubles, Pappu does not give up.

videos.title: Humanity First
videos.overview: While everyone falls asleep, Guddu runs behind Pappu providing him moral support. He finally finishes the challenge and wins the prize money. Mishri refuses to stand by her words after learning that Pappu spent the money on someone in need.

videos.title: The Box Of Mangoes
videos.overview: Mukundi's boss hands him over a box for delivery which he hides and keeps in his house. Indu gets her hands on the box and mistakes it for her birthday gift. Indu gets excited and distributes all the mangoes to the people in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Mukundi Stuck In The Police Station
videos.overview: Mukundi is taken to the police station as he is the only witness to the cobbler and barber's fight. Pappu tries his best to see Sureeli but Mishri and Chotu always come in his way.

videos.title: Cops Look For Pappu
videos.overview: Guddu is put behind the bars when a policeman finds him wearing a fake uniform. When Guddu reveals that he was playing a cop to help Pappu, the policemen start looking for him.

videos.title: Indu Buys a Television Set
videos.overview: Mukundi is rewarded with ten thousand rupees for being the most hardworking employee. Indu claims her right on the money and announces that she is going to buy a television set.

videos.title: The Craze For Tv
videos.overview: When Mukundi asks the villagers to pay for getting the TV repaired, all of them back off. Once the TV is repaired, he makes sure nobody gets to watch TV in his house and kicks everyone out.

videos.title: Pappu Gets Beaten Up By Mishri
videos.overview: Indu convinces Mishri to accompany her to watch a film. Even though Sureeli has exams the next day, Pappu takes her to the theatre with him. When Mishri sees Sureeli with Pappu, she beats him up.

videos.title: Sureeli Passes Her Exam
videos.overview: While Sureeli writes her exam, Pappu and Guddu disguise as women and throw chits at her, so that she passes her exam. Sureeli clears her exam with distinction even though she refuses to cheat.

videos.title: The Fancy Fair
videos.overview: When Indu asks Mukundi to take her to the fair, he refuses. Pappu takes Sureeli to the fair so that they can enjoy together. Indu takes Chukundi to the fair with her and they have fun.

videos.title: Indu Wins an Elephant
videos.overview: Indu is enthusiastic to get the elephant home, which she has won as a price at the fair. Mukundi is petrified thinking about how he would take care of the elephant.

videos.title: Indu Throws a Feast
videos.overview: A minister reaches Mukundi's house with cops to complain against the elephant. Sureeli is on cloud nine after Pappu surprises her with a new cellphone. Indu decides to plan a feast for all her fellow villagers.

videos.title: Lapataganj Bids Farewell to The Elephant
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are worried seeing the elephant lie motionless on the ground. They revive with joy when it wakes up in the morning. Indu cries her eyes out when the elephant is taken to the jungle in order to provide it with a safer life.

videos.title: The Talking Tree
videos.overview: A drunk man from Lapataganj experiences a tree talking to him but nobody believes him. The man takes Pappu to the talking tree and even he is bewildered to see the tree talk.

videos.title: The Truth Behind Gyandev
videos.overview: Pappu takes Sureeli to the talking tree and it seems to understand everything Sureeli intends to say. Mukundi tells Pappu that the tree knows the questions to all the answers, as it was built where either a school or library used to be.

videos.title: Inflation
videos.overview: Even after waiting in the long queue, Mukundi and other fellow villagers fail to get groceries. Seeing inflation, Mukundi is anxious. With inflation, every other commodity's rates increase leaving the people of Lapataganj worried.

videos.title: Concerns Of The Lapataganj Residents
videos.overview: While Tamatarilal and Shakkarchand visit Netaji, the people of the Lapataganj also go to Netaji to get an answer from him. They ask him for his help as the grocery prices are going high.

videos.title: Self-grown Vegetables In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi tries to recite Hanuman chaalisa in the morning while his wife, Indumati offers him breakfast. The residents of Lapataganj start to grow vegetables on their own.

videos.title: Pappu Visits Sureeli
videos.overview: Mishri is left baffled when she find Charusiya staring at the sky. Mukundi prepares for the upcoming rains. Guttu takes Pappu for a ride in his bicycle to see Sureeli.

videos.title: Indumati Waits For Mukundi's Return
videos.overview: Kacchua Chacha finds Indumati waiting for Mukundi's return outside her house. While Pappu and Guttu go in search of Mukundi, Pappu dreams of dancing in the rain with Sureeli.

videos.title: Villagers to Handover Their Land
videos.overview: An announcement is made in the village that the Minister is going to address everyone's concerns regarding water. The villagers decide to hand over their land to the government.

videos.title: Mishri's Bicycle Ride
videos.overview: Jal Jal Prathap Sinha, the minister pretends not to recognize Mukundi. Mishri takes a ride, while Pappu dresses up as an Arab in the village. Indumati has prepared tea for Mukundi prior to him asking.

videos.title: A Bomb Handed Over to Chotu
videos.overview: Mukundi and Elija find it difficult to carry a huge box outside the house. While Pappu tells Mukundi that he has to get tablets for his dad when asked for help, on his return he still finds him hanging around.

videos.title: Surili to Say The Three Words
videos.overview: Residents of Lapataganj learn about the bomb in the market. Mukundi and Elija go to the police to inform them about the bomb. Mishri locks up Sureeli when she goes to confess her love to Pappu.

videos.title: Is Surili Getting Married?
videos.overview: Mukundi leaves home for a few days on work. While Pappu goes to visit Sureeli, he learns that a boy's family is coming to see Sureeli. Pappu is upset and says if she can't be his, she can't be anyone else's.

videos.title: A Drama to Save Surili
videos.overview: Kachua Chacha wakes up in a cart and narrates an incident to Guddu. When the boy's family comes, Elija and the others mislead them to Indumati's house who pretends to be a crazy Sureeli.

videos.title: Pappu Goes Shopping
videos.overview: Mishri and Indumati buy bangles from the seller. Chotu notices Kacchua Chacha making pots. Chotu brings some jalebis for Sureeli. Pappu shops for Sureeli, Indumati and Mishri.

videos.title: The Art Of Sculpting Life
videos.overview: Pappu breaks a pot that Mishri Mausi is carrying using a catapult. He buys samosas for Sureeli and goes to meet her. Chotu visits the doctor to get his mouth checked after having hot samosas.

videos.title: Mukundi and Indumati's Love Story
videos.overview: Pappu gets on top of the house where Sureeli lives and sings a song for her. While Mishri spots him, he manages to escape. Mukundi narrates how he fell in love with Indumati.

videos.title: Mukundi and Indumati's Love Story
videos.overview: Mukundi continues to narrate his love story. He tells them the hurdles that he had to overcome. Pappu buys some roses for Sureeli and sings for her. Mishri brings Police to take Pappu away.

videos.title: Indumati and Mukundi Share a Moment
videos.overview: Mukundi tells Pappu how he had to win a battle with the kabbadi men. One time he had to dress up in a burkha to watch Indumati sing and how he used to follow her places.

videos.title: Biji Pandey L.l.b
videos.overview: Indumati prays for Biji Pandey and makes laddoos for him so that he learns a lesson and studies well. Biji presents his L.L.B marksheet, after which his and Sureeli's wedding preparation begins.

videos.title: Fraud Brings Equality
videos.overview: Indu is upset that she is leaving Mukundi alone and Mishri assures to take care of him. A fortune-teller attempts to create illusion of a better tomorrow, in minds of the villagers.

videos.title: Benefits Of Flood
videos.overview: Mukundi gets a duty to host a politician from a nearby district. The shrewd politician thereafter projects his unethical mannerisms.

videos.title: Baba's Curse
videos.overview: A God-mans entry in Lapataganj gets Mukundi suspicious and he speaks up against it. The Baba in return, holds Mukundi responsible for the upcoming holocaust.

videos.title: Life is Uncertain
videos.overview: Mukundi explains to everyone that life is short and unpredictable which leaves an impact on their minds. Mishra wants Sureeli to get married to Pappu and Indu's father arrives at Lapataganj.

videos.title: Mukundi's First Flight
videos.overview: Mukundi gets an offer to fly to Mumbai and whole Lapataganj starts prepping for his departure. Indu demands to go along and Pappu gifts him an outfit.

videos.title: Mukundi In Trouble
videos.overview: The villagers are enthralled for Mukundi's flight and awaits his return. When Mukundi returns, everyone is intrigued to know his experience.

videos.title: Pappu's Planning
videos.overview: Pappu decides to start up a business and Mukundi feels he is up to some new prank. Suddenly customers are interested in Suttilal's shop.

videos.title: Edification In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Pappu calls the politician for sanctioning his business plans. The villagers start with their complaints regarding the issues they have to face due to sheer negligence.

videos.title: Complicated Relationships
videos.overview: Indu demands Mukundi to take her out on a trip, so Mishri tells her an incident from her own life. A movie creates ripples among the villagers about the relationship of husband and wife.

videos.title: Indu Becomes More Religious
videos.overview: Mukundi is shocked to find Indu's interest in religious methods. Mishri, Chotu, and Elija start doubting about Mukundi's intention.

videos.title: Pure Love
videos.overview: Mukundi's father throws Mukundi out when he hears that Mukundi was with another woman. Mukundi takes Pappu's advice in approaching Indu.

videos.title: Mukundi's Promotion
videos.overview: On the occasion of Mukundi's promotion, Lapatganj prepares to celebrate together and Mishri cooks and worships for him. Pappu gifts a scooter to Mukundi but there is more to it.

videos.title: Mukundi Got a Transfer
videos.overview: Indu cries about Mukundi's transfer from Lapataganj.  The whole village gradually decides to move out one by one after hearing the news.

videos.title: N.r.i. In Lapataganj
videos.overview: A laundryman from America visits his village, Lapataganj. Pappu is impressed by the man's get-up and way of life and wishes the same for himself in the future.

videos.title: Chunmun Chaubey's Reality
videos.overview: Guddu motivates Pappu more towards his aim. Kachua slaps Pappu and explains him about his misdeeds. Police arrive in search of Chunmun Chaubey.

videos.title: Pyjama Mystery
videos.overview: Chotu keeps bragging about his father always, so Mishri shows their father's pyjama to him. Chotu gives the pyjama to Elija to adjust it according to his size and there starts the drama.

videos.title: The Saree Fight
videos.overview: Kachua gifts Indu and Mishri two sarees, but both choose the same one. Mishri gets the saree but Indu starts competing on every note with her.

videos.title: The Art Competition
videos.overview: As Kachua is painting a few pots, there is an announcement for an art competition with a reward of one lakh for the winner. The villagers force Kachua to take part in the competition.

videos.title: Pappu Learns His Lesson
videos.overview: To teach Pappu a lesson, Kachua, and other villagers act as Britishers and turn Lapataganj into a colony. Pappu realizes what sacrifices the freedom fighters would have made and apologizes to everyone in the village.

videos.title: The Five Questions
videos.overview: Mukundi suggests his fellow villagers that this time, they should choose their leader by asking them a few questions. They surround a contesting man and ask him five questions.

videos.title: Mukundi Down With a Fever
videos.overview: When Mishri goes to wake Mukundi up with a cup of tea, he tells her that he is not feeling too well. Chotu mama calls a doctor who tells that Mukundi is down with a fever.

videos.title: The Wedding Invitation
videos.overview: Mukundi is worried after he receives an invitation for Indu's sister's wedding. He wonders how he can eliminate the extra expenditure for the upcoming wedding.

videos.title: A Shocking News For Pappu
videos.overview: Everyone is excited for the upcoming festival of Rakshabandhan. Sureeli overhears Chotu mama talk about Sureeli tying a rakhi on Pappu's wrist.

videos.title: The Festival Of Rakshabandhan
videos.overview: To keep Sureeli from tying a rakhi on his wrist, Pappu lands Chotu in a fight with Mishri. Later, he takes up the responsibility to resolve their fight, so that they spend a memorable Rakshabandhan together.

videos.title: The Unknown Letter
videos.overview: Mukundi receives a letter from an unknown sender which says that they would be coming soon to collect their money. After he reads out the letter in front of all the villagers, they start wondering who is the sender and who is it addressed to.

videos.title: Pappu Blames Chotu Mama
videos.overview: Pappu guesses that the letter was addressed to Chotu mama concerning Sureeli's marriage. He blames mama for trying to get Sureeli married to a man who has been already married twice.

videos.title: Preparations For Janmashtami
videos.overview: Indu is upset as she will not have Chukundi to dress up as Lord Krishna on the occasion of Janmashtami. Mukundi cheers her up and the entire village starts prepping for the festival.

videos.title: Independence Day
videos.overview: Lapataganj seems different on Independence Day as they get water supply. The villagers with a patriotic mind, celebrate independence, followed by various events.

videos.title: Lord Krishna Blesses Lapataganj
videos.overview: As the villagers devote themselves to praying to Lord Krishna, they are extremely happy when it starts pouring. Chotu mama experiences intuitions of his own death.

videos.title: Sureeli's Competition
videos.overview: Sureeli's classmates keep bullying her speech impairment. The bicycle competition is announced in Lapataganj and Sureeli starts preparing for it.

videos.title: Sureeli Gets Injured
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu arrange a bicycle for Sureeli but Chotu takes the credit. The villagers get busy in training Sureeli to ride a bicycle.

videos.title: The Slow Bicycle Race
videos.overview: Sureeli keeps up her training, even with her injury. The slow bicycle race commences but Sureeli's bicycle chain drops in between.

videos.title: Ill-fated Sureeli
videos.overview: Sureeli gets another chance and will represent her college in the race. Another contestant kicks Sureeli down from her bicycle while the competition is going on.

videos.title: Emerging Winner
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu motivate and Sureeli completes the race. Mukundi brings back Pappu's cycle and finally Mishri thanks Pappu for getting her daughter the cycle. Pappu insults Mukundi for using an old bicycle.

videos.title: Scooter-attachment
videos.overview: Mishri consoles Indu, who is upset about Mukundi buying a scooter. Mukundi and Indu go out for a ride but suddenly the scooter stops working.

videos.title: Mukundi's Extravagancy
videos.overview: Mukundi is over-attached to his scooter which infuriates Indu. The villagers give their own opinion and dismantle Mukundi's scooter as it's not working.

videos.title: Mishris Dying Hopes
videos.overview: Mishri eagerly waits for her husband to return from Mumbai. Kachua is in trauma to hear about Putani's return to Lapataganj. Chotu reveals a news, and everyone is shocked.

videos.title: Lapataganjs New Amusement
videos.overview: Mishri faints on her husband arrival at Lapataganj. Putani's accent astonishes the villagers and they keep on muttering the same way. Putani raises a wave of mixed emotions in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Putani Got Fired
videos.overview: Kachua is upset as Putani is going to stay for sometime now. Mishri pursues Putani for fixing Sureeli's marriage. Sureeli reads Putani's retrenchment letter.

videos.title: Ganesh Chaturthi
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are devoted to praying to Lord Ganesha on Ganesh Chaturthi. Later, they discuss what they would ask for as a wish from Lord Ganesh.

videos.title: Ukundi In a Rush
videos.overview: Mukundi leaves home in a hurry as an officer is coming to his workplace for an evaluation. Chotu mama plays a prank on Pappu as he believes mama when he says that Sureeli is alone at home.

videos.title: Appu Misses Sureeli
videos.overview: Pappu is upset that Sureeli has left the town without informing him and misses her all day. Mukundi is scared to tell Indu to change the menu for dinner as he has already handed her over a list of items to be made in advance.

videos.title: Suttilal Receives a Legal Notice
videos.overview: Suttilal receives a legal notice after he gives Pappu sweets full of ants. He blames Chotu mama for his situation as mama had asked him to do so.

videos.title: Elija's Brother In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Elija is on cloud nine as his brother comes to pay him a visit in Lapataganj. He decides to take his brother to see all his friends in the village.

videos.title: Elija Ki Kasam
videos.overview: Mukundilal struggles to get his wife's clothes stitched, as Elija the Tailor refuses to work because all he wants to do is relax, eat, and get fat.

videos.title: The Cleanest House
videos.overview: Mishri starts cleaning her house well in advance, so that her house appears to be the tidiest one in Lapataganj. Indu claims to have the most organized house and gets into a fight with Mishri.

videos.title: Indu vs Mishri
videos.overview: To prove Mishri wrong, Indu makes Mukundi immaculate their house with her. Mukundi is upset as he has been missing work from the past two days.

videos.title: Chotu Mama Hunts For Work
videos.overview: Chotu mama gets excited after Mishri asks him to get married. She asks him to find a job before getting married. He starts looking for work around Lapataganj.

videos.title: Chotus Lottery Controversy
videos.overview: Lapataganj is stormed by Chotu's lottery ticket but the problem is he has misplaced it. United by sharing the profit, the villagers get busy searching Chotu's pyjama which has the ticket.

videos.title: Solving The Problem
videos.overview: Sureeli is back to Lapataganj, Pappu is exhilarated to see her. Meanwhile, Mishri and Chotu plan to get Sureeli married off. Indu is annoyed with Mukundi as he keeps her waiting. Chotu gets fooled by the duo while patroling Sureeli.

videos.title: Prospective Groom
videos.overview: Sureeli tries to convince Mishri about Pappu's positive aspects. Mukundi advises his colleague on marital life. Mishri breaks down as she can't find Chotu.

videos.title: Eloping Plan
videos.overview: Pappu plans to elope with Sureeli and asks money from Guddu. Later on, Pappu and Guddu try to influence Indu against Mishri.

videos.title: Preparations For Ramleela
videos.overview: A mysterious bow is found in Lapataganj and everyone tries to guess its origin. The politician takes donation from the villagers for Ramleela. Villagers start planning the characters they are going to play and get too involved in it.

videos.title: Celebrating Ramleela
videos.overview: Amidst the ongoing celebration, Lapataganj is in a jovial mood. When the play is about to commence, and villagers start demanding the presence of Ram's character, Mukundi goes missing.

videos.title: Broken Bow
videos.overview: Villagers donate money for witnessing the bow breaking incident. Chotu tells it was his deed so he deserves all the money. After a lot of altercation, the Ramayan performance starts.

videos.title: Will The Celebration Continue?
videos.overview: Chotu complains to Mukundi for improving his performance. The villagers get worked-up on hearing that Pappu and Guddu got arrested in a nearby village.

videos.title: Ramleela In Lapataganj
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj take part in Ramleela where Mukundi plays Lord Ram, Indu plays Sita and Pappu plays Lakshman. All the villagers come to see the play.

videos.title: Talented Actors In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mishri playing Surpnakha is against Pappu getting to cut her nose, but gives in eventually. All the actors are happy as they successfully entertain the audience.

videos.title: The Women Get Conned
videos.overview: Indu, Mishri and other women lose their calm as a holyman claims to double their gold. Without them realizing, the con man escapes with all their gold.

videos.title: Chotu Mama Refuses to Wake Up
videos.overview: To teach Chotu mama a lesson, Pappu and Guddu pick him up with his cot and place them in the middle of the road. The villagers try their best but fail to wake Chotu up from his sleep.

videos.title: The Climax
videos.overview: When Chotu mama starts talking a lot, Pappu asks him to shut up. The villagers rehearse for the last scene of the Ramleela, which finally comes to an end after burning the Ravanas statue.

videos.title: Green Chilly Eating Competition
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj analyse the Ramleela they presented. Chotu mama and Pappu have a green chilly eating competition in front of the entire village.

videos.title: Pappu Gets Beaten Up
videos.overview: Pappu plans to teach Chotu mama a lesson but his plan backfires on him. Chotu calls the cops on Pappu and the cops beat Pappu up.

videos.title: Sureeli Wins Through Cheating
videos.overview: Sureeli hands over her award to another girl, as she cheated at the singing competition. Mishri is furious after knowing that Sureeli was lip-syncing to a song playing on the tape recorder.

videos.title: Elija, The Boss
videos.overview: Elija returns to Lapataganj with his aunt who thinks he owns the entire village. She goes around the village believing everyone is there to serve her.

videos.title: Mukundi does The Household Chores
videos.overview: Mukundi is sick and tired of doing the household chores as Indu has gone to her parent's house. When the villagers come to help Mukundi, he is reluctant.

videos.title: Another Headache For Mukundi
videos.overview: Mukundi's family starts staying in his house without any notice and he mistakes his brother-in-law for a thief. Mukundi is taken aback when he informs him that he has got a transfer in Lapataganj and that he would stay with them henceforth.

videos.title: Mukundi has Another Wife
videos.overview: A woman comes to Lapataganj asking for Mukundi claiming to be his wife. Even though Mukundi turns down all her allegations, she refuses to leave him.

videos.title: Bhanumati is a Thief
videos.overview: As Mukundi steps out of the house in the night, Bhanumati opens Indu's cupboard and takes all her jewellery. Mukundi sees this and decides to let her reality be known.

videos.title: Kachua is Back
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are surprised to see Kachua after very long. When Chotu mama spreads baseless rumours about Kachua, he is furious. He starts beating him up in from of all the villagers.

videos.title: Kachua to Change His Name
videos.overview: Kachua is adamant about changing his name to get rid of all his problems. The villagers try to change his decision but in vain, even after Chotu apologizes to him.

videos.title: A Millionaire In Lapataganj
videos.overview: When Chotu mama shares his unreasonable dream with his fellow villagers, they laugh at him. A millionaire comes looking for Pappu which gains everyone's attention.

videos.title: A Demand For Pappu
videos.overview: Mishri and Chotu make Sureeli believe that Pappu is going to get married to another girl. The man from the city is so desperate to get his daughter married to Pappu, that he does not think twice before buying him.

videos.title: Chotu is Asked to Find a Job
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are behind Chotu to get a job, but he is reluctant towards their wish. Mishri makes it clear that she can't take care of him anymore as he does not earn any money.

videos.title: Chotus Attempt to be an Electrician
videos.overview: Learning that Lapataganj would soon have an electric supply, Chotu decides to learn the work of an electrician. Trying to fix things, he creates trouble for the people in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Mukundi is Desperate For Indu's Return
videos.overview: The postman at Mukundi's workplace while getting retired, tells him that there are a lot of letters which are still undelivered. Mukundi is anxious thinking when would Indu return.

videos.title: Indu Abandons Mukundi
videos.overview: Mukundi starts crying after reading Indu's letter which says that she would never come back. The entire village is worried after this news spreads and starts giving Mukundi suggestions on how to get her back.

videos.title: Suman Visits Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu mama tells his fellow villagers that he is leaving for Golganj to get his niece, Suman to Lapataganj. Sureeli and Mishri are extremely happy to receive Suman.

videos.title: Sureeli Plays The Cupid
videos.overview: Chotu fixes Sureeli's marriage to Prem Babu, who is actually Suman's lover. But Sureeli is adamant about marrying Pappu. Mishri catches Sureeli making the lovebirds meet.

videos.title: Wait For Prem Babu
videos.overview: Suman sends Prem Babu a letter through Sureeli, which Pappu perceives differently. Chotu and Mishri await Prem Babu but he is nowhere to be found.

videos.title: Suttilal In a Mess
videos.overview: Lapataganj's new Development Officer arrives and starts enquiring about the residents. Kanyakumari and Mukundi were college lovers. Mukundi suggests Suttilal the ways to save his shop.

videos.title: Mukundi Attempts to Save Suttilal
videos.overview: Mukundi's efforts bring colours to Suttilal's life. Kanyakumari and her assistants evade the situation once the journalists intervene.

videos.title: Pre-funeral Plan
videos.overview: A minister comes to visit Suttilal and threatens him for going on a hunger strike. Different businessmen meet Suttilal to sell their products.

videos.title: Suttilal The Thief
videos.overview: Mukundi explains his plan to the villagers to get rid of the media. The villagers plot that Suttilal is a thief and Pappu adds up to their drama.

videos.title: Patni Aakhir Patni Hoti Hai
videos.overview: Mukundilal rejoices as his beloved wife Indumati, finally returns home after spending time at her parents' house.

videos.title: Mukkoos Cuckoo
videos.overview: Indu is tensed about Kanyakumari's growing closeness to Mukundi. Mukundi comes home late daily, which adds up to Indu's doubts. What will happen when Indu finds Mukundi with Kanyakumari?

videos.title: Indu is Shattered
videos.overview: Indu decides to go back to her mother's place on finding Mukundi returning home in Kanyakumari's car. The villagers try to convince Indu but its too late already.

videos.title: Elija's Wedding
videos.overview: Elija takes Chotu's criticism too hard, and gets sensitive about being unmarried. Kanyakumari is annoyed to hear about Indu from Mukundi. Elija beats the drums and swears about getting married in front of the villagers.

videos.title: Elija's Sweety
videos.overview: Sweety enters Lapataganj and asks Elija to help her out. Elija challenges Chotu that he will get married soon. Guddu is called upon by Elija for advices but Chotu has already manipulated Guddu.

videos.title: Elija's Wish to Get Married
videos.overview: Elija dresses up in mismatched clothes to impress a girl he has set his eyes on. He intends to get married to her and goes behind wooing her.

videos.title: Mishris Dream Come True
videos.overview: Mishri dreams about Chotu getting bashed due to his antics and her religious Baba confirms that will happen. Chotu doesn't bother about any of the superstition and goes out to only realize that it turned to be true. Indu saw a terrible dream at the same hour as Mishris, will that also be true?

videos.title: Indu's Death Fear
videos.overview: Indu is scared and does everything she can for her family to remember her. Guddu lies to Mishri and takes Pappu to feed Sureeli. Chotu stops the lovebirds and snatches away the jalebis.

videos.title: Kanyakumari Doesnt Like Kids
videos.overview: Indu calls Eliza over and makes him wear numerous rakhis. Indu and Mukundi invite Kanyakumari for dinner but Chukundi ruins the mood.

videos.title: Bindwasini At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Pappu gifts a few bangles to Sureeli and gets caught thereafter. Indu plans that her sister, Bindwasini, is ideal for Mukundi and tries to push them for going for a movie.

videos.title: Pappu is In Danger
videos.overview: Indu finally reveals everything to her sister, Bindumati. Mukundi has a nightmare about Pappu getting badly attacked and so Indu goes to alert him.

videos.title: Indu Gets Jealous
videos.overview: Indu is in a hurry to send off Bindwasini home, but Mukundi's statement shocks everyone. The Lapataganj is united once again to help one of their residents.

videos.title: Storytellers At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu amuses the crowd with his father's story. Kachua is back in Lapataganj but nobody is ready to listen to him. So Chotu suggests Kachua newer ways to gain his importance back.

videos.title: Kachhua Ki Pooch
videos.overview: Kachhua Prasad slaps a Government official after mistaking him for a roadside romeo and immediately regrets it when the officer reveals his identity.

videos.title: Kachuas Case
videos.overview: Kachua slapped Manchale Yadav and has made things hard for himself. The villagers seek help from Lallan but he refuses to help.

videos.title: Lapataganj At Stake
videos.overview: The villagers try to convince Kachua for apologising to the government officer but he denies to accept his mistake at all. Lapataganj will be added to a highway and there is no scope for development.

videos.title: The Cross Connection
videos.overview: Pappu keeps hiding and running from his family to avoid meeting a girl named Duniya. Pappu chooses Guddu as the ideal alternative to send for the date. Duniya likes Guddu and selects him as her prospective husband.

videos.title: He Chosen Misconception
videos.overview: Chuniya, Duniya's father arrives at Lapataganj to meet Guddu. Pappu is upset to know Duniya has chosen Guddu. Lapataganj gets engrossed in Guddu's celebration.

videos.title: Guddus Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: While Lapataganj is celebrating Guddu's haldi, Chuniya Dubey brings a better proposal for Guddu's future. Pappu and Guddu get emotional for this new step.

videos.title: Guddu's Wedding
videos.overview: The villagers convince Guddu that Lapataganj will always be his. Guddu and Duniya make a perfect couple, but Pappu tries to tease them by getting in between. Lapataganj is heartbroken to witness Guddu's farewell.

videos.title: Friends Reunite
videos.overview: Pappu is in depression as he still feels Guddu is in Lapataganj. Sureeli goes to another village with her mother. The villagers worry about Guddu's condition, when Guddu arrives at Lapataganj.

videos.title: Father's Reminiscence
videos.overview: Duniya stands in between of Guddu and Pappu. Chotu finds his father's things in the safe and show it off to the villagers. While Lapataganj celebrates their father's birthday, Chotu takes up a challenge.

videos.title: Chotu Gets In Trouble
videos.overview: Chotu is worked up to accept this challenge of showing his fathers photograph. Suttilal, Chaurasia and Elija tries to convince him but that starts a new problem.

videos.title: Chotu Goes Missing
videos.overview: Chotu decides to sketch his father's picture. Mukundi prepares food while Chotu chats with him. The artist who arrives is a professional sketch artist for Police.

videos.title: Chotu's Photo In The Newspaper
videos.overview: The people in Lapatganj are in shock to see Chotu mama's picture in the newspaper, saying he is no more. During a prayer service, Chotu's presence scares everyone.

videos.title: The Army Of Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu mama goes in search for members for the army from Lapataganj. Lallu's return after 6 years excites everyone. Chaurasiya narrates the incident of how Lallu left the village.

videos.title: Lallu's Return Awaited
videos.overview: Lallu returns to Lapataganj after 6 years. His arrival brings tears in their eyes as he is injured. They all celebrate Lallu's return in Lapataganj, before which he shares his experience.

videos.title: A Reward For Lallu
videos.overview: A celebration takes place in Lapataganj for Lallu's return and the minister promises him a license for putting up a petrol bunk. Lallu visits the collector along with Mukundi.

videos.title: Honeymoon Express
videos.overview: An announcement goes around in Lapataganj of a new movie. Indumati tries to convince Mukundi to take her. Guddu and his wife, Duniya too, go to watch the new movie.

videos.title: The Husbands are Punished
videos.overview: Mukundi, Guddu, and Lallan are put outside the house, as they do not agree to go with their wives for a honeymoon. Chotu brings a smile on Surili's face and makes her laugh.

videos.title: Honeymoon Fantasies
videos.overview: Bindu, Indumati and Duniya discuss their honeymoon fantasies. Sutti Lal is upset as his wife, Mircha as she is forcing him to take her for the honeymoon.

videos.title: Excited Wives Of Lapataganj
videos.overview: All the couples are excited as they are finally going for the honeymoon. They discuss the places to visit. Duniya's father lends some money to Guddu to take Duniya for the honeymoon.

videos.title: Honeymoon Journey Begins
videos.overview: Everyone waits for Thota Ram who has planned the Honeymoon trip. A bus arrives to take everyone to the honeymoon resort. They all have a fun time during the bus journey.

videos.title: Pappu Returns to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mircha begins to weep as she has left behind her hen in the food joint that they had stopped at. Pappu returns to Lapataganj and wonders where everyone are. All of them arrive at the resort.

videos.title: Bonfire Night
videos.overview: Elija has his eyes on the receptionist at the resort. The manager takes them around the resort. They all get into the pool and have a bonfire night at the end of the day.

videos.title: Elija Gets Slapped
videos.overview: As all the couples are having a good time, Elija gets slapped by the receptionist after reading his letter. While Pappu is en route to honeymoon resort, Surili misses him.

videos.title: Surili Goes Missing
videos.overview: Elija sarcastically explains to Chotu about his conversation with the receptionist. When Surili notices all the couples having a good time, she misses Pappu even more.

videos.title: Pappu At Honeymoon Resort
videos.overview: Pappu reaches the honeymoon resort and Surili is also found. Everyone leaves to return to Lapataganj. Surili and Pappu have a moment together before the others return.

videos.title: Dabang Pandey
videos.overview: Biji Pandey finally clears his LLB exam and becomes a lawyer, but no one in his neighbourhood takes him seriously. An upset Biji decides to change his ways and bring an element of 'Dabangayi' in his attitude.

videos.title: Is Pappu an Actual Cop?
videos.overview: Indu and Duniya try to convince Mishri mausi to get Surili married to Pappu. Pappu later dressed up in police uniform arrives in Lapataganj trying to convince Mishri mausi.

videos.title: Dabang Pandey
videos.overview: Pappu takes Surili with him to distribute money. The actual police come to catch hold of Pappu. He then confesses the truth saying he was testing everyone's belief.

videos.title: Mishri Mausi's Golden Bangles
videos.overview: Mishri mausi shows off her new golden bangles. Indumati cries to Mukundi, because he hasn't bought her any bangles. Mausi plans to get Surili married to Suresh.

videos.title: Colourful Bangles For Surili
videos.overview: Mukundi visits the jewellery store with Indumati to buy bangles for her. Pappu buys colourful bangles for Surili and goes to meet her, the minute Mausi and Chotu leave the house.

videos.title: Indumati Throws a Party
videos.overview: Indumati calls for a get together to show everyone the bangles she bought. Since Indumati has bought golden bangles, Bindu tries to convince her husband to buy bangles for her as well.

videos.title: Pappu's Visit to The Jewellery Store
videos.overview: The jewellery store manager comes in search of Mukundi to collect money. Surili too asks Pappu to buy bangles for her. Bindu is excited as her husband arranges for money to buy bangles.

videos.title: Muneemji In Search Of Mukundi
videos.overview: Mukundi hides from Muneemji. Lallan and Bindu visit Indumati and Mukundi at night. Mishri mausi makes besan laddu for everyone. Mukundi is at the jewellery store again.

videos.title: Mukundi In Distress
videos.overview: Mukundi is worried thinking about Bindu's money and the bangles. Bindu is excited thinking about her bangles. Before Mukundi returns, everyone is already celebrating for Bindu's joy.

videos.title: Indumati In Shock
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked as Mukundi doesn't get the bangles. Bindu says that Indumati is jealous of her and leaves. Indu is shocked to find money in her cupboard that Mukundi had kept.

videos.title: Indu and Bindu Split Up
videos.overview: The ladies in Lapataganj are sad over Indu and BIndu's split up. Sureeli is forced to see a man for her wedding but Pappu intervenes.

videos.title: Indu Makes a Blunder
videos.overview: Indu makes a big blunder by giving Mukundi's office money to Bindu. Indu cries her eyes out, as Mukundi is nowhere to be seen and spends a sleepless night.

videos.title: Indu Observes a Fast
videos.overview: Indu in front of Lord Hanuman pleadges that she will not eat or drink anything until Mukundi returns home. Even though her fellow villagers try to make her eat something, she stands by her decision.

videos.title: Chotu Believes In Pappu's Prank
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu stick a one rupee coin on Chotu mama's forehead while he is asleep. They later tell him that if the coin sticks for one day, he would become a millionaire.

videos.title: Chotu Tries to Woo Chameli
videos.overview: As soon as Mishri agrees to get Chotu married, he tries talking to Chameli. Chotu goes to extremes to impress Chamelii but Mishri refuses to take things forward until Chotu finds a job.

videos.title: Chotu Demands Money From Mishri
videos.overview: Chotu mama goes around the village asking people what work he should be doing. Chotu demands money from Mishri to run a business.

videos.title: Mama Ki Pehli Kamai
videos.overview: Mama earns for the first time. He sends Surili to tell his mother to look for a suitable person to get married to. Mama's mother decides to meet Lalaji to discuss the same.

videos.title: Bura Na Maano Holi Hai
videos.overview: The people of Lapataganj get ready to celebrate Holi. Mama Ji dreams of being a part of the unique Holi celebration with the person he loves.

videos.title: The Festival Of Colors
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj celebrate the festival of colors with great joy and enthusiasm. Everyone thinks Chameli is angry at Chotu for throwing colors at her, but she reveals that she loved it.

videos.title: Chotu and Pappu Shake Hands
videos.overview: The men in Lapataganj regreat getting a body massage from wrestlers instead of enjoying it. Chotu and Pappu shake hands and promise to not intervene in each other's marriage.

videos.title: Chotu is Left Heartbroken
videos.overview: Chotu mama is upset as he does not want Sureeli to miss his wedding. Chotu mama is left heartbroken, when he sees another man getting married to Chameli.

videos.title: Chotu Bids Chameli Farewell
videos.overview: Chameli talks to Chotu mama for one last time, before departing from Lapataganj. Before she leaves, she asks Chotu to sing a song in front of everyone.

videos.title: A Test Of Love
videos.overview: Indu wonders if Mukundi has stopped loving her as much as he used to. She starts testing his love for her and her belief becomes stronger when he refuses to call in sick for work.

videos.title: Indu Doubts Mukundi's Love For Her
videos.overview: Seeing Indu doubt his love for her, Mukundi gives in to all her wishes. They get into a fight at the theatre, followed by a few more fights.

videos.title: Indu Gives Mukundi a Hard Time
videos.overview: Indu asks Mukundi to wrestle with a strong wrestler to prove his love for her. Chukundi tells Mukundi that Indu is planning to leave the house if he does not agree for wrestling.

videos.title: Mukundi Agrees to Wrestle
videos.overview: Indu announces that Mukundi will be wrestling a sumo in front of everyone in Lapataganj. Mukundi applies for a two months leave at work, thinking he would definitely break his bones.

videos.title: Mukundi Panics
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj prepare Mukundi for the fight but he starts panicking. Mukundi loses all his confidence seeing the wrestler and is unable to accept the reality.

videos.title: Winner Of Love
videos.overview: Mukundi loses the wrestling match but wins in his test of love. Indu and Mukundi exchange gifts and share their journey of love.

videos.title: Tie Magic
videos.overview: Bindu and Lallan fight over a tie and the question of gentleman arises. Two suited men arrive at Lapataganj and they only find Lallan as a gentleman.

videos.title: Mukundi, a Gentleman
videos.overview: The whole village starts wearing ties as to feel like a gentleman. Even Mukundi suits up in a blazer and tie and Indu is shocked to see him.

videos.title: Sureeli's Fast
videos.overview: Pappu is excited to have Sureeli back at Lapataganj. Sureeli starts fasting for a day on the suggestion of a Baba, when she hears that Pappu is going to see another woman.

videos.title: Mishri Forces Sureeli
videos.overview: Mishri prepares Sureeli's favourite food to break her fasting, but she still refrains from having any food. Elija collapses when Chotu slaps him assuming it is Pappu.

videos.title: Sureeli's Wrath
videos.overview: Mishri and Sureeli finally end their fasting when their town hall clock strikes six but Chotu reveals that the clock was forwarded only to break their fasting. Sureeli starts dancing in front of Lord Shiva in despair.

videos.title: United
videos.overview: The whole village gathers to feed Sureeli as she denies in anger. Chotu plays a new trick to make Sureeli have her food but fails miserably.

videos.title: Fasts For Sureeli
videos.overview: Sureeli gets weak without taking any food, even after Mishri's and Chotu's several tries. Mukundi insults Chotu, when he is having food at Suttilal. Lapataganj sits down together to fast till Sureeli doesn't break hers.

videos.title: Sureeli In a Severe State
videos.overview: A doctor comes to check Sureeli's state and suggests a few remedies. Mukundi finally succeeds in convincing Sureeli to have food for Chukundi's sake.

videos.title: Elija In Trouble
videos.overview: Mircha finishes all the food at her husband, Suttilal's shop. Pappu teases Sureeli for fasting so long. Elija catches the wrong man thinking as thief and now his life is in danger.

videos.title: Elija Tries to Hide
videos.overview: Elija hides behinds the bars by slapping a constable, but is announced the winner at a local level tailoring contest. Ghamshyampur's residents get Elija out on bail for bashing him, but Mukundi and Chotu get stuck with them.

videos.title: Thakur Brothers In Disguise
videos.overview: Elija again slaps a constable for hiding in jail. The Thakur brothers dress up differently to search for Elija. One of them falls for Sureeli and Guddu overhears him. Mukundi catches one of them dressed as a postman.

videos.title: New Plan to Find Elija
videos.overview: Thakur brothers fail to find Elija and Lapataganj residents feel relieved. Mukundi suggests everyone to stay alert. The brothers plot another way to attack Elija.

videos.title: Mama Ji Tries to Bail Elija
videos.overview: Mama Ji tries to bail Elija out of jail. Later, a lawyer reaches the police station and bails Elija out. Who sent the lawyer?

videos.title: Elija Gets Relieved
videos.overview: Chotu plans to escape from Lapataganj till this trouble evades. Mukundi is in deep thoughts to find out a solution for Elija. Mukundi manages to convince the older Thakur and he forgives Elija but the brothers don't.

videos.title: Mukundi's Friend
videos.overview: Mukundi struggles to get Chukundi ready and Sugandhi arrives. Chukundi reads a letter for Mukundi from his friend. Mukundi makes arrangement and the whole village awaits Prasanna.

videos.title: Misconception
videos.overview: Prasanna's entry is enjoyed by the villagers, even Chukundi appears really smart to him. Suttilal's samosas are a delight to the guest. But the residents have a misconception about Prasanna.

videos.title: Fight to Impress
videos.overview: There is a fight over buying samosas at Suttilal's shop. The fight is actually to impress Prasanna, who himself is stressed over the misconception that Mukundi has.

videos.title: Prasanna is Tied Up
videos.overview: Lapataganj members dream about expanding their means of livelihood. The villagers get united to host a program for Prasanna. Prasanna enjoys their company and fears to reveal the truth.

videos.title: Prasanna Finally Discloses
videos.overview: The villagers are disappointed to know about the truth of Prasanna as their dreams are shattered. A Hakim arrives at Lapataganj to fool the simple villagers, Mukundi stands against it.

videos.title: Neem Hakim's Trickery
videos.overview: Pappu has no chance with Sureeli as his plan fails. Lallan and Mukundi argue about silly issues. Elija gets rejected by a woman. Hakim starts plotting new ways to affect the villagers.

videos.title: Hakim Gets Some Approval
videos.overview: Suttilal and Mircha go to the Hakim for treating their buffalo. Meanwhile, Lallan cannot find his glasses, and Bindu wishes he didn't have to wear them. One-by-one, the villagers visit the Hakim with their ailments.

videos.title: Suttilal's Life In Danger
videos.overview: Suttilal eats the medicine for his buffalo and falls sick. The villagers start to realize Hakim's medicines are fake. Lallan gets stuck due to his carelessness.

videos.title: No Recovery
videos.overview: Mukundi saves Lallan from getting beaten up as he isn't wearing his glasses. The villagers discuss and lie about their ailments. Pappu gets beaten up by Mishri when she hears about the medicines he gave her.

videos.title: Pappu Ustad a Fraudx
videos.overview: The villagers finally reveal to each that there is no sign of recovery. The whole village together confronts the fake Hakim and asks their money back.

videos.title: Suttilal's New Problem
videos.overview: Lallan's colleagues will visit them, so he asks Bindu to prepare a special menu. Suttilal goes to Mukundi to resolve his problems.

videos.title: Suttilal Closes His Shop
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj wonder why Suttilal's shop is closed, which is unusual. Suttilal tells them that he would never reopen his shop because people never repay their debts.

videos.title: Suttilal's Decision Affects The Villagers
videos.overview: Lallan's boss and his wife leave his house after tasting the food they had to offer him. Sureeli tells Pappu that he does not love her anymore as he did not get her jalebis.

videos.title: Suttilal to Reopen His Shop
videos.overview: Mukundi makes everyone repay their debts they had taken from Suttilal. Suttilal agrees to reopen his shop leaving everyone extremely happy.

videos.title: Lallan is Thrown Out Of The House
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu admire a new woman who they notice in Lapataganj. Bindu asks Lallan to stay out of the house until he gets his all three daughters home.

videos.title: Bindu Reunites With Her Daughters
videos.overview: Lallan's mother asks Bindu to have a son against her will. Bindu breaks down seeing her daughters. Lallan's mother constantly finds faults in whatever Bindu and her daughters do.

videos.title: Lalan Ji's Mother Comes Over
videos.overview: Lalan Ji's amma has come over. She fusses over her son. Later, Lalan Ji's daughters arrive.

videos.title: Daughters are a Gift
videos.overview: Mukundi and other villagers try to make Lallan's mother understand how lucky it is to have daughters. She understands only when her grand-daughters save her after her clothes catch fire.

videos.title: Sureeli Wins a Dance Competition
videos.overview: Sureeli is extremely happy as she has won the dance competition in her school. Chotu mama drags Sureeli home when he ends up seeing Pappu romancing her.

videos.title: The Money Order
videos.overview: Mishri and Chotu wonder why her husband still hasn't sent across the money order for the month. They are relieved when Mukundi informs them that the money order has come.

videos.title: Chotu Blames Pappu For Robbery
videos.overview: Mishri gets a shock after learning that Chotu has lost the money somewhere. Chotu blames Pappu for stealing his money which upsets Sureeli.

videos.title: Sureeli Breaks Up With Pappu
videos.overview: Mishri and her family begin to think about how to generate the money so that they can get through the month. Sureeli goes to Pappu and ends all ties with him.

videos.title: Mama Ki Chai Ki Dukaan
videos.overview: Mama opens a tea stall. Lalan Ji's wife decides to send their three daughters to Surili, for dance classes. Later, Surili lies when she is asked why she has been feeling low.

videos.title: Chotu Plays The Blame Game
videos.overview: Chotu mama opens a small tea stall to earn money, whereas Sureeli teaches dance to a few kids to generate money. After losing the next money order, Mama blames it on Mukundi.

videos.title: The Only School In Lapataganj Closes
videos.overview: Chotu mama takes his coat to Elija and asks him to stitch it back as he was the one to tear it. People in Lapataganj are shocked to learn that the only school in the village is shutting down forever.

videos.title: Vs Gumshudaganj
videos.overview: Mukundi gets very upset as the only school in Lapataganj closes. Everyone sit together and listen to the protest Mukundi has in his mind.

videos.title: Mukundi's Excellent Plan
videos.overview: Mukundi put up posters all over Lapataganj with the help of his fellow villagers. He then, openly challenges whosoever has done this, should come up if they have guts in them.

videos.title: Mukundi's Father-in-law
videos.overview: Mukundi is busy making his son do is homework. Then, suddenly, Bindubasini and Mukundi's father-in-law surprise him. But Mukundi is not at all surprised to see them.

videos.title: The Kho-kho Competition
videos.overview: There is a Kho-Kho competition taking place between Lapataganj and Gumshudaganj ladies. Laptaganj is in the lead with only one player left, Bindumati. But mishap happens and Bindumati falls down. Will Lapataganj win this competition?

videos.title: Kabaddi Competition
