videos.overview: It is time for a competition between the men. One side is the Lapataganj heroes and the other side are the Gumshudaganj heroes.

videos.title: Mishri's Prayer Worked
videos.overview: Mishri keeps on praying for the Lapataganj heroes so that they win the Kabaddi competition. By God's grace and everyone's hard work, Lapataganj wins and Sureeli comes running to tell her the news.

videos.title: Injured Bindumati
videos.overview: Bindumati is still in terrible pain after she hurt herself while playing Kho-Kho. Her mother-in-law asks Lallan to take care of her. He thinks Bindu should be taken to the city for a better treatment.

videos.title: Mircha In Pain
videos.overview: Lapataganj wins the game of "hide and seek" as nobody can find Chukundi, who is their sixteenth member. Mircha alone can defeat four men in "tug of war" but her hands get burnt.

videos.title: Question Of Winning
videos.overview: Mircha's condition doesn't stop the villagers from playing for Chukundi's school. The game is going well but suddenly Bacchi gets out and so arises the question of Lapataganj winning.

videos.title: Leads
videos.overview: Lapataganj is almost on the verge of losing the game as Mukundi is alone on one side of the rope. But a miracle happens and Lapataganj wins the game of tug of war.

videos.title: Chukundi's School Resumes
videos.overview: Lapataganj donates three lakhs for Chukundi's school. Mukundi leaves for two days but Lallan arrives. The villagers are irritated with the extreme heat and wish for rain.

videos.title: The Unbearable Heat
videos.overview: Chotu can't hide his feelings for Chameli. Chukundi has got heat rashes and Indu is tensed about him while awaiting Mukundi's return. The food products are high-priced due to the scorching heat and Mircha faints while fetching food.

videos.title: Mircha has Heat Stroke
videos.overview: The villagers struggle to pick up Mircha but finally, she regains consciousness. One Baba tells them that it will rain in an hour and rather fools them of their money.

videos.title: When It Rains
videos.overview: Lapataganj assembles to decide a way out, but Chukundi's idea actually clicks in. Finally, it rains in their village and the residents enjoy their snacks.

videos.title: Season Of Monsoon
videos.overview: Lapataganj is happy but the few miss their other halves. So Sureeli plans to make them happy and engage them in the togetherness of monsoon.

videos.title: Sugandhi's Possessiveness
videos.overview: Chotu is upset that he couldn't see Chameli when she was leaving. Chukundi argues with Indu that he won't go to school when Sugandhi is in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Sugandhi Overreacts
videos.overview: The villagers tease Sugandhi when he goes to give Mukundi tiffin and Sugandhi gives it back rightly. Sugandhi starts panicking when Mukundi is late in returning.

videos.title: Every Fathers Fear
videos.overview: Chotu discusses with others about Mukundi's misbehaviour with his father and starts avoiding him. Mukundi returns home early and realizes Chukundi is missing.

videos.title: Lallan Takes Bribes
videos.overview: Bindu is back in Lapataganj and has recovered. Bindu tells Indu that Lallan takes bribes. Suttilal gets stuck with Lallan as his papers are not clear.

videos.title: Lallan Gets Exposed
videos.overview: The whole village talks about Lallan taking bribes. Mukundi confronts Lallan but he takes it lightly. Soon, he gets caught while taking bribe.

videos.title: Raid At Lallans House
videos.overview: The officials raid at Lallan's house and make a list of essentials he has got through his bribe money. Lallan hides in shame and Bindu explains him to change his ways.

videos.title: Unlimited Friendship
videos.overview: Lallan takes a new step in his life and announces it in the village. Chotu is scared of dogs and Elija saves him. Chotu and Elija discuss their friendship and get nostalgic.

videos.title: Elija Gets a Customer
videos.overview: After a long time, Elija gets a customer who asks him to take his measurements. Elija gets super excited and gets into business. After taking all the measurements, the customer says he does not want to get anything tailored. What could possibly be the reason?

videos.title: A Piece Of Advise
videos.overview: Mamaji and Elija plan to start a business together by selling Elija's aunts chain. But they are shocked to know the truth. They are advised to take loan from the bank and start the business.

videos.title: Mama and Elija's New Shop
videos.overview: Mama and Elija have opened a new shop. The preparations for the opening are in full swing. What happens when the shop owner tells them that they cannot continue with their plan?

videos.title: Sonamals Epic Wecome
videos.overview: Sonamal gets welcomed in Lapataganj in an epic way. People tie a fire-cracker along with his pajamas string. And as soon as they light it up, he loses his calm and starts running from one place to another. Everyone laughs while watching him.

videos.title: Mamaji and Elija's Partnership
videos.overview: Mamaji asks Elija to learn lessons from him for their partnership. And Mamaji explains him their partnership and how they should work together by performing a dance.

videos.title: Lallan and Mamas Fight
videos.overview: Mama gets into an ugly fight with Lallan as he did not give money for the things he purchased from mama. He starts yelling at him and the whole Lapataganj gathers around. The fight continues to take an ugly turn.

videos.title: Indumati Returns to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi receives Indumati and brings her back home. She is excited and is surprised to see the changes in Lapataganj. Meanwhile, Lallan starts yelling at Mukundi this time for his money.

videos.title: Friends Turn Into Enemies
videos.overview: Certain arguments lead to a fight between Mamaji and Elija. The start throwing grocery items on each other and break down the store they started together. Mukundi reminds them of their ethics.

videos.title: A Girl Calls Mukundilal Her Father
videos.overview: Indumati and Mukundilal meet a young girl outside a temple, who follows them and calls Mukundilal her father. Mukundilal decides to drop her off where they found her, but the other people present there cause a commotion.

videos.title: Mukundi Mistaken Again
videos.overview: As soon as Mukundi is leaving that girl in the police station, he gets caught by one of the constables. He is asked to take her home with him and not to do this again. Mukundi decides to keep her with him till they find her parents.

videos.title: Mamaji In Big Trouble
videos.overview: As soon as Sureeli and Mishri come back home they see a girl lying down near Mamaji. They are shocked to see her. Sureeli finds a note that someone leaves for Mamaji.

videos.title: Lallanji Conned
videos.overview: Pappu and mamaji start having a fight for Samosa. The shop owner gets into trouble, till then the little girl comes and sorts it out. Later, they con Lallanji and eat samosas on his money.

videos.title: Against Policemen
videos.overview: As soon as everyone sees the policemen, they get concerned if they will have to give Bhagyalakshmi back. Unknowingly, everyone starts protesting against them that they will not hand over her to them.

videos.title: Everyone Craves For Mishris Sweets
videos.overview: Mishri has started preparing laddoos for kids and others. Indu comes to help her as everyone in Lapataganj loves her laddoos. Mamaji and Elija demand extra sweets to be made as they get finished very early.

videos.title: Mukundi Blames Indumati
videos.overview: Mukundi comes back home in full anger as he finds the pack of sweets to be empty. Without knowing the actual truth, he starts yelling at Indu and blames her for staeling someones sweets.

videos.title: Misunderstanding Prevails
videos.overview: Mishri calls Lallanji to talk about something. But he tries to hide his face for what he did. But both are talking about a different topic unknowingly and hence misunderstanding builds up.

videos.title: Ration Crisis
videos.overview: Mukundi investigates a resident and Indu gets upset that he is out late at night. Mukunda calls an assembly to talk about the smuggling of the ration.

videos.title: Putanis Letter
videos.overview: The villagers argue over who sent Putani the laddoos as he has written a letter to Mishri telling her about it. Lapataganj celebrates the twelfth anniversary of Lallan and Bindu.

videos.title: Black Market
videos.overview: Sugandhi talks about how to become self-sufficient. Mircha announces that there is a discount on ration. There is a long queue at the ration shop and the villagers start fighting. Mukundi finds one neighbour smuggling their ration.

videos.title: Mishris Special Laddoo
videos.overview: Chotu is upset as he didnt even share of the laddoos that Mishri prepared. Mukundi asks help from Chotu to convince Mishri.

videos.title: Self Sufficiency
videos.overview: Mukundi plots to find out the ration smuggling result but Indu's misunderstanding stops him. Together, the residents of Lapataganj catch the culprit and put an end to the black market.

videos.title: Bhaag Elija Bhaag
videos.overview: Elija gets into trouble with the relatives of a goon. The goon sends men to find Elija. Elija and Mama get beaten up in front of all the people.

videos.title: Sureeli's Fan
videos.overview: Sureeli slaps a boy, who is Thakurs brother and he decides to marry her. Singaraganjs Thakur, Bhanu Pratap arrives at Lapataganj to arrange this wedding and the villagers misunderstand.

videos.title: Gyaanis Weird Problem
videos.overview: Thakur and his brother, Gyaani enter Lapataganj and start creating a fuss. Thakur tells everyone about Gyaanis weird problem of whistling after finish any sentence.

videos.title: Pappu's Law Degree
videos.overview: Pappu goes to the law college to get his degree certificate. He gets very happy to receive it and starts wondering that this not just a law degree certificate, it is a certificate which will make him get married to Sureeli.

videos.title: Angry Sureeli
videos.overview: Sureeli gets very angry when everybody says a no for her and Pappu's marriage. She stops eating dinner, Mishri tries to make her understand what is good for her.

videos.title: Sureeli On Cloud Nine
videos.overview: Sureeli is extremely happy and on cloud nine when Mishri and Mamaji agree on what Sureeli wants. Bindumati comes and both of them share their feelings. Sureeli dreams about herself and Pappu together.

videos.title: Elija Teases Suttilaal
videos.overview: Elija teases Sutilaal and Mircha Bhabhi and reminds them old days. he keeps insisting Mirja Bhabhi to tell him how she impressed Suttilaal so that he can take that tip and impress some other girl.

videos.title: Mishri and Mamaji Threatened
videos.overview: Thakur sends his men to threaten Mishri and her family as they said a no for the marriage. Mishri loses her calm and gets scared. Mamaji asks her to wait till morning and then they will asks everyone.

videos.title: The Family Lodges a Complaint
videos.overview: Surili meets an unexpected guest as she stares out of the bus window. Surili feels weak since she has not eaten anything for a while. On the other hand, Surili's family members are worried about her and lodge a complaint with the police.

videos.title: Sureeli and Pappu Run Away
videos.overview: Sureeli and Pappu decide to run away from Lapatagnaj as everyone was against them. They come running to a hilltop and decide to make their house their and stay together happily.

videos.title: Mamajis Truth Revealed
videos.overview: Thakur Singh comes back in Lapataganj and is very angry. Firstly, he asks Mamaji nicely but then yells at him for not saying the truth. He threatens him that he will have to pay for lying to him.

videos.title: Mishri and Mamaji Threatened
videos.overview: Gabbu Pandey enters Lapataganj in a rickshaw but he does not have the change to give. Then he asks Suttilaal to give the rickshaw person money. He starts with his false philosophy and ends up giving no one their money, as usual.

videos.title: Letter From Pappu
videos.overview: Finally, Pappu sends a letter to Mishri and mamaji. They ask Mukundi to read it and let them know what is their status. Mishri starts to panic and becomes restless to know what is there in the letter.

videos.title: Mishri Loses All Her Calm
videos.overview: Mishri does not keep calm as Sureeli is not back home yet. She plans to go and find her anywhere and so packs her bag and is ready to leave. But then Indumati comes and asks her to calm down as Mukundi has already gone to find her.

videos.title: Vs Thakur and His Brothers
videos.overview: Thakur gets to know that Sureeli is back with Pappu in lapataganj. He comes along with his brothers to take back Sureeli. One after the other everyone starts protecting Sureeli and Pappu.

videos.title: Thakurs New Plan
videos.overview: Gyaani keeps crying all day long as he cannot stand Sureeli and Pappu together. He begs to Thakur, his brother, to do something or it will be late and Sureeli will get married to Pappu. What will Thakur plan now?

videos.title: Pappu Fights Like a Hero
videos.overview: As Pappu was about to leave to give the hard-earned money to Mishri, Gyaani and his men stop him and does not let him go. Watch how bravely Pappu fights all the goons and Gyaani.

videos.title: The Antaakshari Game
videos.overview: Everything ends on a good note and every member of the Lapataganj family is happy. They sit for a competition where they have to sing with the last alphabet is given to them. Everyone is enjoying and are competitive at the same moment.

videos.title: Kachua Chachas Protest
videos.overview: Kachua Chacha stands on the middle of Lapataganj dressed as Anna and protests against corruption. He tries to influence other people by telling them what is going in the country.

videos.title: Celebrations have Started
videos.overview: It is time that Pappu and Sureeli are going to get married to each other. The whole of Lapataganj is decorated and the Hadli function has started.

videos.title: Indumati Scares Mukundi
videos.overview: Indumati starts running from here and there in the house, trying to hide from Mukundi. She starts blushing when Mukundi comes near her to ask something. What could be the news that scared Mukundi so much.

videos.title: Men In Disguise
videos.overview: All men could not control themselves from not entering the ladies function. So instead they wear saree and do some make-up and enter the function. Watch what happens when they get caught.

videos.title: Elija Finds The Solution
videos.overview: Pappu's father says that they want to bear the weddings expenses. But Mishri does not agree to it and says that she will bear the expenses as it is her daughters wedding. Both of them start fighting, so Elija comes up with a perfect solution.

videos.title: Pappu Weds Sureeli
videos.overview: Pappu is mesmerised seeing Sureeli as his bride. After so much chaos, they finally tie the knot and get married to each other.

videos.title: Sureeli Misses Her Father
videos.overview: Sureeli is extremely upset after receiving her father's letter which states the reason why he wouldn't be able to attend her wedding. Pappu and Sureeli then get busy with their post-wedding festivities.

videos.title: Pappu Leaves Without Surili
videos.overview: A dance face off takes place between the boys and girls. Pappu finally gets his shoes back from the girls. Pappu had to leave to his house without Surili, after the wedding.

videos.title: Pappu Visits Surili
videos.overview: Pappu returns to his house upset, and cries to Guddu. He decides to visit Surili the very next day. The contractor who organized the wedding comes to collect money from Pappu's father.

videos.title: Mishri Mausis Vows
videos.overview: When Pappu goes to meet Surili he mimicks a dog to indicate his arrival to Surili. Mukundi who is upset ove a fight with Indumati, expresses his concerns to Lallan and Bindu.

videos.title: Duniya Returns to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Pappu's father fools the constables saying he is very influential. Guddu is upset and leaves the house. Duniya returns to Lapataganj after receiving a letter from Guddu.

videos.title: Pappu's Confession
videos.overview: The people of Lapataganj are shocked to see Guddu with another lady. Pappu confesses to have written the letter to Duniya. They thank the lord for his miracles and for reuniting Guddu and Duniya.

videos.title: Pappu Bails Out His Father
videos.overview: Chotu is shocked to see Lallan involved in prayer like never before. Pappu goes to the police station to bail out his father as his lawyer. Mishri mausi returns to Lapataganj without Surili.

videos.title: Mukundi to The Rescue
videos.overview: Chotu asks his friends to answer a general riddle. He decides that Mukundi is the smartest. Elija distributes the kulfi that he made. Mukundi saves everyone from the shock received from the fridge.

videos.title: Chameli Back In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Lallan returns to Lapataganj with Chameli. Chotu is excited with Chamelis return. Chotu cant take his eyes off Chameli. Chotu shoos away Chotu and the others who keep an eye on Chameli.

videos.title: Chotus Wish to Marry Chameli
videos.overview: Chotu eagerly waits for Chameli. He informs Mishri that he wants to marry Chameli. Mukundi, Mishri mausi and Elija visit Lallan to talk about Chotu and Chamelis wedding.

videos.title: Chotu The Bodyguard
videos.overview: Chotu becomes Chameli bodyguard to keep her safe and sound. He escorts her to the temple. Lallan appoints ten bodyguards for himself. Chotu challenges them to whistle the way he does.

videos.title: The New Saree Store In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi is excited as his wife, Indumati is returning to Lapataganj. He prepares tea for Indumati. Bindu takes Indumati with her to visit the new saree store.

videos.title: Fight Over Saree
videos.overview: The ladies fight over the pending saree gift from their husbands. Pappu gets money as advance for a case and share with Guddu.

videos.title: Best Gift In Lapataganj
videos.overview: The men buy sarees for their better halves by paying almost five times more as the seller dupes them. The women engage in a competition of dressing up the best.

videos.title: Culprit In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chaurasias long term friend arrives at Lapataganj while evading the police. He overhears Mukundi's conversation with the jeweller. Pappu helps Mishri in running errands.

videos.title: Thief In Mukundi's House
videos.overview: Mukundi announces in front of his neighbors about buying gold earrings for Indu. After the dinner at Mukundi's place, the new guest attempts a robbery.

videos.title: Drama On Ramleela
videos.overview: Lapataganj is excited for the Ramleela play and starts practicing the characters. Suttilal is stuck in his character of Maharaja Janak and Lallan expresses how lucky is he to have daughters.

videos.title: Fight Over Bottle Gourd
videos.overview: The play on Ramleela happens successfully, even though, Indu and Mukundi were fighting. The whole village eavesdrops their argument and tries to sort it out.

videos.title: Father's Order
videos.overview: Sugandhi impresses the villagers with his satirical acting and generates more funds. What will happen when Chukundi forgets to bring the soap Mukundi asked him to get for Sugandhi?

videos.title: Pappu's Revenge
videos.overview: Mircha requests Suttilal for giving food on loan to Pappu, who is depressed. Mishri performs well as Surpanakha but Pappu is adamant about taking his revenge from her.

videos.title: Ramleela In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Ramleela has been organised in Lapataganj and everybody dresses up as different characters. Mamaji and Lallanji go against each other to play their respective roles.

videos.title: The War Continues
videos.overview: Ramleela act continues as they portray the story. The audience enjoys as it is wartime and everyone playfully hit each other to get in character.

videos.title: Husband Problems
videos.overview: Mukundi gets up from his nap and does not find Indumati anywhere. He is glad not to find her as he will not have to listen to Indu's rants. But Then Lallanji comes and he gets upset.

videos.title: Pappu Gets Slapped
videos.overview: While getting down of the train, Pappu hugs Sureeli and gets all romantic. But then he gets slapped as the woman he is hugging is not Sureeli. Pappu gets embarrassed as everyone is looking at him.

videos.title: Pappu Apologizes to Bhabau Singh
videos.overview: Pappu mistakenly hugs T.T. Bhabausinghs wife. Later he apologizes to Bhabausingh and pleads him to not keep any grudges. He later tells him that he will be going to Mumbai in the same train and that they should keep harmony among themselves.

videos.title: Bomb In The Train
videos.overview: There is a bomb in the train and everyone gets to know about it. There is chaos as everyone is in panic. Indumati starts crying as she does not want to die. How will everyone get out of this situation?

videos.title: On The Way to Mumbai
videos.overview: Elija and Chotu miss the train to Mumbai. While finding a way out, they find Sureeli and Pappu also stranded on Laxmanghat station. On realising a shop has similar clothes as Chotu does, they manage to catch the thief that sells their bag.

videos.title: Finally Mumbai
videos.overview: Chotu and Elija finally come out there hiding. The truck driver agrees to take them to the next station, Igatpuri. The villagers give a surprise to Mishris husband.

videos.title: Life At a Resort
videos.overview: The villagers are on an emotional rollercoaster to stay at the resort. The couples enjoying themselves but Sureeli leaves Mishris room at late night.

videos.title: What is a Pool?
videos.overview: Pappu and Sureeli spend some time alone but Pappu is annoyed with Mishris decision on delaying. The women are confused to see a swimming pool at their resort.

videos.title: Mumbai Experience
videos.overview: Lapataganj residents travel around Mumbai and experience different and newer aspects of life. They indulge in variety of food and sea bathing.

videos.title: The Real Reel
videos.overview: Lapataganj residents gear up for the witnessing the shoot. Indu's act scares Mukundi and Bindu. Pappu plans to spend time with Sureeli and convinces Guddu.

videos.title: The Cake Fight
videos.overview: Shooting begins but the heroine is forgetful of her dialogues so Indu interrupts which starts a fight between the heroine and her. On apologising, the film crew selects Indu as their new cast.

videos.title: Departure From Mumbai
videos.overview: Indu rejects the plea on Mukundi's choice but gets upset. Lapataganj residents feel heavy-hearted as they have to leave and coax Mishris husband to come along with them.

videos.title: Dumb Goon
videos.overview: The Bhais of Mumbai arrive at the resort to have a word of resolvement with Mishris husband. The villagers tackle it and board the train on time.

videos.title: Elija's Rani
videos.overview: Mirchas sister, Rani arrives at Lapataganj. Pappu threatens Mishri and Chotu for keeping Sureeli apart. Rani plans to get closer to Elija but he is perplexed.

videos.title: Chotu Cries In Pain
videos.overview: Chotu mama is cries in pain as Mishri applies a hot pack on him. Mukundi is surprised to see Indu return from her parents house in a week.

videos.title: Elija's 35th Birthday
videos.overview: It is Elija's 35th birthday and he starts missing his mother as Indu wishes him birthday just like her. People in Lapataganj try to make his birthday as memorable as possible.

videos.title: Rani Tries to Help Elija
videos.overview: Rani claims to be Elija's wife in front of the lawyer. Even though all the people stand by Ranis word, Elija reveals the truth saying Rani isnt his wife.

videos.title: Elija Stands By His Decision
videos.overview: The fellow villagers at Suttilals shop try to talk Elija into not getting married but his decision of marrying Rani remains stern.

videos.title: Mukundi is Too Busy
videos.overview: Indu is upset with Mukundi as he is too buy to take her out for a movie. Elija decides to meet Ranis parents and take Indu along with him.

videos.title: Indu Doubts Mukundi
videos.overview: Indu cries in front of Mishri as she finds two movie tickets from his pocket. Mishri suggests Indu gives Mukundi unconditional love so that he never thinks about any other woman.

videos.title: Indu Humiliates Mukundi
videos.overview: Happy with his work, Mukundi's boss lets him leave for home early. As soon as he reaches his house, Indu is waiting for him with the movie tickets she found in his pocket.

videos.title: The Villagers Approach an Exorcist
videos.overview: Chotu mama's word becomes more powerful when three other people from Lapataganj see the witch. They call an exorcist to get rid of the witch from their village.

videos.title: Chotu to Leave Lapataganj
videos.overview: The witch tells Chotu that he made a mistake calling the exorcist and that it has upset her even more. Mukundi suggests Chotu mama leaves Lapataganj to eliminate such thoughts from his head.

videos.title: Pappu Tastes His Own Medicine
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu are petrified when the witch talks about taking them with her. Mukundi and Elija then reveal that it was their plan to teach Pappu a lesson.

videos.title: Duniya Welcomes Her Friend
videos.overview: Duniya is extremely happy as she receives a letter from her friend, Gudia saying she is coming to visit her. While Guddu's father yells at him, Gudia sees him getting humiliated.

videos.title: Duniya Wants Guddu to Leave Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu and Elija make fun of Lallan as he fails to answer any riddles they throw at him. Learning that Guddu again went to meet Pappu against her wish, she asks him to leave Lapataganj and move to Kanpur with her parents.

videos.title: Duniya Refuses to Eat
videos.overview: Duniya refuses to eat anything until Guddu agrees to leave Lapataganj. Bindu asks Lallan to find a job for Guddu so that he does not have to leave Lapataganj.

videos.title: Guddus Farewell
videos.overview: Pappu along with the entire village bid Guddu farewell, before he leaves for Kanpur with Duniya. As they are about to leave, Duniya's father arrives at Lapataganj.

videos.title: Bindu Kicks Lallan Out Of The House
videos.overview: Lallan and Bindu get into a heated argument after which she kicks him out of the house. Mukundi asks Indu to talk to Bindu and resolve her fight with Lallan.

videos.title: Lallan Moves Into Mukundi's House
videos.overview: Lallan has a hard time finishing the household chores without Bindu. The next morning, Lallan arrives at Mukundi's house with his luggage and decides to stay with him.

videos.title: Bindu Refuses to Forgive Lallan
videos.overview: Mishri and other women ask Bindu to forgive Lallan and go back to her house. Even though Lallan tries to apologize to Bindu, she refuses to forgive him.

videos.title: Mukundi Goes Missing
videos.overview: Indu starts crying in front of the villagers when Mukundi does not return home till late in the night. Mukundi, after returning, reveals that he stayed the night in an abandoned house to avoid sleeping with Lallan's snores.

videos.title: Chotus Statement Hurts Sutti Lal
videos.overview: Sutti Lal overhears Chotu's statements against him and warns Pudina not to lend Chotu anything. Sutti Lal is fuming in anger because Chotu lied to him.

videos.title: Chotu Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Guddu tells Pappu that Duniya doesn't want to see them together. While Duniya arrives at Sutti Lal's stall, Guddu and Pappu hide from her. The police arrest Chotu.

videos.title: Chotus Truth is Out
videos.overview: After Chotu gets arrested, Mukundi along with the others, goes to the station to bail him out. Biji Pandey aka Pappu, visits the station to bail out Chotu.

videos.title: Mukundi's Missing Bicycle
videos.overview: Mukundi wakes up early to polish his bicycle and make it shine. Indumati is excited as she is going for the fair with Mukundi. Mukundi realises that his cycle is missing.

videos.title: Indumati Consoles Mukundi
videos.overview: Indumati is upset and angry because Mukundi returns home late and because of him she couldn't go for the fair. Everyone is shocked to learn that Mukundi's cycle is missing.

videos.title: Indumatis Prayers For Her Husband
videos.overview: Mukundi is worried thinking about his cycle. Indumati stands on leg and prays to god hoping that her husband's cycle will be found sooner.

videos.title: Mukundi's Bicycle is Found
videos.overview: Lallan buys the cycle from the man who stole from Mukundi without being aware of it. Indumati notices that the cycle which Lallan gets, is infact, Mukundi's cycle.

videos.title: Indumati Recognizes Mukundi's Cycle
videos.overview: While Indumati recognizes her husband's cycle, he pretends not to. Pappu, Guddu, and Chotu mama visit Mukundi at night. Indumati and Bindu get into and argument again.

videos.title: Mamajis Fathers Stories
videos.overview: Mamaji sits with his gang in Suttilals shop and has a gala time. They all praise him for making them laugh. Then Mamaji tells them stories about his father how he also used to make everyone laugh.

videos.title: Robbery At Lallans House
videos.overview: This time it is Lallanjis cycle that gets stolen. Bindumati witnesses it and informs Lallanji about it. He gets shocked as for how can someone steal his cycle. On the contrary, Indu finds a cycle in her porch. What is the matter?

videos.title: The Cycle Truth is Out
videos.overview: Indumati decorates the cycle as she is happy to get it back. But Bindumati claims that it is their cycle. Mishri supports Indumati as she knows it is their cycle. Everyone asks the stranger to tell the truth.

videos.title: Mishri Mausi Shocked At Chotus Behaviour
videos.overview: Chotu along with a friend go to meet Shanti who they refer to as a sanyasi. Chotu wants to attain sanyas and gain peace, when he returns home, Mishri mausi is shocked at his behaviour.

videos.title: Mishris Unending Concern
videos.overview: Mukundi comes back home from the office and relaxes until Mishri comes running asking for help. She is concerned as Chotu is not behaving normally. Mishri starts being superstitious.

videos.title: Irritating Mamaji
videos.overview: Mamaji decides to take renunciation and calls up a local meeting with the villagers. Everyone starts getting irritated as he is protesting for everyone to follow his path.

videos.title: Chotu Becomes a Sanyaas
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj are shocked looking at Chotu trying to be a sanyaasi. Elija and the others also follow Chotu's steps in becoming a sanyaasi.

videos.title: Mishri Out Of Control
videos.overview: Chotu, Elija, and two other villagers, have finally thought of going to a sacred place, out of daily life. Mishri starts to panic and goes out of control. Mukundi has lost all hope in Mamaji.

videos.title: Lohri Celebrations In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Shanti Lal and his wife arrive in Lapataganj. Chotu fails to recognize Shanti Lal. The people of Lapataganj celebrate Lohri with Shanti Lal and his wife.

videos.title: Medical Camp In Lapataganj
videos.overview: There is a free medical camp happening in Lapataganj. Mishri takes Surili with her to visit the doctor at the camp. The doctor informs them that Surili is likely to get her voice back.

videos.title: Mishri Mausi Wins a Prize
videos.overview: Mishri mausi wins a prize. Mukundi spots Pappu and Guddu going for a movie. Guddu visits Mishri mausi's house. Suttilal gets worried seeing Radhe walk towards his stall.

videos.title: Chotu Fails to Get Money
videos.overview: A sewing machine vendor comes to Lapataganj selling his company's products and Elija seems interested. Chotu goes to collect Mishri's money but doesn't get it. Radhe again visits Suttilal.

videos.title: Surili Gives Pappu The Good News
videos.overview: Guddu visits Chotu in Lapataganj. Guddu meets Surili and spends time with her. Pappu gets excited as he learns that Surili might get her voice back.

videos.title: Lallan Tries to Borrow Money
videos.overview: Lallan and Mukundi fall off the cycle. Chotu, yet again, leaves the office without getting Mishri mausi's money and meets the minister regarding the same.

videos.title: A Call For Mishri Mausi
videos.overview: Mishri mausi along with the people of Lapataganj, visits the officer who has to give them money. Mausi gets a call from the nurse saying they will prepare for Surili's operation.

videos.title: Contribution For Sureeli's Operation
videos.overview: Mishri starts crying as she tells her fellow villagers that she needs one lakh rupees to get Sureeli operated for her to speak again. People in Lapataganj decide to contribute as much as they can for Sureeli's operation.

videos.title: Sureeli Loses All Hope
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj try their best to raise money for Sureeli's operation. After learning that the money has to be deposited in the hospital within a week, Sureeli loses all hope.

videos.title: Lallan Gets Robbed
videos.overview: Chotu mama tells Elija that he is planning to rob someone in order to raise money for Sureeli's operation. In the night, both of them mug Lallan after his salary day.

videos.title: Mishri Beats Chotu Up
videos.overview: Mishri beats Chotu up after she learns that he was the one to mug Lallan. Elija explains the reason behind Chotu's wrongdoing which makes everyone in Lapataganj emotional.

videos.title: Kundan Challenges Pappu
videos.overview: Mishri apologizes to Chotu for hurting him. Kundan Singh Kushwaha challenges Pappu openly in front of everyone and announces a fight after three days in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Pappu Starts Training
videos.overview: Mukundi's father arrives in Lapataganj to give Pappu tips for how to fight. After a lot of bargain, he starts training Pappu for the fight.

videos.title: Appu Deals With Pain
videos.overview: Pappu suffers various injuries and pain while training for the fight. The day of the fight arrives, and everyone in Lapataganj roots for Pappu and motivates him.

videos.title: The Fight Day
videos.overview: Kundan Singh and Pappu begin their fight with the wooden strip and it is a close competition. In the process, Pappu gets hurt terribly and starts bleeding.

videos.title: Pappu Defeats Kundan Singh
videos.overview: As Pappu defeats Kundan Singh, the entire village of Lapataganj jumps with joy and excitement. Sureeli and her family then leave for Lucknow to get her operated.

videos.title: The Operation is Successful
videos.overview: Sureeli is admitted to the hospital and soon taken to the operation theatre. After the operation, the doctor tells the family that Sureeli will begin to talk, but gradually.

videos.title: Pappu to Move In With Sureeli
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj celebrate the happiness of Sureeli's successful operation. Mishri is so happy with Pappu that she allows him to move into their house and live with them.

videos.title: Sureeli Opposes Pappu's Actions
videos.overview: Pappu is on cloud nine when he gets to spend time with Sureeli. Mishri opposes Pappu romancing Sureeli and stops him every time he touches Sureeli.

videos.title: An Ancient Object
videos.overview: A few people, while digging up a spot in Lapataganj, find an ancient statue. When an archeologist comes and examines the statue, it is found to be of great importance.

videos.title: Mukundi and Indu Become Homeless
videos.overview: In order to find the missing part of the statue, the archeologist plans to dig Mukundi's house up. Mukundi and Indu become homeless as all their belongings are removed from their house.

videos.title: Pappu Befriends Mr Chedi
videos.overview: Mukundi overhears the labours talk about how Mr. Chedi has been getting random places dug for years. Pappu acts friendly with Mr. Chedi to get the truth out from him.

videos.title: The Missing Part
videos.overview: After Mr. Chedi finds the missing part, he is on cloud nine. Pappu calls the media in Lapataganj to cover this story.

videos.title: Indu's Mother Falls Ill
videos.overview: Mukundi and Indu are relieved to be finally back in their house and live every moment. As Indu's mother is ill, Indu goes to visit her for two days.

videos.title: Mircha Loses Her Memory
videos.overview: After Mircha trips and falls unconscious, a doctor comes to check her up. Once she wakes up, she seems to have forgotten everything and starts acting like a kid.

videos.title: Elija Romances Rani
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj try to get Mircha's memory back by reminding her of various things. Elija takes advantage of the situation and romances her sister. Rani.

videos.title: Mircha Plays With Kids
videos.overview: Mircha plays around with all the kids in Lapataganj. The cops feel that Suttilal have been troubling Mircha and arrest him.

videos.title: Suttilal Gets a Bail
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj blame Chotu mama for Mircha and Suttilals condition. They then go to the police station to get Suttilal out of the lock up.

videos.title: Mircha Regains Her Memory
videos.overview: Chotu is filled with remorse and decides to take care of Mircha. While playing, Mircha faints and when she wakes up, she regains her memory.

videos.title: Suttilal Distributes Sweets
videos.overview: Suttilal distributes sweets in Lapataganj in the joy of Mircha regaining her memory. Pappu is scared seeing Sureeli and wonders what he would do if she loses her memory.

videos.title: Mishri Stands Between Pappu and Sureeli
videos.overview: Mishri asks Sureeli and Pappu to maintain distance. She then adds that Sureeli cannot live with Pappu unless her father comes and visits them.

videos.title: Pappu Kidnaps Sureeli
videos.overview: Pappu and Guddu cover themselves and enter Mishris house with an intention to kidnap Sureeli. Mishri and other villagers are worried as Sureeli is nowhere to be seen.

videos.title: Mishri Worries For Sureeli
videos.overview: The cops come to Lapataganj and investigate everyone closely to find out who is responsible for Sureeli's abduction. Sureeli is kept in a secluded room with her mouth and hands tied.

videos.title: Pappu and Guddu Rethink Their Decision
videos.overview: Pappu covers his face and changes his voice while feeding Sureeli. Pappu and Guddu are nervous seeing how big of a deal Sureeli's abduction has become.

videos.title: Sureeli is Missed
videos.overview: Mishri and other villagers try and do the best they can in order to get Sureeli back. Sureeli is stunned to see that Pappu is the one who kidnapped her.

videos.title: Pappu Loses Sureeli
videos.overview: Seeing the people in Lapataganj worry about Sureeli, Pappu is filled with remorse. All of them are taken aback when he tells them that he had kidnapped Sureeli but now he has lost her.

videos.title: Sureeli Comes Back
videos.overview: Pappu attempts to hang himself in front of the people of Lapataganj as he is unable to take the pain. As soon as he tries to do it, he sees Sureeli and stops.

videos.title: Bhagyalaxmi does Indu Proud
videos.overview: Indu is extremely happy after Bhagyalaxmi tells her that she has won an essay competition in her school. Indu goes around the village praising her daughter.

videos.title: Bhagyalaxmis Real Parents
videos.overview: Mukundi hides the fact that Bhagyalaxmis real parent shad come to take her. When Mukundi meets her real parents, he is stunned after seeing the evidence they have to show.

videos.title: Indu is Devastated
videos.overview: When Mukundi finally reveals the truth to Indu, she is devastated. She cries all day thinking about having a life without Bhagyalaxmi.

videos.title: Bhagyalaxmi Leaves Lapataganj
videos.overview: Everyone in Lapataganj come together to celebrate Bhagyalaxmi's birthday and her last day with them. Indu and Mukundi bid her a farewell with a heavy heart.

videos.title: Distortion Of Facts
videos.overview: Chukundi refuses to eat unless he sees Bhagaylaxmi. After talking to Indu, Mukundi realizes that there has been a distortion of facts and reports it to the policeman immediately.

videos.title: Fake Parents
videos.overview: Indu and Mukundi along with the policemen track down Bhagyalaxmi and the cops arrest her fake parents. People in Lapataganj are extremely happy to see Bhagyalaxmi back in their village.

videos.title: Lallan Needs a Promotion
videos.overview: Lallan tells Bindu how desperately he wants a promotion as he might not get one for the next two years.

videos.title: Lallans Consolation Prize
videos.overview: Lallan faints when he learns that he has received a mixer grinder as a consolation prize. People in Lapataganj stand in a queue in front of Bindu's house to get various items grinded.

videos.title: Lallanji Misunderstands
videos.overview: A bank person comes to Lapataganj to give the notice. But he forgets the route Mishri told him and lands up in front of Lallanji's house. Lallanji misunderstands Mishri and does not stop yelling.

videos.title: Not a Good Day
videos.overview: Indu and Bindu have kept everything ready and are waiting for the men to come and then start the ceremony. But the men return with bad news. What is the bad news?

videos.title: Finally The Promotion
videos.overview: Finally, it is the day when Lallanji gets promoted and Mamaji brings the good news to Mishri. Lallanji invites everyone for celebrations.

videos.title: Mamajis Friendship
videos.overview: Mamaji gets up in the morning and leaves for a cup of tea with his friends. But instead, Mishri gets him the tea. He denies it as he wants to have it with his best friend, Elija and have some fun.

videos.title: Mamaji has Made The Decision
videos.overview: Mamaji has become self-obsessed and has firmly decided that he will get married for the third time. Mishri is unhappy with this decision and warns him to think all over again.

videos.title: Mamaji Mind-blown
videos.overview: A family comes to meet Mamaji and Mishri for Mamaji's marriage. Mamaji is very excited to see the girl and as soon as he sees her, he is mind-blown and wants to get married immediately.

videos.title: Denial Hits Hard
videos.overview: Mamaji loses his calm when he gets to know that the girl denied for marriage. He meets the girl's uncle who gives him the bitter truth that he is not a match for his niece.

videos.title: Things Turn Out Bad
videos.overview: Mamaji dreams about him and Chutki romancing and spending the best time. Everybody gets ready for the function, the next morning. They all keep waiting for the bride's side people to come, but no one turns up.

videos.title: Anything For Friendship
videos.overview: Mukundi and Mamaji spy on the people who denied for the marriage. They want to catch them and make them learn a lesson for whatever they did. With smartness, they plan a plot to get a hold of them.

videos.title: Ladies Talk
videos.overview: Mishri and Indumati are having a gala time with each other as they talk about Mamaji. They start laughing when they discuss if Mamaji still wants to get married.

videos.title: Chukundi Faints
videos.overview: Everyone is busy doing some or the other work in Lapataganj and suddenly Chukundi faints. Indumati starts crying and panics. What happened to Chukundi?

videos.title: Mukundi Prays For The Future
videos.overview: Elija and Mamaji are collecting donation money from people to make an umbrella for Hanuman Ji. Mukundi, on the other hand, prays for the betterment of childen and their education in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Happiness For All
videos.overview: Mukundi comes running back home with good news. He tells Chukundi and Indu that he will now be able to go back to school. This happened as Mamaji helped him by giving all the donation money.

videos.title: Bittoo Boss In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Lapatagnaj residents get excited when they see Bittoo Boss. Initially none recognised him, but later everyone started appraising them.

videos.title: Run, Elija Run
videos.overview: Mamaji makes Elija run a long way and he gets tired. Elija pleads him to stop, but he keeps running and asks him to run as well, as it good for the health and mind.

videos.title: Mukundi In Trouble
videos.overview: Mukundi is having a leisure when he suddenly remembers that he forgot to get ornaments for Indumati. When Indumati asks him about those earrings, he fails to reply.

videos.title: A Sting Operation?
videos.overview: Indumati is still angry with Mukundi and is not talking to him. Mukundi tries to woo her and uplift her mood, but it is a waste. A person comes with a hidden camera and records Mukundi and Indu's conversations.

videos.title: The Game Of Clone
videos.overview: Mukundi is against the builder's tactic of buying Lapataganj. So the builder abducts Mukundi and Churma Bhopali goes home in his place.

videos.title: Churma's Crisis
videos.overview: Churma struggles to play it cool at home and office. Indu is elated to find the earrings and doubts about Mukundi's indifferent behaviour.

videos.title: The Hidden Side
videos.overview: Churma's push up challenge leaves the whole village stunned. Guddu's father breaks down in front of Churma asking for his money back.

videos.title: In Threat
videos.overview: The villagers one by one agree to sell off their lands. Mukundi gets caught once again while trying to escape. Pickpocketer at the theatre threatens the villagers.

videos.title: Churma is Surrounded
videos.overview: Churma fights with the pickpockets and rescue back their lost money. Mukundi finally hears about his look-alike at Lapataganj. The whole village catches hold of Churma, who is trying to run away.

videos.title: Mukundi's Birthday
videos.overview: The villagers celebrate Mukundi's birthday by presenting Churma with different unique gifts. Mukundi, on the other hand, gets a cake from Govardhan.

videos.title: Change Of Fate
videos.overview: Churma brings the legal papers for their land. Lapataganj residents start dreaming about their better future. Govardhan tells Mukundi about the changing story of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Churma V/s Govardhan
videos.overview: The villagers are about to sign the papers, when Mukundi enters and exposes Govardhan. Churma makes a dynamic entry.

videos.title: Look-alikes Team Up
videos.overview: Mukundi and Churma tell their story and impress the residents of Lapataganj, but only Indu is able to recognise the real Mukundi. Elija wishes he too can have a wife like Chotu did.

videos.title: Elija's Perseverance
videos.overview: Elija is missing Rani but Mircha is still not agreeing to marry them off. Elija with help of his neighbours attempts to pursue Mircha.

videos.title: Gujarias Eyes
videos.overview: Mircha is infuriated with Elija's failed attempts and it only gets worse. Chameli arrives with her friend, Gujaria and Lallan is having sleepless nights.

videos.title: Widows Rule Over Lallan
videos.overview: Lallan is terrified with Gujaria and feels that Chameli is also helping her. He wishes that Gujaria gets married to Elija.

videos.title: Famous Tailor
videos.overview: Gujaria's unique way astonishes the Lapataganj residents. Elija has suddenly attained a fame and lot of customers arrive at his shop. Gujaria calls Elija for lunch and Chotu also joins in.

videos.title: Prospective Groom
videos.overview: Mircha and Lallan fight over feeding Elija for lunch. Finally, Lallan tells the villagers about Gujaria's reality and that Elija is a government recognised tailor.

videos.title: Quest For New Cycle
videos.overview: Mukundi needs to buy a new cycle but is comptemplating it. Bhagyalaxmi announces that Chukundi got selected in a recitation competition.

videos.title: Chotus Competition
videos.overview: Chukundi is keeping away the change he should return back. Chotu and Chukundi compete on instant rhymes. Pappu plots against Chotu's love story.

videos.title: Chukundi is The Winner
videos.overview: Mukundi is tensed to find money in Chukundi's pocket. Chukundi wins the competition and brings laddoo for his family.

videos.title: Mukundi Questions Chukundi
videos.overview: Chukundi starts sweating when Mukundi asks him what he was doing near the lottery man. Mukundi learns that Chukundi has received a thousand rupees from the minister.

videos.title: Chukundi Blamed For Gambling
videos.overview: Mukundi is so angry that he pushes Chukundi out of the house. The people in Lapataganj are shocked to hear that Chukundi has started gambling.

videos.title: Chotu Mesmerized By Chameli
videos.overview: Chotu Mama is mesmerized after seeing Chameli and soon faints due to the injury on his forehead. Indu shares her wish of visiting Singapore to Mukundi.

videos.title: Indumatis Singapore Dream
videos.overview: Indumati keeps jumping around from here to there in happiness. Chukundi asks the reason for her happiness and she finally breaks the news of her going to Singapore with Mukundi.

videos.title: Pappu's Advice to Chameli
videos.overview: Chameli tries to comfort Mamaji but does not get any response. Instead when Elija comforts him, he readily accepts it. Seeing this, Chameli gets upset and then Pappu gives her the best advice.

videos.title: Lallanji Gets Angry
videos.overview: Chameli does not stop cying. Lallanji comes yelling that Chameli has left him helpless and that he cannot show his face to anyone. He gets upset as Chameli wrote that letter to Mamaji.

videos.title: Chamelis Philosophy Backfired
videos.overview: Chameli's stupid friend, Duniya, asks her to throw the plant again on Mamaji so that he gets his memory back. Everyone starts screaming for applying this philosophy without using brain.

videos.title: Lallan Doubts Chotu
videos.overview: Chotu expresses his feelings to Chameli. Lallan and Pappu bargain on the damage amount. Lallan tells the villagers he has fixed Chameli's marriage.

videos.title: Case On Pandey
videos.overview: Chotu revolts in his original form against Chameli's marriage. Elija and Chotu has to apologise to Lallan for their misdeeds. The doctor gets extremely irritated at Pappu for forging the case.

videos.title: Ration Tension
videos.overview: Indu is tensed and is adamant to suffice the month with the ration. The whole village buys ration in plenty as they find it inexpensive.

videos.title: Indu's Savings
videos.overview: Indu has lunch at Mishri's house and avoids spending too much ration to fulfil her plan of saving money. Mukundi is bored of having brinjals and now wants bitter guard.

videos.title: Indu Helps Elija
videos.overview: Bhagyalaxmi wants to have mango and Indu gets tensed as it is expensive. Indu decides to avoid washing clothes every alternate day. Lallan arrives at their place to have breakfast.

videos.title: Elija is Proud Of Indu
videos.overview: Indu helps Elija when his cousin sister's prospective groom comes to see her. Indu finally opens up about using up all her ration to treat the guests.

videos.title: Letters to Lover
videos.overview: Chameli hates Chotu and so he gets depressed. Gujaria wants to meet and know about Elija's whereabouts. Chotu sends a letter to Chameli and leaves her confused.

videos.title: Gujaria has a Misconception
videos.overview: Chukundi and Bhagyalaxmi teach Indu to speak English. Gujaria forces Elija to write a letter to her mother and Chameli realizes that Elija only wrote the love letter.

videos.title: Gujarias Desire
videos.overview: Gujaria is head over heels for Elija but he doesn't feel the same for her. Suttilal is scared as to Elija is supposed to get married to Rani and informs this to Mukundi.

videos.title: Rani or Gujaria
videos.overview: Elija promises Mukundi that he wants Rani only. Chameli misguides Gujaria telling Elija is the one for her. Elija is terrified of Gujaria's approach.

videos.title: Letter For Chameli
videos.overview: Chameli charges Elija in front of the village enquiring about the love letter. Chotu expresses that the letter was for Chameli from his side, only written by Elija.

videos.title: Letter Trouble
videos.overview: Lallan confronts Elija with the letter, misunderstanding him. Finally, when Lallan hears about the truth behind the letter, he threatens him about the police. Chotu finds the letter but gets scared to see Gujaria.

videos.title: Police At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu enjoys time at Lallan's place at night. Elija is about to get arrested when Chotu asks for evidence, the change of evidence makes the situation even worse.

videos.title: New Threat
videos.overview: Elija's customer, Kallu dada refuses to pay for the clothes and attacks him. The villagers together throw him outside Lapataganj. Tufan Singh, a criminal arrives at the village, searching for Lallan.

videos.title: Slipper Thief
videos.overview: Lallan rescues a person, who apparently is a slipper thief, Tufan Singh. The police announced that he is getting a reward for catching the thief. The villagers stand together for defending Lallan, after hearing his story.

videos.title: Riend In Burqa
videos.overview: Chameli's new friend in burqa, Jamila arrives at Lapataganj. Chotu and Elija try to enquire about her, but somehow Chameli manages. At PWD office, Lallan's colleagues are talking behind his back, when suddenly he emerges.

videos.title: Burqa Confusion
videos.overview: Chotu and Elija inform Lallan that Tufan Singh came to visit him. The duo works out to bash away Tufan but there is a confusion with the burqa and they beat up Lallan in place of Tufan.

videos.title: Abduction
videos.overview: Chotu promises to take care of Chameli when Tufan's letter stuns them all. Lallan is lazy and doesn't want to look for his sister, so Chotu is prepared with a plan.

videos.title: Lallan In a Sack
videos.overview: Chameli runs away from Tufan's capture and Chotu brings the wrong sack to him. Tufan comes to Lapataganj and is upright in front of Lallan.

videos.title: Kachua Found to be Dead
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are shattered after the cops tell them that they have found Kachua's dead body. The clothes and other things found are identified as Kachua's.

videos.title: Kachua is Back
videos.overview: After finishing Kachua's last rites, all the villagers are stunned to see him. He then tells everyone where he had been all the days of being found to be missing.

videos.title: Homeless Kachua
videos.overview: Kachua and his fellow villagers fight for the former's house but to no avail. So, they head to the police station to file a complaints.

videos.title: Dead or Alive
videos.overview: There arises a confusion about who actually own Kachua's house. Kachua then works towards proving that he is Kachua and is alive.

videos.title: Kachua Under Arrest
videos.overview: Kachua is put inside lock up after he attacks a policeman. Kachua finally gets ownership of his house and is proved to be alive.

videos.title: Take It Easy
videos.overview: Seeing Mukundi walk with his bicycle instead of riding it, almost everyone in the village asks him the reason. After telling everyone that one of the tires is punctured, he loses his calm when Chotu asks the same question and starts beating him up.

videos.title: Pappu Misbehaves
videos.overview: Mirza Taiyyab gets furious when Pappu starts praising his daughters. Later, Pappu even misbehaves with Indu which makes Mukundi angry.

videos.title: Thoughtful Indu
videos.overview: Indu points out how Mukundi always gets her clothes, even though his clothes are all worn out. Indu feels that she does not do enough for Mukundi and expresses her wish of doing something great for him.

videos.title: Embarrassed Chotu
videos.overview: Pappu is mesmerized seeing Mirza Taiyaab's daughter's faces for the first time. Chotu mama is embarrassed to step out without a mustache.

videos.title: Indu Gifts Mukundi a Scooter
videos.overview: Indu surprises Mukundi with a scooter which would make his commute to work much easier. When they go out for a ride, the scooter skids and they have a fall.

videos.title: Indu Learns How to Ride a Scooter
videos.overview: Pappu while teaching Indu how to ride a scooter, crashes after he sees Mirza Taiyyab's daughters. After a couple of days, she finally learns how to ride.

videos.title: Pappu's Twin Brother
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are mind blown seeing Pappu's twin brother. Indu starts crying when she learns that the brother sold her scooter.

videos.title: Eijji Scams People
videos.overview: Indu loves Pappu's gesture of collecting money from people to buy her a new scooter, which his brother sold off. Guddu is stunned to find out that it is Eijji Pandey who has been taking money from people and not Pappu.

videos.title: The Real Pappu
videos.overview: When both Pandey brothers claim to be Pappu, Guddu after getting a slap from both of them recognizes who the real one is. Indu is on cloud nine to see her scooter with Mukundi.

videos.title: The Superman
videos.overview: Elija returns to Lapataganj wearing Superman's costume. In his attempt to fly, Elija experiences a fall and hurts himself.

videos.title: Movie Buffs
videos.overview: Eijji buys twenty-five tickets for the Superman movie leaving Guddu muddled. Indu insists Mukundi takes her for the movie and miss work.

videos.title: Eijjis Marketing Skills
videos.overview: All the shows for the Superman movies are house-full and people in Lapataganj are depressed when they don't get a ticket. Enters Eijji, who sells the tickets for a much higher rate than what he bought them for.

videos.title: Movie Time
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj sit and enjoy the Superman movie together. Eijji gets a shock when he realizes that he has held Mirza Taiyyab's hand instead of his daughters.

videos.title: Eijji Becomes Superman
videos.overview: After Silent Baba calls Eijji Superman, lightning strikes him and he disappears. People in Lapataganj are bewildered to see Eijji flying up in the sky.

videos.title: Superman
videos.overview: Eijji becomes the Superman for Lapatagnj people and everyone starts asking for help. Indumati asks him to get groceries for her. Everybody is astonished to see Eijji like this.

videos.title: New Mummy In Lapataganj
videos.overview: A car enters Lapataganj and people are surprised to see it. Three men in a black dress get off the car. The leader is portrayed as mummy by his followers and is unknown to everyone in Lpataganj.

videos.title: Mamaji Jumps Off
videos.overview: Mamaji stands right on the top of the house to jump. He thinks that he is a Superman and he will be able to fly in the air. But he falls off and gets badly hurt.

videos.title: Superman Saves It
videos.overview: The bad people are about to forcefully take away Lapataganj's Hanumanji. But in the nick of time, Superman comes and blocks their way. Watch how superman fights the bad guys and save the idol.

videos.title: Nagging Wife
videos.overview: It is a bright sunny day and Mukundi calls Indumati as he is leaving for the office. But like all other women who nag to their husbands, Indu also starts nagging Mukundi that he does not take her anywhere for holidays.

videos.title: World will End
videos.overview: Mukundi, Indumati, Mishri, Mamaji, and others are sitting glued to the television. They sit to watch the news where they will get to know that the world might come to an end. Will the world come to an end?

videos.title: Mirja Striked With Lightening
videos.overview: It is a stormy night and everyone's headed to home. Suddenly, there is thunder and lightning in the sky and Mirja is striked with the lightening. Sutilaal comes running to save her.

videos.title: Bad News For Mishri
videos.overview: Mamaji comes home crying, Mishri gets tensed as to what could have possibly happened. But he does not stop crying and gathers all the Lapataganj people inside his house. After hearing the news, Mishri's heart breaks and she starts crying.

videos.title: Tribute to Rajesh Khanna
videos.overview: Kachua Chacha gives a tribute to Rajesh Khanna by singing his iconic song. And he makes everyone in Lapataganj sing as well. Everyone melodiously sings his songs and pays tribute in their own way.

videos.title: Pappu's Apology to Mishri
videos.overview: Pappu visits Mishri's house and asks her to accept his apology. He actually feels bad for what he did to her and does not want any grudges before the world ends. He promises to be her child in the next life.

videos.title: The Time has Come
videos.overview: The earth gets divided into two halves in Laptaganj. One set of people on one side and the rest on the other side. Everybody is devastated to see such a scenario and prays for their best. Is it a dream or reality?

videos.title: Brother-sister Relationship
videos.overview: Mishri tells Mamaji that she will accept anything from him only when he gets it with his own hard earned money. Mamaji gets upset as he does not want to work. Mishri makes him understand that it is necessary to get respect from everyone.

videos.title: Mamaji Brings The Good News
videos.overview: Mamaji comes home with a piece of good news that PWD has called him for a job interview. Mishri gets super excited and starts praying for his good health and wealth.

videos.title: Chotu Gets Kicked Out
videos.overview: Mishri beats Chotu mama up because he was kicked out of PWD. Kachua suggests Chotu does something that he loves so that it does not feel like work.

videos.title: Chotu Receives a Big Order
videos.overview: While Suttilal is away, Chotu mama receives a huge order for sweets and savouries. Even though Suttilal disagrees to take the order, Chotu insists he does so, so that he can make some money.

videos.title: Chotu Regrets
videos.overview: Mishri is ashamed of Chotu and asks him to stay away. Mukundi gives Indu a ride around Lapataganj. A collector arrives at Lapataganj, with an emerging hope to solve their problems.

videos.title: Chotu, The Rickshaw Driver
videos.overview: Mukundi urges the collector to have a word with Chotu. The collector convinces Chotu to not drive rickshaw anymore and try other better ways to earn his livelihood.

videos.title: Chotus Bravery
videos.overview: Chotu is severely injured but still successfully carries collector Tripathi to the nearby hospital to save him. Due to this act, Chotu is awarded an amount of ten thousand rupees.

videos.title: Independence Day Celebrations
videos.overview: Mishri does the honour of hoisting the flag. Chukundi questions his father that why the citizens give more importance to the freedom fighters only on Independence Day and not on other days.

videos.title: Indu's Birthday
videos.overview: Missing Indu returns back to Lapataganj after few hours as Mukundi has forgotten her birthday. Two buffalos are additions to her, gifted by her father. But Mukundi gets annoyed with the presence of Phoolbati.

videos.title: Cunning Kallu
videos.overview: Phoolbati is the new milk supplier in Lapataganj as the whole village gets enthralled to see her. Mircha is in dilemma with Indu's decision as Suttilal's business is running in loss.

videos.title: Eid In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi wakes up his children early on Eid and shouts at Indu for being obsessed with Phoolbati. Pappu's flirting has reached new heights.

videos.title: Mukundi's Nightmare
videos.overview: Parmanand Pandit assures Mukundi and Indu that he will sort out their disputes. But their problems only get worse so Indu shifts to Lalganj, forever.

videos.title: Indu Leaves The House
videos.overview: Kallu is happy after learning about Indu and Mukundi's fight. Mishri calls Indu's parents house and asks her to come back but Indu refuses.

videos.title: Kallus Truth is Out
videos.overview: Eijji brings Kallu's truth in front of everyone which makes everyone angry. The reason behind Indu and Mukundi's fight comes out and Indu returns to Lapataganj.

videos.title: Indu Chases Mukundi
videos.overview: Soon after coming back to Lapataganj, Indu chases Mukundi with a wooden stick, thinking Mukundi is getting remarried. All the villagers plan to get Indu and Mukundi married once again.

videos.title: Mukundi to Marry Indu Again
videos.overview: Mukundi agrees to get married to Indu once again. Everyone in Lapataganj starts preparing for the couple's big day.

videos.title: The Big Day
videos.overview: After a lot of convincing, Mukundi's father agrees for Mukundi and Indu's remarriage. The couple dresses up for their big day, helped by their friends.

videos.title: Mukundi Dying to Meet Indu
videos.overview: Mukundi wakes up with a dream where he has already married Indu. He starts missing her and tries his best to see her, but Mishri does not let him.

videos.title: Eijji's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Eager to see Indu, Eijji suggests Mukundi bursts a bomb in Mishri's house. The plan backfires as the bomb hurts Chotu mama and makes Mishri extremely angry.

videos.title: Mukundi Disguises As a Salesman
videos.overview: When two people selling bangles ask for Mishri's address, Eijji and Mukundi take up their look so that Mukundi gets to see Indu.

videos.title: Bindu Tries to Help Mukundi
videos.overview: Mishri and other villagers are angry seeing Mukundi's disguise to see Indu. Bindu tells Mukundi that she can help him meet Indu but she puts forth a condition.

videos.title: Chotu is Against The Wedding
videos.overview: Mukundi's boss, after seeing his work, talks about his promotion. Chotu mama tells Elija that he will not let this wedding happen as Eijji has challenged him.

videos.title: Ladies Sangeet
videos.overview: The celebrations begin by Ladies Sangeet where all the women sing and dance with joy. Seeing Guddu and Eijji at the celebration, the ladies are furious and start beating them up.

videos.title: Haldi Ceremony
videos.overview: While praying in front of God, Indu and Mukundi talk about how close the distance has brought them. Later in the day, Mukundi has his haldi ceremony.

videos.title: Chotu Tries to Stop The Wedding
videos.overview: Amidst all the celebrations, the Women's Commission intervenes and defame Mukundi for getting married for the second time. People in Lapataganj later find out that the confusion was deliberately created by Chotu mama.

videos.title: Indu Weds Mukundi
videos.overview: After all the hustle, Mukundi finally gets to see his bride all dolled up for him. They are extremely happy and recreate their wedding vows all over again.

videos.title: Just Married
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj sing and dance to entertain the newlyweds. Later, Mukundi gets romantic with Indu on their first night but their children wish to sleep with them.

videos.title: Lallan has a Fall
videos.overview: Lallan trips and falls while running behind Mukundi, asking him for a lift. Bindu complains to Indu about the same.

videos.title: Lallan Buys a Car
videos.overview: Lallan becomes a laughing stock as he wears a rodent red coat. He then goes to buy a second-hand car accompanying Eijji.

videos.title: Super Excited Villagers
videos.overview: Bindu and other villagers are super excited to see Lallan with a car. People laugh at him when they see him push the car the next day.

videos.title: Lallan Chains His Car
videos.overview: Lallan is so paranoid after seeing a man trying to steal his car, he locks his car using chains. In the morning, he asks people to help him push the car so that it starts.

videos.title: A Corpse In The Car
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are taken aback when Mishri tells them that Lallan's car has a corpse in the back seat. They immediately inform the cops who come to investigate the case.

videos.title: Lallan Behind The Bars
videos.overview: Lallan is put behind bars in the charge for having kept a dead body in his car. Bindu cries her eyes out when the cops refuse to bail him out.

videos.title: Car Thief
videos.overview: Eijji and Guddu, along with the villagers, catch hold of Panna Boss trying to steal Lallan's car and the diamond. The police intervenes at the right time to help the villagers.

videos.title: Indu's Decision
videos.overview: The villagers are perplexed at Indu's decision of standing as the Village Chief against Bahadur Singh. Mukundi is shocked to see the villagers support Indu in her decision.

videos.title: Speech By Indu
videos.overview: Bahadur Singh is tensed with his opponent in the election. Sugandhi tells Chukundi to write down a speech for Indu, and Salima helps Indu to prepare her speech. Indu messes up the speech, so she speaks out of her heart.

videos.title: For Indu
videos.overview: Mukundi is against Indu and lashes out at her but Sugandhi comes to rescue. The minister gets Mukundi's change of posting sanctioned, while Lapataganj is eagerly waiting to vote for Indu.

videos.title: Minister's Teacher
videos.overview: Indu's opponent tries to instigate Chotu against Indu by luring him. Mukundi avoids Indu after her big decision and tries to explain her about the dirty politics. Sugandhi's efforts to cancel Mukundi's transport brings colours.

videos.title: Indu V/s Chotu
videos.overview: Indu's supporters stand up for her, which is evidently more than Chotu's. Bahadur Singh plots to use bribe and bitter gourd as their means to win the election.

videos.title: Elections At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Indu is demeaned by Bahadur Singh, as he tries to get her in trouble and accuses Mukundi of black money. Still, Lapataganj supports them and Indu comes out with flying colours.

videos.title: Indu, The New Chief
videos.overview: Indu wins the election against Bahadur Singh. Chotu gets zero votes, as he votes for Indu. Lapataganj is overjoyed in celebrating Indu's win. Mishri struggles to read the letter sent by her husband.

videos.title: Haunted School
videos.overview: Mircha and Suttilal fight over payment, so Elija and Mishri intervene. Mishri wants to open the Gandhi Vidyalaya, but a stranger warns them about the place. The villagers gather to find out the mystery of this place.

videos.title: Behind The Doors
videos.overview: After Gandhi Vidyalaya's door open, two villagers try to go inside the place at night and get thrown away by a wave of energy. Mishri attempts to find out and gets herself into trouble.

videos.title: Mishri's Change Of Fate
videos.overview: Vivek, the lawyer arrives to inform Lallan that he cannot expand his place. Mishri saves Lallan from his crisis and the villagers are in shock with her transformation. Chotu tries to find out about Mishri and gets attacked by her.

videos.title: Bhavani Shankar's Ghost
videos.overview: Rajjo tells the villagers about the ghost who wanted to get everyone educated. The villagers finally understand that Mishri is possessed. The villagers start studying in front of Mishri and soon enough the goons arrive in search of the sacks.

videos.title: Chota Babbar In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chota Babbar interrogates the villagers about the sacks. Elija also gets possessed and teach the goons a good lesson. The villagers start getting scared of each other.

videos.title: Right to Education
videos.overview: Mukundi thinks Indu is possessed when she triess teaching her children. Lallan is clueless with the ghosts and cannot sleep. Chotu sells talisman to the villagers which Mukundi opposes and Indu promises to make Bhavanis unfulfilled wishes come true.

videos.title: Kachuas New Trend
videos.overview: Finally, there is a teacher for Gandhi Vidyalaya and it will reopen. The goons try to flame up the school but Bhavanis ghost prevents them. The villagers get prepared for school and their new teacher astonishes them.

videos.title: Dacoits At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chotu tries to scheme Suttilal but they catch him red-handed, so he tells them a story about a dacoit, Jalim Singh. The arrival of the dacoits leaves the villagers in a trauma.

videos.title: Chotu Becomes a Dacoit
videos.overview: Chotu confronts the chief dacoit, Kroor Singh. Mishri breaks down when the dacoits take Chotu along with them, presuming his origin is from their same clan. The villagers file a report but there is still no hope.

videos.title: Mirchas Love For Suttilal
videos.overview: Mishri's dream of Chotu as a dacoit keeps haunting her. When the dacoits come to take Suttilal, Mircha attacks them so the daciots carry them both back to their den.

videos.title: Confectioner In Demand
videos.overview: Mircha and Suttilal prepare food for the dacoits but to their horror all food gets vanished as Mircha has all of the food. The police are unable to get them back and the dacoit chief gets irritated with Mircha.

videos.title: The Spy In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mirza is shocked to know Guddu's awareness. The villagers bash up Suttilal assuming him as dacoit. Suttilal acts as a middle man to inform the dacoits and they soon arrive at Mukundi's post office.

videos.title: Curse The Spy
videos.overview: The villagers curse the spy, as the dacoits have all the information about Lapataganj now. Mircha keeps the dacoits in control with her violence. Lapataganj residents get ready to attack the dacoits as they have had enough.

videos.title: Failed Attempts
videos.overview: The dacoits arrive and the villagers fail to stop them. Suttilal almost expresses that he is the spy. The dacoits attack PWD office and take Chaurasia from Lapataganj.

videos.title: Against Spy
videos.overview: Chotu strangles Suttilal while comparing him as the spy. Lallan is devated after the dacoits loot him. The villagers get busy to find out the spy.

videos.title: Suttilal Gets Caught
videos.overview: Elija plan to feed and get the dacoits unconcious fails miserably when Kachua has the food in their place. Mukundi realises that Suttilal calls Kroor Singh.

videos.title: Confronts Suttilal
videos.overview: Suttilal reveals that he has done it all for Mircha's safety. Suttilal with the help of the villagers places bait for Kroor Singh to have Mircha back. The dacoits get to see the women power of Lapataganj but there is a twist in the story.

videos.title: Women Empowerment
videos.overview: Elija plans to feed something and make the dacoits unconscious, but fails miserably when Kachua has the food in their place. Mukundi realizes that Suttilal calls Kroor Singh.

videos.title: Chotu's Chameli
videos.overview: Chotu wants to get married to Chameli and expresses that to Mishri. Bindu pesters Lallan to think about Chameli's marriage. Finally, Chotu proposes Chameli.

videos.title: Drama Of Love
videos.overview: Chameli accepts to marry Chotu when he falls unconcious. Lallan is still not sure about their relationship and opposes their marriage.

videos.title: Stuborn Lallan
videos.overview: Chameli is heartbroken and tells Mishri about Lallans decision. Chotu requests Mukundi to convince Lallan along with Mishri. Lallan is determined so Chotu comes in front of a bike.

videos.title: Court Marriage
videos.overview: Chotu makes Chameli sign the registry papers to go against Lallan. Its Pudinas birthday, Lapataganj celebrates his birthday when Chotu discusses his love for Chameli in front of Lallan.

videos.title: Chotu V/s Lallan
videos.overview: Chotu and Lallan curse each other as they plot to ruin each others plan. Chameli is stuck as Lallan isnt leaving for office, Chotus plan fail one after another.

videos.title: Mircha Comes to Save
videos.overview: Chotu seeks help from Mircha so she teams up with Elija to save Chameli from Lallan patroling. Lallan somehow manages to find out Elija's pretense.

videos.title: Chameli has to Make a Choice
videos.overview: Lallan rushes outside to find Chameli and stop her from marrying Chotu. Lallan threatens the couple that he will commit suicide.

videos.title: Lovers In Pain
videos.overview: Chotu refrains from intaking any food, and only drinks black tea in an alcohol bottle. Chameli drinks the poison that Lallan was about to and realizes it is honey. Chotu and Chameli are about to get married when Mini-Chotu visits Lapataganj.

videos.title: New Kid In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Lambodar Prasad a.k.a. Tilu comes to tell that he is Chotu's son and Chameli is devasted to see him. Mishri is excited to see her nephew in Lapataganj. Chukundi and Bhagyalaxmi befriend Tilu as he feels lonely.

videos.title: Chotu Loves His Son
videos.overview: Tilu plans to reunite his father with Chameli and targets to pester Chameli in various ways. Tilu befriends Chameli gradually and Chotu is excited to see them.

videos.title: Tilus Try
videos.overview: Chotu is sad on hearing the news of Chamelis wedding so Tilu pretends to read her hand to bring the estranged couple close again. But Chameli still avoids talking to Chotu.

videos.title: Chameli On a Date
videos.overview: Chameli goes for a movie where Lallan accompanies her, Tilu and Chotu also join them. Two strange fellows try to molest her and Chotu retaliates.

videos.title: Chotu and Chameli
videos.overview: Tilu's plan fails but he finally speaks out the truth. Chotu and Tilu are about to leave Lapataganj, but on everyone's request, Lallan makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: Brother-sister Day
videos.overview: Lallan visits Chameli to celebrate this togetherness of siblings. Bhagyalaxmi celebrates the day with Chukundi and Tilu. Chukundi gets bullied at the school and follows Tilu's suggestion.

videos.title: Chukundi's Expulsion
videos.overview: Golu loses the challenge he put forward to Chukundi. Police arrive at school to investigate who broke the lock and Golu starts blackmailing Chukundi.

videos.title: Golu's Blackmailing
videos.overview: Chukundi requests Chameli to prepare halwa for Golu. But, Golu starts demanding more. So, Chukundi decides to tell everything to Mukundi.

videos.title: Tilu Wants to Study
videos.overview: Tilu pesters his father to get him admitted to a school. Golu and Chunnu-Munnu get punished for the same homework. Golu orders Chukundi to get a shirt for him and Chukundi requests Elija to help him out.

videos.title: Chukundi's New Classmate
videos.overview: Chotu gives a treat to the villagers for Tilu joining the school. Chukundi is stuck as Golu and Chunnu-Munnu increase their demand on knowing that Mukundi will get a reward.

videos.title: Golu Gets Exposed
videos.overview: Chukundi's teacher loses his money so there is a search conducted at the classroom, revealing all the antics of Golu. Mukundi returns back home early with his reward and goes to Chukundi's school.

videos.title: Chotu Goes Missing
videos.overview: Mukundi struggles to manage the household chores and balances it well with office work. Indu is back and excited to see her husband and son get prizes. Chotu is missing since the morning and so Mishri loses her cool.

videos.title: Chotu In News
videos.overview: The voxpop says Chotu challenged Tinku, the thief to come to Lapataganj. Tinku, simultaneously accepts his challenge and arrives at Lapataganj. Alongside, Mishri, the constable also visits at the same time, and takes the information about the villagers.

videos.title: Tinkus First Failure
videos.overview: Lallan shares safety tips with his neighbours as he still fears the threat from Tinku. Mishra, on the other hand takes measurement of Lallans house. Tilu starts doubting Mishras behaviour.

videos.title: Robbery At Elija's
videos.overview: Tinkus robbery attempt fails at Lallans and Chotus place. Indu calls for an assembly to discuss about and gather money for Ruksanas ailment. Tinku steals the full cash amount at Elija's place.

videos.title: Tinku Mishra
