videos.overview: Chotu shows the villagers a jackpot that is Tinku lying unconscious at Gandhi Vidyalaya. Mishra constable is actually Tinku thief. Chotu reveals he could catch Tinku only with Tilu's help.

videos.title: Bindu's Calling
videos.overview: The men at Lapataganj are elated to know that their wives are going for a pilgrim tour. Mukundi is upset and doesn't want Indu to go. Chotu pesters Mishri for extra money. Inspector Devidas Singh enters, who is an ardent follower of the Goddess, and a feminist.

videos.title: Dancer At Lapataganj
videos.overview: Guddus friend, Bhimsen, Nautanki wale arrives at Lapataganj. The villagers convince Lallan to pay him and pursue Mukundi to attend the function. Devidas hears about the dancer and decides to take an action against Lapataganj.

videos.title: Misson : Women
videos.overview: Chotu asks help from Lallan as Inspector Devidas tries to intervene in their village function. Suttilal asks Elija to dress up as a woman once again. Lallan pretends to be a woman for saving all the men of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Women Of Lapataganj
videos.overview: The new Daroga appointed catches men disguised as women of Lapataganj in their absence and gives an ultimatum of 2 days to get the women back. Mamaji and his son manage to get samosa in the absence of women in town.

videos.title: Men In Trouble
videos.overview: Mukundi and all the men of Lapataganj try to reach their wives and women who are out of town. Suttilal has a scary dream of getting beaten up by the Daroga and other policemen as the ultimatum gets closer.

videos.title: Women Back In Town
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj are about to leave the village as the Daroga comes in time to stop them from running away from him and to arrest them. Kachua chacha manages to get the women back and rescue the men of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Moustache, Pride Of Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi's coleague Mishra ji gets praised for his looks before he gets his moustache shaved and made is fun of. Meanwhile Suttilals mausaji comes in town for a visit and is angry over people without a moustache.

videos.title: Fake Moustaches In Lapataganj
videos.overview: To impress his Mausaji Suttilal gets a fake moustache for himself. Tilu gets a fake moustache too and as a prank puts it on her buaji who unknowingly roams around in the village before being caught and so does Suttilal.

videos.title: Moustaches In Trouble
videos.overview: Pudina chacha decides to solve the moustache problem by taking off mausaji's moustache using a prank. Mukundi plays hide and seek with his children. Mausaji's old enemy visits Lapataganj and as revenge wants to shave the moustaches of everyone present in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Indumati Saves The Village
videos.overview: Suttilal tries to save Mausaji from the enemies and Indumati arrives inbetween to save Sutilal from the beating and helps save the village. Mukundi has a strange issue where his left eye doesnst stop blinking which is a sign of something bad coming his way.

videos.title: Bad Time For Mukundi
videos.overview: Mukundi is troubled by the fact that his salary is gonna arrive a month late. Elija lost a needle and goes to Mukundi for help. Mamaji's wife is back after a long time and is upset that she was away for a long time.

videos.title: Elija's Gift to Mukundi
videos.overview: Elija feels bad that Mukundi burnt his hands because of him so he decides to get him a present which makes everyone excited. Suttilal finds all his samosas to be bitten from the top and Mamaji decides to act as a detective and solve the crime.

videos.title: Mamaji Caught As Spy
videos.overview: Mamaji decides to get a cooker for himself and Kachua chacha advises him to get one with an ISI mark and writes it on his arm. The Commissioner gives the Daroga info that a spy from ISI has entered the village, and they catch Mamaji instead.

videos.title: Policemen Get Punished
videos.overview: The policemen try to punish the captured Mamaji which goes wrong and end up hurting themselves. Mukundi, Kachua chacha, and Elija go to the same police station in search of Mamaji and find him.

videos.title: Mamaji and Lallan Fight
videos.overview: Mamaji and Lallan have a fight and are upset with each other, so mamaji stops talking to other people as well. Indumati and co decide to end this fight and take several measures.

videos.title: Mamaji, Jijaji Friends Again
videos.overview: Indumati and Bindumati decide to haunt Mamaji and Jijaji with scary stories to resolve their fight. Indumati dresses as a witch and scares both of them off and asks them to stop fighting and come back together.

videos.title: Makundi Teaches His Chilldren
videos.overview: Makundi and Indumati teach their children how to write a letter and recieve one at their home from their children. Mamaji is mad at mausiji that she didn't bring Chameli along with her and Tilu.

videos.title: Biji Bhaiya is Back
videos.overview: Indumati and Bindumati compete  over who has the better curtains and fight over about whose place is Chachiji going to stay over. Biji bhaiya comes to the Lapatagnj after a very long time.

videos.title: Indu and Bindu Compete
videos.overview: Indumati and Bindumati compete again and get sofa sets for their places for whose is better. Tilu hears Biju bhaiya and blackmails him about telling Buaji everything.

videos.title: Bijji Pandey is Rich
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey astonishes every one at the tea stall with his behaviour. He uses a hundred rupee note to hold the hot cup of tea at Suthilals shop and walks away after a show stunt. Mukundi on the other hand is tensed about money. Bijji pandey trains Indumati and Bindumati to carry western clothes and walk in heels, in the Mumbai style. The villagers are surprised looking at them flaunt their new style.

videos.title: Where will Sudha Chachi Stay?
videos.overview: Indumati and Bindumati are in competition to welcome Sudha Chachi to their respective homes. They push their husbands out of their homes so they get used to sleeping outside, while Sudha Chachi stays at home. Mausi tries to make Indumati understand that she need not fight with her sister. Indumati plans to get a dress stitched for Chachi and so does Bindumati. Busy Pandey creates confusion by pitching in details to both of them.

videos.title: Indumati Loves Bindumati
videos.overview: Sudha Chachi arrives and everyone gathers around to welcome her. Indumati and Bindumati fight yet again to keep her in their homes. Mukundi explains the reason of the fight to Sudha Chachi. Sudha Chachi reminds them of their childhood days and of the love they had for each other. The two sisters felt sorry for being envious of each other and hugged each other with love.

videos.title: Shiek Visits Suthilals Shop
videos.overview: Busy Pandey fools Suthilal and eats everything he has prepared in the shop. While the villagers are going to punish him, his twin brother, Eji Pandey arrives in the village and tells them that he will teach them to celebrate New Years' in the city-style. The very next day, a gang of his friends reaches Lapataganj to celebrate their New Year.

videos.title: New Year Party At Lapataganj
videos.overview: The villagers are excited for the modern New Year party. They get new clothes stichted and are in prep to look the best for the New Year party. Indumati also presents a jean to Mausi for the New Year which she refuses to take and returns it back.

videos.title: Rocks New Year Eve
videos.overview: Villagers gather along dressed for the party, dance on bollywood numbers and welcome the New Year. The gang of boys then decide to leave for Kanpur post mid night, they are warned by mausi to grab some rest. The next morning the gang returns in an ambulance with a cop after meeting with an accident.

videos.title: Party Boys Meet With an Accident
videos.overview: The villagers make the boys promise to be responsible for celebrating any occasion. Mukundi comes back home but decides to leave again. While Indumati is reminded that the water at home is over. Indumati and Bindumati are worried about the scarcity of drinking water.

videos.title: Furious Elija
videos.overview: The scarcity of water troubles everyone at the village. Elija looses his cool and takes a brick in hand to break the local tap. The villagers try to stop him. Suddenly, there is electricity and water supply in the village. Indumati questions the incident and party elect arrives to inform the villager that the party head is planning to visit Lapataganj.

videos.title: Ministers Visit to Lapataganj
videos.overview: The minister arrives to discuss the issues faced by the vilagers. Mukundi warns Indumati to not attend the discussion and to stay away from politics and politicians. She is furious about not being able to attend the discussion.

videos.title: The Corrupt Politicians
videos.overview: The politicians fight among themselves and create a chaos. Suthilal and his wife make many sweets and present it to the party, hoping to earn out of the discussion programme. Though the politicians lie about providing a payment and show them out.

videos.title: Innocent Public is Fooled
videos.overview: The politicians are not interested in discussion or resolving any issues. The spend time lazing around and so a dancer is called to entertain and motivate them. The politicians enjoy the dancers performance in the tent while the villagers are fooled with an audio played of a political speech outside the tent.

videos.title: Common Man Strives For a Good Life
videos.overview: The politicians create a chaos in the village and leave. The power and water supply too are disconnected as the politicians leave from the village. The villagers decide to live happily anyway with the light of their love and affcetion for each other. The serial signs off talking about the ironic life of a common man.

videos.title: Chameli Runs Away From Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi and other villagers wake up in the morning to fill water when they see Mamaji bathing under the tap. Elections are about to take place in Lapataganj. Sureeli finds a note from Chameli quoting that she ran away with Radhesham out of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Mataji Visits Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mataji who is a political candidate visits Lapataganj to listen to the problems faced by the villagers. Many problems like scarcity of water and electricity are expressed by the villagers to Mataji. Kachchua chacha gives a whole speech on how politicians make fake promises and leave the villagers hanging in the middle only for votes.

videos.title: Lapataganj Celebrates Patni Diwas
videos.overview: Elija clicks a picture of Suttilal and Mircha who celebrate Patni diwas. Mamaji goes searching for Chameli and ends up beating a guy thinking about Chameli. Mukundi and Indumati have a fight and she warns of calling her mom at her place to stay.

videos.title: Mamaji Gets Pranked
videos.overview: Mukundi is still upset from Indumati and goes to work without lunch. Bijji Pandey pranks Mamaji by giving him a soap which causes itching with the motive to meet Sureeli.

videos.title: Indumati Throws Mukundilal Out
videos.overview: Mukundilal sleeps on the bed and Indumati insists him to sleep on the floor. When Mukundilal doesn't agree with her she throws him out of the house.

videos.title: Kacchua Irritated With The Mobile Phones
videos.overview: Kacchua Chacha is irritated with everyone in Lapataganj because of their phone addiction. He tries to talk to many of them but fails to catch their attention as they lost on their phones.

videos.title: Kacchua Meets With an Accident
videos.overview: Kacchua meets with an accident and is taken to the hospital. There is nobody to attend him or take him home. Indu reaches the hospital and gets emotional about the busy lives of people.

videos.title: Mukundilal Visits Kacchua Chacha
videos.overview: Indu is upset and shouts at everyone about their ignorance. Mukundilal visits Kacchua Chacha at the hospital and is still busy over the phone.

videos.title: Kacchua Runs Away From The Hospital
videos.overview: Kacchua is tired of telling each of his visitors the story. Mishri too decides to visit him, he gets frustrated of narrating his tale and chooses to run away from the hospital.

videos.title: Rainy Season Knocks Lapataganjs Door
videos.overview: In this episode, Bablu is trying to explain Dablu that what are the benefits of the rainy season. Meanwhile, in Lapataganj people are not aware that rainy season can be a big problem for them.

videos.title: Mukundilal Becomes a Postman
videos.overview: Mukundilala read the letter in front of Lapataganj's people, what is in the letter, who is visiting Lapataganj's this time. Who is the special guest?

videos.title: Babuji is Alive
videos.overview: Lallan forgets to pick her wife Bindumati from the railway station and when she reached Lapataganj, she throws him out of the house.

videos.title: Mama and Lallan Get Punished
videos.overview: Babuji gives punishment to Chotu mama and Lallan for throwing a stone at him.

videos.title: Babuji's Birthday Celebration
videos.overview: Lapataganj is going to celebrate Babuji's birthday for the first time. But why Babuji doesn't want to celebrate his birthday?

videos.title: Babuji Gets Angry On His Birthday
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj threw a surprise birthday party for Babuji, but Babuji was not happy at all. What is the reason behind Babuji's anger?

videos.title: Chukku and Dolly
videos.overview: People in the town start noticing Chukku and Dolly looking at each other. They talk about how fast kids are these days. Elija tries to baby Chukku in front of Dolly. Chukku tries to go to Dolly's shop but his mother stops him. How will Chukku approach Dolly?

videos.title: Chukku Approaches Dolly
videos.overview: Chukku approaches Dolly and gets slapped. He thinks of ways to tell dolly how he feels. Pandeyji dances with Surili and ends up getting beaten by her mother. Chukku draws a heart in his book and was about to be caught by Mukundilal.

videos.title: Chukku and Dolly's Love Story
videos.overview: Chukku buys snacks from Dolly's shop often without paying to see her. Chukku takes Mukundilal's scooter without asking and takes Dolly and Tilu for a ride. Mukundilal finds out and scolds Chukku.

videos.title: Everything is Revealed
videos.overview: Dolly's father tells Mukundilal that Chukku comes to the shop often and buys things from the shop in order to see Dolly. Mukundilal tries to discipline Chukku but the people of Lapataganj defend him. Pandeyji reads out the love letters he wrote to Surili 9 years ago.

videos.title: Chukku Writes a Love Letter
videos.overview: Chukku struggles to write a love letter for Dolly. Mukundi teaches him to write a letter on mother, he replaces the word mother to Dolly in the letter. However, he fails to give it to her.

videos.title: Chukku Gets Caught
videos.overview: Mukundilal sees Chukku's love letter and says that it looks like its written by a doctor. Mukundilal reads out Chukku's letter in front of everyone. Dolly likes it a lot. Chukku is scared and hiding. Everyone looks for him.

videos.title: Suttilal's Good News
videos.overview: Suttilal, Mircha, and Pudilal visit Mukundilal to share the good news. Everyone gathers around to listen to what Suttilal has to say. What can be the news?

videos.title: Suttilal's New Shop
videos.overview: Suttilal opens a samosa shop. Everyone comes to bless him. Babuji visits Suttilal's new shop. Just when everyone is celebrating happiness, someone new enters. Who is this new guest?

videos.title: Suttilal has a Rival
videos.overview: Gappu Singh opens a fast food shop near Suttilal's shop. It's a rainy day. Everyone comes to check out his shop. Gappu Singh bribes Mamaji with free food. But instead, Mamaji invites everyone else over to have free food.

videos.title: Suttilal Becomes a Vendor
videos.overview: Suttilal becomes a vegetable vendor. Mukundilal and the others feel bad for him. Gappu Singh makes fun of Suttilal's condition. Pandey visits Gappu Singh's shop and gets money in order to leave the business.

videos.title: Clash Between The Shop Owners
videos.overview: Business is slow in Suttilal's shop so they use different techniques to improve the business. Elija drinks tea from Suttilal's shop and finds a fly in the tea. Will the business grow in the new shop?

videos.title: The Brawl Between Suttilal and The Gang Leader
videos.overview: Gappu Singh and Suttilal start brawling, as everyone gathers around them. Pappu intervenes and makes a scene. Gappu Singh bribes Pandeyji with money again.

videos.title: The Closed Shop
videos.overview: Suttilal's shop is closed. Some people feel bad for Suttilal and decide not to eat in the new shop. Pandey visits the new shop multiple times and collects money.

videos.title: Showdown Between The Shop Owners
videos.overview: Gappu Singh and Suttilal start fighting in front of the whole village. Mukundilal intervenes in order to settle the fight. Pandeyji arrives and Gappu Singh bribes him again. Will Mukundilal be able to stop them?

videos.title: Pandeyji's Kind Gesture
videos.overview: Pandeyji lends money to Suttilal to reopen his shop. Suttilal and a few others search for the lost money in the ground. Chukku asks for money from Mukundilal but he denies. Chukku keeps pleading to him. Will Mukundi give him the money?

videos.title: Lapataganj Needs a Doctor
videos.overview: Mircha calls everyone to look at Suttilal's smoked face. Mukundi and others gather around to sort the problem. Pandey tries to lure Sureeli out of her house and ends up getting caught. Mukundi decides to meet Mantriji.

videos.title: The Hunt For Rats
videos.overview: Mantriji comes up with a scheme and tells the people of Lapataganj to catch all the rats and in exchange get 50rs for each rat. Everyone starts hunting for rats. The fight starts to earn more money.

videos.title: Pandey's Attempt to Meet Sureeli
videos.overview: Pandey asks Tilu about who is there in Sureeli's house. He then asks money from Chukku, he denies it as he does not have any. Pappu Pandey then fools Pudina and steals sweets from Suttilal's shop for Sureeli.

videos.title: Cash In Storage Room
videos.overview: Mamaji eats from Suttilal's shop and refuses to pay. But Mamaji left his bag in his shop and now Mircha has it. Mamaji tries hard to get back his bag, so he breaks into the storage and steals rations. Mamaji and Elija make a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Catching The Culprit
videos.overview: Mamaji and Elija find cash in the ration and inform Mukundi. Mantriji comes to the village with his wife. Mukundilal and others gather around and reveal the cash hidden in the storage shop. They confront Mantriji and capture everything on camera.

videos.title: Bindumati's New Look
videos.overview: Romance is in the air for all the villagers. Bindumati gets romantic and also changes her look. Lallanji gets surprised to see Bindu's new look. Lallanji gets scared and asks her to be normal.

videos.title: I Love You
videos.overview: Mishri gets a letter from someone. It's a rainy day and Lallanji gets beaten by the ladies of Lapataganj, and swears not to say the words I LOVE YOU to anyone. Bindumati takes care of his wounds.

videos.title: Lallanji In Search Of True Love
videos.overview: Indu, Mishri, and Mircha reveal to Lallanji that they don't love him anymore. All the females residing in Lapataganj get angry with Lallanji and some of them rush to beat him too. How will he solve this problem?

videos.title: Villagers Propose Lallanji
videos.overview: Not only Chaurasiya but all the villagers of Lapataganj are proposing to Lallanji, but this apparently does not go down too well with him and he gets confused. Lallanji receives flowers from all the female members of Lapataganj. Will Mukundi solve Lallan's problem?

videos.title: Lallanji On Everone's Watchlist
videos.overview: Bindumati gets a huge shock as Mamaji proposes Bindumati on behalf of Lallanji but this apparently does not go down well either. Bindu decides to leave Lapataganj and Lallanji.

videos.title: Lallanji Proposes to Bindumati
videos.overview: Lallanji proposes to Bindumati and all the villagers of Lapataganj are trying to persuade Bindumati and also explain to her that Lallanji immensely loves her. Just when Bindumati was about to leave Lapataganj, Lallanji says loving words.

videos.title: What You Sow So shall You Reap
videos.overview: Baba Hawaijahaj reveals to Mama that if he works hard, he will get rewards for the same but Mama fails to understand. Mama tries to help all the villagers so that he can get heavy rewards. Will this be helpful for Mama?

videos.title: Mukundi Gets Scared Of Mamaji
videos.overview: Villagers of Lapataganj get a huge shock as they come to know about Mama, so they decide to pay him the last visit. Panic occurs in Lapataganj as they see Mama alive. Why is Mukundi scared of Mama?

videos.title: Bansi Chacha Shares His Painful Journey
videos.overview: Mama could not bear Bansi Chacha's pain so he firmly decides to help him out. Chukundi and Bhagyalakshmi try to cheer up Bansi Chacha as he was extremely upset. Will Bansi Chacha share his painful journey with Mukundi and Indumati?

videos.title: Bansi Chacha and Elija Faints
videos.overview: Mukundi urgently calls doctor Tripathy as Bansi Chacha faints and also takes a look at the letter which Mama finds in his pocket. Major trouble takes place as Eilja faints too. Who will take responsibility for these two?

videos.title: Bansi Chacha Falls
videos.overview: Bansi Chacha falls ill and Mama gets upset. Mama succeeds in persuading villagers to donate money for Bansi Chacha's operation. What will be the villagers' final decision and will they agree to it?

videos.title: Mama Collects Funds
videos.overview: After lots of hard work, Mama finally succeeds in collecting money for Bansi Chacha but he has some other plans. Will Bansi Chacha take all the money and escape from Lapataganj?

videos.title: Bansi Chacha Feels Guilty
videos.overview: All the villagers of Lapataganj get a huge shock as they come to know that Bansi Chacha escaped with all their money. There in the hospital, Bansi Chacha feels guilty. Will Mama forgive him for what Bansi Chacha did?

videos.title: Eijji Pandey Offers a Lift to Misri
videos.overview: Biji ka Pran-Babloo & Dabloo deliberate over the concept of izzat or respect. Eijji Pandey offers a lift to Misri Mausi on his bike, Katrina, but the villagers think that he has arrested her. When the confusion is over and done with, Misri Mausi invites Eijji over to dinner, which does not go down well with Biji as he has already had a bad day. What happens next?

videos.title: Biji Gets Romantic With Surili
videos.overview: Biji is extremely excited to watch a movie with Surili and also gets romantic with her. Indumati fumes in anger and also reveals to Easy that she saw him with Surili. Will Easy reveal the truth to Indumati and Biji?

videos.title: Biji Challenges Ejji
videos.overview: Lapataganj villagers are extremely upset with Biji and also decide to avoid him. Biji challenges Easy. Will Biji succeed in proving his point?

videos.title: Biji and Guddu are Seeking For Cases
videos.overview: Biji and Guddu firmly decide to work but both of them get a huge shock as they see the scene outside the office. Will Biji get work? What has destiny planned for Biji's future?

videos.title: Biji Earns Rs 10,000
videos.overview: Biji gives the wrong statement in the court and earns Rs. 10,000 for Surili. Will Surili accept Biji's money? What will be Biji's next step?

videos.title: Ishwarchand Challenges Biji Pandey
videos.overview: Biji reveals to his lawyer colleagues that he has agreed to fight Ganeshi's case. Ishwarchand challenges Biji Pandey in the court. Will Ganeshi be proven innocent or guilty? Who will win the case?

videos.title: Eijji Pandey's Final Warning
videos.overview: Judge sends Ganeshi for 2 days in police remand. Inspector Easy Pandey gives a final warning to Ganeshi and also insists him to reveal the truth. What will be the Judge's final verdict? Will Biji find out the truth?

videos.title: Inspector Eijji Pandey Slaps Laxmi Seth
videos.overview: Biji fights with goons in Lapataganj. Elija, Mama, and Suttilal become constables and visit Kanta Prasad's haveli to prove Ganeshi innocent. Will Elija, Mama, and Suttilal succeed in collecting evidence against Kanta?

videos.title: Grand Welcome Of Lawyer Biji Pandey
videos.overview: Seth Laxmi Narayan reveals a shocking truth in the court. Kanta Prasad sends goons to teach a lesson to Biji for fighting a case against him. Easy Pandey saves his brother, Biji Pandey. Is there a surprise?

videos.title: Chotu Mama Falls Asleep On Theater's Roof
videos.overview: All the villagers of Lapataganj are trying hard to wake up Chotu Mama who is sleeping on Delight Cinema's roof. Mausi fumes in anger. Mukundi as Lord Krishna gives knowledge to Chotu Mama as Arjun.

videos.title: Chotu Mama In Search Of Lord Krishna
videos.overview: Chotu Mama gets highly inspired by Geetaji in which Lord Krishna has beautifully explained brave warrior Arjun the truth of life. Chotu Mama becomes Arjun. Will Chotu Mama be able to find Lord Krishna?

videos.title: Blue Baba Arrives In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mukundi gets angry with Chotu Mama as he fought with Lallanji. Netaji Khauram introduces Blue Baba to all the villagers of Lapataganj. Is this Netaji Khauram's evil plan? Will Mukundi find out the truth?

videos.title: Blue Baba's Speech
videos.overview: America return Blue Baba spreads knowledge to the villagers in English. Villagers are highly impressed by Blue Baba as he repeatedly keeps on saying those 3 magical words. How will Mukundi find out the truth about Blue Baba?

videos.title: Blue Babas Master Plan
videos.overview: Mukundi is strictly against these Babas who fool people but found Blue Baba unique. Will the villagers of Lapataganj come to know about Blue Babas master plan? Will Inspector Ejji Pandey find out the truth?

videos.title: Suttilal Becomes Blue Baba
videos.overview: Mamaji tries to reveal the truth to the villagers about Blue Baba but none of them believe him. Mama firmly decides to raise the blue curtain and spill the truth.

videos.title: Villagers Get Crazy For Blue Baba
videos.overview: All the female members of Lapataganj are extremely upset as Blue Baba decides to leave Lapataganj. But still, Blue Baba requests the villagers to vote for him.

videos.title: Don Jagpal Singh In Lapataganj
videos.overview: All the villagers of Lapataganj are shocked to see Don Jagpal Singh. They capture Lallanji as a hostage. Kachua Chacha explains the truth of life and motivates others. Ejji Pandey has a task to be completed.

videos.title: New Refrigerator In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chukundi is trying unique ways to impress Dolly. Lallanji gets angry with Mamaji because of his behaviour. All are super excited about the new refrigerator in Lallanji's house.

videos.title: Loans Fever
videos.overview: Mukundi is in a  big shock as Indu buys a new refrigerator. Mausi welcomes the new refrigerator in Mukundi's house but a major trouble takes place. The refrigerator turns out to be a defective one. How will Mukundi deal with this?

videos.title: Indu Tries to Jump From The Balcony
videos.overview: Indumati tries out unique ways to persuade Mukundi to buy a brand new refrigerator and when he denies, she tries to jump from the balcony. How will Mukundi deal with this?

videos.title: Mukundi is Not Confident
videos.overview: Mukundi and Indu welcome their new refrigerator in Lapataganj and also invites the villagers to take a look at it. Mukundi is not confident about the loan he has taken. Mukundi has to look after his father too.

videos.title: Sugandhilal Admitted In Hospital
videos.overview: All the villagers of Lapataganj are trying to cure Sugandhilal who has been shivering for a long time. Sugandhilal is urgently rushed to the hospital, as things get out of hand.

videos.title: Mukundi Fails to Repay The Loan
videos.overview: One of the Employees who collects the amount of loan from the customers, troubles Mamaji.  Mukundi fails to repay the loan amount. Will Mukuni and Indu get any help from Sugandhilal?

videos.title: Friendship Over?
videos.overview: Mamaji and Eilja have become best friends forever. They are stunned to see Genda Gorakhpur, who has recently arrived in Lapataganj. How long will Elija and Mamaji's friendship last?

videos.title: Genda Gets Attention
videos.overview: Elija and Mamaji are trying their best to impress Lallanji's relative Genda. Will Genda get impressed by Elija or Mamaji?

videos.title: Genda's Search For a Groom
videos.overview: Mamaji and Elija fool Genda by giving their own description to Genda as she is looking for a perfect groom. Elija and Mamaji both are trying their best to impress Genda. Will Genda find her perfect groom in Lapataganj?

videos.title: Elija and Mamaji Gets Romantic
videos.overview: Elija and Mamaji both are trying their best to impress Genda. They start being romantic and try all means to woo her. Genda does not give much importance to them. Will their hard work go in vain?

videos.title: Elija Gets Romantic With Genda
videos.overview: Elija is extremely excited about expressing his love for Genda. A massive argument takes place between the two best friends as they come to know that both have fallen in love with the same girl. Who will solve Elija and Mamaji's problem?

videos.title: Fight Between Mamaji and Elija
videos.overview: A massive argument takes place between Elija and Mamaji. Elija and Mama slap each other. Mukundi and Indu try to stop their grand fight. The whole village is going to know about their love interest.

videos.title: Yellow Flowers and Possession
videos.overview: Elija forgets the gift in front of the statue but Mamaji comes up with something. He gives Genda the gift and wishes her a happy birthday. He gives her a yellow flower and something weird happens.

videos.title: Who will be The Bodyguard?
videos.overview: Mamaji starts chasing Elija and Mausi stops him. Both of them are at each other's throat. They visit Mukundilal's house to talk to him. They are competing against each other to become a bodyguard to Gendha. Who will be the bodyguard?

videos.title: Elija, The Bodyguard
videos.overview: Lallanji introduces Elija as the bodyguard. Elija guards Gendha as they walk through the town. Mamaji gets furious at the sight of Elija taking care of Gendha and attacks him.

videos.title: Elija vs The Goons
videos.overview: Mamaji attacks Mausi instead of Elija. Mamaji confronts Lallanji and asks him why he chose Elija to be the bodyguard and not him. Some goons attack Genda. Will Elija be able to fight them and protect Genda?

videos.title: Friendship Blooms
videos.overview: The goons start attacking Elija and Mamaji intervene and starts fighting the goons. Both of them fight together but Gendha does not choose either of them as her bodyguard.

videos.title: Sajini Arrives
videos.overview: Dolly wants to go to Mumbai and become an actress. Sajini arrives with Dolly's father and he agrees that hell get her the tickets. Dolly practices pose in front of everyone and pester her father to get her the tickets to Mumbai.

videos.title: Dolly's Dream
videos.overview: Chukku is sad about Dolly trying to leave for Mumbai. Dolly is distracted by the attention she gets from the customers in the shop. She argues with her father and insists on going to Mumbai again and again.

videos.title: The Stranger
videos.overview: A stranger visits Dolly's shop and tells her that he's met a lot of actors and actresses. He tells her that he's going to Mumbai the next day and asks her to join him so that she can also act. Dolly writes a letter and disappears. Everyone starts looking for her everywhere.

videos.title: Dolly is Back
videos.overview: Chukundi and Chotu follow Dolly and manage to rescue her from the guy who plans to take her to Mumbai. Dolly comes back to her village and accepts her mistakes and regrets them. Lala gets mad at her for leaving all of them.

videos.title: A Thief Enters Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mishri Mausi finds a guy in Indumati's house trying to steal slippers. Seeing her, the thief tries to run away. When caught by Mishra Mausi and other villagers, he then tries to defend himself by making up stories and fooling them.

videos.title: Lallanji Gets Super Excited
videos.overview: Lallanji goes back home to Bindumati all excited and tells her that he will be soon promoted. Bindumati is not bothered at first, but then Lallanji makes huge promises of getting her expensive things and building a house for her.

videos.title: Lallanji In Search For an Onion
videos.overview: Lallanji is desperately in need of onion and Bijji Pandey helps him to get one. While Bijji gets one from Sureeli's house suddenly a guy on the bike passes by him really fast and crushes the onion on the way. Seeing this Lallanji faints there itself.

videos.title: Auction For Onions
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey gets a piece of information about an auction taking place for onions. In order to help Lallanji to get hold of some onions, he reaches there and takes part in the auctions.

videos.title: Bidders Become Frauds
videos.overview: A couple of people who were bidders in the auction come at night to steal onions from the one who won the auction and has 10kg onions. Lallanji catches the people in the act and beats them up in front of the villagers.

videos.title: Bablu Leaves His House
videos.overview: Bablu claims that his father doesn't trust him and that is the reason he left his house. When Dablu comes and asks Bablu for the reason he tells him that he got a movie ticket which features the whole of Banaras and asks him to get a ticket for Banaras.

videos.title: Bijji Gets Rid Of His Sins
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey is told by Kachchua Chacha to get rid of his past life sins away by doing good deeds. Guddu tells him to do that by making other people happy and helping the ones in need. Bijji then goes around the village looking for people in need of it.

videos.title: Ghost In Suttilal's Shop
videos.overview: Suttilal, Mircha and Pudina are worried about a ghost's presence in their shop. Lallanji meanwhile goes to Suttilal's shop and takes some snacks with him. Seeing Lallanji go out of his shop safely makes Suttilal's relieved.

videos.title: Suttilal's Father's Ghost
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey and Guddu come to Suttilal's shop for some jalebis when a voice comes cursing them and asking them to pay first, only then they will be served sweets. Hearing that, Bijji and Guddu turn to Suttilal and question his audacity to talk to them in that manner.

videos.title: Buttilals Strong Decision
videos.overview: All the villagers roam around dancing their problems away with Buttilal's photo frame. Hearing their problems, Buttilal decides that the sweets in his shop would now be sold at the old price that was cheaper.

videos.title: Villagers to The Rescue
videos.overview: Yadavji comes to Suttilal's shop in search of Buttilal as he needs sweets for his daughters wedding. Suttilal and the other villagers come to his aid and also to help Yadavji in making his daughters marriage a successful one.

videos.title: Mukundilal Gets His Head Shaved
videos.overview: Mukundilal's father asks Mukundi and Chukundi to get their head shaved for religious purposes. Both Mukundi and Chukundi are adamant about not getting their heads shaved as people would make fun of them and stop respecting them.

videos.title: A Visit to Ganga
videos.overview: Mukundi and family along with Mamaji and Elija go for a trip to visit the holy Ganga. Mukundi's father explains everyone the importance of the river Ganga and how pure and blissful it is.

videos.title: Indumati Enjoying Holy Ganga
videos.overview: Indumati sits near the shores of Ganga admiring the beautiful river. Mukundi and Chukundi join her when she tells them that she misses her daughter Bhagyalaxmi.

videos.title: Mukundi Convinces His Father
videos.overview: Indumati brings a picture of her and a bald guy to show her father and he starts making fun of the bald guy and gets mad at Indumati for getting a picture clicked with a stranger. She wants him to realize that the bald guy is none other than Mukundilal.

videos.title: Mukundi and Chukundi Run Away
videos.overview: Thinking of a way out from getting their heads shaved, Mukundi and Chukundi run away from the Ashram. Elija tries to stop them but is unable to.

videos.title: In Search Of Mukundi
videos.overview: After Mukundi and Chukundi run away from the Ashram, Elija and Mamamji go looking for them all over town. The villagers get the news of Mukundi and Chukundi missing and pray for them coming back.

videos.title: Mukundi and Chukundis Disguise
videos.overview: Mukundi and Chukundi, as a way of hiding in town after running from the ashram, disguises as priests. Babuji and Indumati go in search for them but are difficult to find because of the disguise.

videos.title: Mukundi and Chukundi Return
videos.overview: Mukundi and Chukundi return back to their family, as Mukundi realizes when he loses Chukundi a night ago and how difficult and painful it was to find him back. The villagers are about to go in search of both of them but all of a sudden they return back to the village.

videos.title: Munna Arrives In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Indumati tells Mukundilal that Munna will visit and stay with them for a while. Indumati and Bindumati are very excited about his arrival. Mukundilal meets with a small accident with a stranger.

videos.title: Munna Saves The Day
videos.overview: Two chain snatchers ride on a bike and snatch Mircha's chain and were about to run away. The villagers tried to stop them but couldn't, until Munna arrives and beats them up.

videos.title: Munna Gets Presents
videos.overview: Munna gets presents for Chukundi and Bhagyalaxmi. He gets them a story reading device but Chukundi takes that away and doesn't let Bhagyalaxmi use it which makes her very sad.

videos.title: Mukundi Intimidated By Munna
videos.overview: Mukundilal is intimidated by Munna's presence as everyone around him praises Munna. Indumati asks Mukundilal to get sweets for Munna from Suttilal's shop.

videos.title: Diwali Celebrations In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey goes to meet Sureeli and makes fun of Mausiji who gets a beating after that. Munna gets litres of milk delivered for him and eats a lot at Suttilal's shop.

videos.title: Wrestling In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Indumati's father who is also Munna's wrestling trainer visits her place. He trains all the villagers for a day and is disappointed by Mukundilal. Mukundilal challenges Munna for a fight.

videos.title: Mukundilal V/s Munna
videos.overview: Mukundilal faces Munna in a wrestling fight. Everyone thinks the fight is one-sided and expects Munna to win the battle, however, tables are turned during the match.

videos.title: Babuji Returns to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Sajni bua listens to sad songs early in the morning which annoys Mukundilal.  Babuji comes back home all of a sudden and all the villagers gather around asking the same questions to him including Lallanji who gets a beating after that.

videos.title: Babuji Hospitalised
videos.overview: Babuji is at the hospital and the doctor says that Babuji wont be able to survive for more than ten days. Indumati and all the villagers are sentimental of the fact and don't believe that Babuji wont survive.

videos.title: Lapataganj Sad About Babuji
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj are sad about receiving the news about Babuji. Mamaji, Suttilal and Pudhina all are sad while Bijji Pandey comes back to the village after a couple of days and receives the news himself.

videos.title: Villagers Prepare a Funeral
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj prepare a funeral for Babuji and discuss it amongst themselves when Babuji walks in all of a sudden. To hide the truth from Babuji everyone makes up a lie that Lallanji had a dream about dying so the funeral is for him.

videos.title: Singer At Lapataganj
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj invite a singer for the funeral. The singer asks the people of Lapataganj to bring the person for whom the funeral is taking place for and accordingly he is gonna perform for them.

videos.title: Babujis Last Night
videos.overview: Mukundi and Indumati go to Babuji as they feel its his last night as said by the doctor. Next morning they try to wake up Babuji and he doesn't move for a while and when he does it was Chukundi sleeping in Babuji's place.

videos.title: Babuji Survives
videos.overview: The politicians of Lapataganj had prepared a whole speech and a feast on account of Babuji's death. The villagers then meet up with the politicians and give them the news which makes them angry.

videos.title: Indumati Learns English
videos.overview: Indumati tries to learn English from her daughter Bhagyalakshmi. Mukundilal and Chukundi make fun of her English and laugh at her. Bablu and Dablu go to their chacha to clear their doubts.

videos.title: Mamajis Treat
videos.overview: Mamaji on account of her first late Wife's birthday treats everyone with a samosa and a cup of tea at Suttilal's shop. Mamaji and Mukundilal then advice Bijji to find a job and start working.

videos.title: Tilu and Chukku Protect Sureeli
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey comes at Sureeli's place to meet her when he sees Tilu and Chiku with wooden sticks in their hands guarding Sureeli and letting him meet her. When Bijji doesn't go, they both start attacking him and make him go away.

videos.title: Bijji and Sureeli Run Away
videos.overview: Mausiji and Mamaji find a note from Sureeli and Bijji stating that they both are going away. The villagers go to the police station to file a report where the police attendant is Bijji's brother Ijji.

videos.title: Sureeli and Bijji Get Married
videos.overview: Sureeli and Bijji are back to get married. Elija feels emotional about him not being married. Mausiji is sad because Sureeli's father wont make it to the wedding.

videos.title: Strange Things In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mircha and Suttilal head home at night when they see a strange aircraft in the sky causing strong winds and storms which causes Mircha to faint and Suttilal worried.

videos.title: Alien In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mircha is stunned as she witnessed a spaceship in Lapataganj. The minister arrives to inform them about an aliens presence in Lapataganj. Bhagyalakshmi meets the alien on the way back home from school.

videos.title: Bhagyalakshmi Brings The Alien Home
videos.overview: Bhagyalakshmi encounters the alien and decides to take the alien home. She meets Eji Pandey on the way back home and she lies to him that people tried to steal her books and moves on.

videos.title: Bhagyalakshmi is Friends With Akka
videos.overview: Bhagyalakshmi brings the alien home and is friends with alien, Akka-Bakka. Indu is scared of the alien initially but everyone becomes friendly to the alien and introduces him to the people of Lapataganj.

videos.title: Akka
videos.overview: Akka-Bakka meet and greet the people of Lapataganj but run away from there to an abundant old furniture factory. Everyone follows him to find an alien family there. They bring the family to the village.

videos.title: Mamaji Takes The Alien Avatar
videos.overview: Mamaji comes to Lapataganj in the avatar of an alien and everyone believes him to belong with the other aliens. While they head to sleep in the night, Mamaji figures that they are fake aliens and tells everyone in the village about it.

videos.title: Minister Deals With The Aliens
videos.overview: The minister's people hit the family that faked to be the aliens. They break down confessing that they are farmers who lost their land and were desperate to have a decent meal, the minister gets furious but Mukundi reminds him of his duties.

videos.title: Mukundi has a Bad Day
videos.overview: Mukundi leaves home fighting with Indu, witnesses an accident. When he heads to launch a complaint at the police station he finds out about the dangerous Goldie Yadav. Goldie Yadav also gets arrested.

videos.title: Bhagyalakshmi Goes Missing
videos.overview: Mukundi involves in conflict with Goldie Yadav. But gradually, Goldie Yadav gets away from the jail. Goldie calls Mukundi and warns him about the future. Mukundi then receives a call of Bhagyalakshmi's disappearance.

videos.title: Mukundis Family In Danger
videos.overview: Bhagyalakshmi returns and informs everyone that a man told her to go to the warehouse to meet her father. Goldie Yadav is determined to scare Mukundi from being a witness. The family goes missing after someone tries to burn his house.

videos.title: A New Punjabi Family
videos.overview: A new Punjabi family comes to Lapataganj. The people of Lapataganj fail to recognize that it is Mukundi's family in a Punjabi avatar. They have changed their looks in order to stay safer before the court hearing.

videos.title: Goldie Visits Mahender
videos.overview: Goldie hears of the new Punjabi family who has moved to Mukundi's home. He visits to threaten them and Mukundi gets hit on the head. The villagers are worried and apologize for not being able to recognize them.

videos.title: Guptas As South Indians
videos.overview: People of Lapataganj are sad as they read the letter Mukundi and his family leave behind before leaving the village. Mukundi's family returns as a new south Indian family in place of them. Mukundi tries to make Indumati jealous by dancing with another woman.

videos.title: Mamaji Returns
videos.overview: Lapataganj is busy spending time with the south Indian family. They visit the Gupta's while Mukundi gets irritated about it. Mamaji returns home with a donkey.

videos.title: Mukundi's Father is Worried
videos.overview: Mukundi's father comes to Lapataganj and finds him missing and gets to know about the incident of Goldie. He is worried about Mukundi, but the family gets emotional and opens up about their reality.

videos.title: Lalanjis Niece In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chukkundi is involved in a fight while a beautiful girl walks in Lapataganj. She calls herself as Lily Vajpayee. Lallanji introduces her as Leelavati, his niece.

videos.title: Chukkundi Loves Lily
videos.overview: Chukkundi is lost and dreams about Lily. The next morning Lily and Chukkundi brush while looking at each other. Lily gives him a riddle to solve. There is a debate that is happening over love.

videos.title: Chukkundi Tries to Impress Lily
videos.overview: Chukkundi wears a suit to impress Lily but she puts up another obstacle. Chukkundi cries about the troubles he has in his way. Lily spends time capturing pictures on her phone. Chukkundi is very happy about the romantic time they spend together.

videos.title: Chukkundi and Lily Go On a Date
videos.overview: Chukkundi takes Lily to the market and she opens up about the troublesome rich boy who had created troubles for her during the college days. The boys find them and both of them escape.

videos.title: Lallanji's Elder Bother
videos.overview: Lallanji's elder brother shows up in Lapataganj and Chukkundi introduces himself. He gets furious looking at Chukkundi's chemistry with his daughter, Lily.

videos.title: Lallan V/s Kallan
videos.overview: The brothers fight over who is the better one. The better one will be decided by a rickshaw race. Both are injured but they care for each others pain more than ones own.

videos.title: Kallan Gives a Party
videos.overview: Kalanji gives a party to the people of Lapataganj. Everyone thanks him and he expresses the reason for the party. Kalanji felt the selfish person he had become because of the city life and hence repented at the party.

videos.title: Sureeli Gets a Letter
videos.overview: Sureeli gets a letter to go to Nagpur. Biji Pandey promised her that he will come along, Mishri requests Ejji Pandey to come to Nagpur. The brothers start having a tiff with each other on this issue.

videos.title: Bijji and Sureeli's Vacation
videos.overview: After Sureeli's exam in Kanpur, Bijji and Sureeli escape from Mamaji's sight and head out to explore Kanpur. However, some guard holds Bijji and take him away somewhere.

videos.title: Bijji is a Nawab
videos.overview: The guards take Bijji Pandey to a palace and tell him that he belongs to their family and is the Nawab they have been waiting for since so many years.

videos.title: Bijji Overhears The Truth
videos.overview: Biji eats his meal in the Nawab style. Nawab's mother realizes the innocence of Bijji Pandey and tells him the truth about the Nawab family. How will he react to this story?

videos.title: Biji Pandey As Nawab
videos.overview: Biji Pandey decides to save the queens from the cruel Nawabs. Bijji takes over as the Nawab of the Palace and rules over everyone so that he is able to protect the others.

videos.title: Biji Enjoys Being a Nawab
videos.overview: Bijji Pandey tries to escape from the palace for a while as he wants to hunt, but is informed that hunting has now been banned. He is then stuck in a situation where two old queens try to seduce him.

videos.title: Ejji Saves Bijji
videos.overview: The Nawabs capture Bijji Pandey and threaten to kill him. Ejji Pandey finds out about them and comes to the rescue. He arrests the evil Nawabs and passes on the property to their wives.

videos.title: Mukundilal's Honesty
videos.overview: Colleagues of Mukundi plot against Mukundi because of his honesty. Mukundi prays to God to give him the strength to be the same honest man. Mukundi leaves to work but is caught up with a bad body itching.

videos.title: Mukundi Becomes The King
videos.overview: Mukundi manages to reach the office with a clean shirt. They come up with the plan of a drama and Mukundi is made the king.

videos.title: The Crown Caught On Lallanjis Head
videos.overview: Lallanji visits Mukundi's house and wears the crown meant for the play. The crown is fit tight on his head and he is unable to remove it, despite trying it several times. Mukundilal loses his cool on losing the crown.

videos.title: Lallanji Gets Suspended
videos.overview: Mukundilal fumes in anger as he gets to know that Lallanji has worn his prestigious Mukut and also tries to find a solution as he has to wear the Mukut in the play Mukutraj. PWD star Lallanji talks rudely with his Boss and thus he gets suspended. How will Mukundilal solve his and Lallanji's problem?

videos.title: Mukut Unlucky For Lallanji
videos.overview: Mamaji calls one of his closest friends, Chunnilal who happens to be Bade Babu's mukut designer. Chunnilal gets to know that the mukut is worn by Lallanji and not by Mukundilal. Lallanji reveals that the mukut has proved to be unlucky for him as he can't remove it and above all he gets suspended.

videos.title: Thieves Attempt to Steal
videos.overview: Two thieves arrive in Lapataganj to steal Lallanji's golden mukut but little do they know about heavy trouble which is waiting for them. They both fail to remove the mukut and Lallanji is found unconscious in the middle of the village. Will the villagers catch the thieves?

videos.title: Bade Babus Confession
videos.overview: Lallanji essays the role of Maharaja Shersingh and all the esteemed guests are highly impressed by Lallanji's acting skills. Bade Babu reveals a shocking truth to Mukundilal. Will Mukundilal forgive Bade Babu?

videos.title: The Local Politician Arrives
videos.overview: The local politician arrives in Lapataganj to announce that the school will be reopened, and will also provide education for adults who want to learn to read and write. But who is this Miss Mary? Join the excitement with the residents of Lapataganj in this episode.

videos.title: Grand Welcome Of Miss Mary
videos.overview: All the villagers of Lapataganj are stunned to see Miss Mary who will be their new teacher. Miss Mary is warmly welcomed by all the villagers. It seems that Elija, Chukundi and Mamaji have fallen in love with her. Will Miss Mary succeed in achieving her goal?

videos.title: Miss Mary has Moved to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Miss Mary has moved to Lapataganj in an attempt to straighten out the education system in the town. She is going out of her way to discipline the laid-back townfolk. How will they take this?

videos.title: New Students In Marys Classroom
videos.overview: Love is in the air for Elija, Chotu Mama, Chukundi, Suttilal and Phudina as a new teacher has arrived in Lapataganj to educate them. Miss Mary surprised to see new students in the classroom and also requests them to leave. The ladies of Lapataganj are highly impressed by Miss Mary's dressing style and wishes to be stylish like her.

videos.title: Wonder Woman, Mary
videos.overview: Miss Mary dances all around the village and introduces herself and she tells everyone that she is here to stay. Three goons stop Mary's way and tease her.

videos.title: Mausi Becomes Super Stylish
videos.overview: All the villagers of Lapataganj are extremely upset as Mary is leaving. The villagers are stunned to see Mausi's new look as she becomes super stylish and also apologizes to Miss Mary. Will Mary forgive Mausi?

videos.title: Elija Becomes a Detective
videos.overview: Elija has become a detective to find out the wife who is planning to kill her husband in Lapataganj. Elija doubts on Mircha as she was getting angry on Suttilal. Will Elija find out the truth?

videos.title: Miss Marys Accident
videos.overview: Elija has covered almost all the places in Lapataganj and has also enquired about every couple but still, he has not managed to find out who that woman is who is planning to kill her husband. Mukundi, Elija and Chotu Mama have a plan.

videos.title: Chukundis Love Letter
videos.overview: With the help of Miss Mary, Chukundi succeeds in writing a love letter for his huge crush, Lilavati. Elija is shocked to see Mircha with an unknown man in Lapataganj. Elija firmly decides to save Suttilal's life. Who will solve the confusion?

videos.title: Suttilal Gets Frightened
videos.overview: Suttilal is afraid of his wife and Elija also reveals to Mukundilal and Mamaji that Mircha wants to kill Suttilal. Mircha is extremely angry with Suttilal's suggestion of marriage. Who is planning to kill Suttilal?

videos.title: Miss Marys Master Plan
videos.overview: The villagers share Suttilal's problem with Miss Mary and she comes up with an interesting plan to find the truth with the help of her team. Suttilal is afraid of Mircha's brother. Suttilal too believes that Mircha wants to kill him.

videos.title: Mircha Reveals a Shocking Truth
videos.overview: Mircha gets a huge shock when Suttilal reveals her that someone was planning to kill him in Lapataganj and also tries to prove it with the help of Elija but this apparently does not go down too well with Mircha.

videos.title: The Stone Man
videos.overview: Mukundi and Indu are worried after learning the news about a man who hits people with a stone when they are asleep and escapes. People in Lapataganj are in terror after listening to this news.

videos.title: A New Twist
videos.overview: There is a new twist this time, people of Lapataganj are in fear because there is someone who is creating problems for the villagers. Who is this guy, who is creating problems for the villagers?

videos.title: Mamaji Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Gappu Singh confronts Mamaji and arrests him. Mausi gets worried as Mamaji ends up in prison. Elija and Mukundilal go to visit Mamaji in prison and give him some food. What will happen to Mamaji?

videos.title: Encounter With The Mystery Man
videos.overview: Eliza dresses up and tries to catch the man who throws stones at night. Suttilal, Mircha and Elija encounter the mystery man. Mamaji is released from prison. Everyone suspects Mary. Who is the mystery man?

videos.title: Mystery Man Revealed
videos.overview: People start leaving Lapataganj because they are scared of the mystery man. Mamaji suspects Mary and follows her. Everyone plans to go out at night and catch the mystery man. Pudina is the bait and the mystery man appears.

videos.title: The Master Plan
videos.overview: Mamaji gets slapped by Mary. Mamaji, Elija, Suttilal and his wife tell everyone about previous night's events. Mary tells everyone her family background. All the town's people join together and plan to catch the mystery man.

videos.title: The Plan Execution
videos.overview: All the people of Lapataganj dress up like the mystery man and execute the plan they made with Mary. The policeman arrives and rounds up all the people to catch the mystery man. Who do you think is the mystery man?

videos.title: Caught Red-handed
videos.overview: Mukundilal arrives at the right moment and catches the mystery man. Everyone is shocked as the mystery man reveals his face. The mystery man also reveals the reason behind his deeds. After catching the culprit everyone is happy and safe.

videos.title: The Water Problem
videos.overview: Everyone in the town gets sick after taking a bath or drinking the water. They get together and discover that the water is polluted. How will they solve this problem?

videos.title: Price Hike Each Time
videos.overview: After finding out that the water is polluted, Mukundi and the others take the problem to Nethaji who tells them that he'll send the tanker. Raja babu arrives in Lapataganj with the water tanker. But the tanker price increases everyday.

videos.title: The Tanker and The Lake
videos.overview: Every day the price of water supply increases and the people of Lapataganj decide not to get water from the tanker. Mukundilal and Indu go to fetch water from the lake and discover something and end up getting beaten.

videos.title: Water Crisis Again
videos.overview: The local minister after watching how the villagers are wreaking havoc due to the water crisis gives in and takes an initiative to solve the problem.

videos.title: Elija Seeks Blessings
videos.overview: Elija gives a good news to everyone and wishes to get married as soon as possible. He seeks blessings from Mukundi, Indumati and Mishri. Mukundi tries to tell Elija that a man is happy if he is unmarried.

videos.title: Elija's Dream Shatters
videos.overview: Elija's truth comes out that he is totally different from the picture that was sent to the girl's family. They find out the truth and insults Elija as they refuse to accept him. Everyone starts questioning Elija why he lied.

videos.title: Chotu to Find Elija
videos.overview: Elija gets kidnapped by a group of people. Nobody in Lapataganj is aware of it. Chotu realizes it later and shouts to gather everyone. No one has any information about Elija.

videos.title: Elija In Gujarat
videos.overview: Strangers take Elija to Gujarat to get him married to one of their girls. He is excited as he always wanted to get married. Elija starts following the instructions that he has been asked to follow.

videos.title: Decision has to be Made
videos.overview: Mishri and Mamaji reach Gujarat to save Elija from getting married. But then he is stuck as the opposite party pleads him to get married. When Elija refuses, they point the gun on him and scare him.

videos.title: Elija Against Chotu
videos.overview: Chotu starts liking Kokila and decides to get married to her. Elija, on the other hand, stops him from getting married to Kokila. What is the reason that Elija is stopping him ?

videos.title: Chotu Gets Cheated
videos.overview: The celebration has started and everyone is excited about the wedding. Chotu is very happy and wants to enjoy his life. But when Chotu sees Kokila, he faints and does not want to wake up. What did Chotu see?

videos.title: Lapataganj In Shock
videos.overview: Everyone in Lapataganj eagerly waits to welcome Chotu and his wife. Indumati is super excited and starts welcoming them with all the rituals. As soon as Bindumati unveils Kokila's face, everyone in Lapataganj stands shocked.

videos.title: Raoji and Kokila's Marriage
videos.overview: Raoji reveals that he and Kokila love each other. Everyone is surprised but happy at the same time. They get married immediately and Mamaji, Eliza and Mausi return to Lapataganj. Eliza shares a piece of good news. What could it be?

videos.title: Lazy Lapataganj
videos.overview: All the people of Lapataganj feel very lazy and yawn the whole day. Mary suggests an idea to make the people feel refreshed. Someone new comes to Lapataganj.

videos.title: The Argument About The Fence
videos.overview: Bubblyji, Lovelyji and the others are now staying in Lapataganj. They start arguing and everyone gathers around. What are they arguing about? And how will they solve it?

videos.title: The Permission Letter
videos.overview: Lallanji and Mukundilal decide to help out Bubblyji and Lovelyji. They go to meet Murali Babu and discover something about Raja Babu. Mausi faces some issue at her house. What could it be?

videos.title: The Brave Ladies Of Lapataganj
videos.overview: Everyone is gathered in front of Mausi's house. Mukundilal and the others return and share the news about the permission letter. All the ladies of Lapataganj go to meet Murali babu and start quarrelling.

videos.title: Nethajis Sudden Visit
videos.overview: The ladies return and hand over the permission letter to Bubbly Singh and Lovely Singh. Nethaji visits the people of Lapataganj and informs them about the race. Mukundilal and Indumati start quarrelling.

videos.title: The Exhibition
videos.overview: Lallanji comes to town with a car. Everyone is getting ready to go to the exhibition. Nethaji cuts the ribbon and inaugurates the exhibition. Everyone comes to the exhibition to check it out.

videos.title: Miss Mary's Stalker
videos.overview: The people of Lapataganj have fun at the exhibition and play different games. Raja babu plants a small bomb but it blows up on his face. Mary falls down but a stranger catches her. The stranger happens to be stalking her for a long time.

videos.title: The Grand Circus
videos.overview: Bubbly and Lovely rehearse for the circus. All the people of Lapataganj come to see the circus. Everyone watches the circus with great excitement.

videos.title: Men vs Women
videos.overview: The people of Lapataganj divide themselves into two groups and compete against each other in various games. Mary's stalker appears again and helps Mary to make sure that the women win the competition.

videos.title: Lakhan Saves The Day
videos.overview: The men get on the twister and later Lakhan notices something wrong with the twister. He tells the operator to stop the ride but it is so fast that it cannot be stopped.

videos.title: Grand Prize Stolen
videos.overview: Throughout the day Lakhan helps Mary win all the games without her knowing. Mary wants to win the grand prize. But Lakhan steals it while the lights are out. What will Lakhan do now?

videos.title: The Bike Sport
videos.overview: Lakhan gives the stolen prize to Mary. The next day everyone comes to the exhibition again. They start quarrelling with each other there itself. Later, Lakhan agrees to participate in the bike sport.

videos.title: The Arm Wrestling
videos.overview: Lakhan does amazing bike stunts in front of everyone.  Meanwhile, the wrestling match starts and all the Lapataganj women are against a lady and the men against the hefty man.

videos.title: Winner Of The Grand Prize
videos.overview: Elija defeats the man. Mukundilal receives the prize on behalf of all men. A fire starts at the exhibition and Lakhan goes into the fire to save Mary, but something falls on Lakhan and he faints on the spot.

videos.title: Lakhan The Inspector
videos.overview: Mary loses her phone and goes to file a complaint at the police station. But they refuse to file one. Lakhan gets mistaken as the inspector. He scolds the others for not taking the complaint made by Mary.

videos.title: Dolly Returns to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chukku gets into trouble with a girl. Everyone defends Chukku. Mukundilal scolds and beats Chukku in front of everyone. Someone stops Mukundilal from beating Chukku. Who could it be?

videos.title: Dolly's Big Break
videos.overview: Dolly fights her way in to meet the director. She acts in front of him and he proclaims her the star of the movie. The shooting starts. Back in Lapataganj, Chukku gets into trouble.

videos.title: Dolly Returns to Lapataganj
videos.overview: Chukku gets into trouble with a girl. Everyone defends Chukku. Mukundilal scolds and beats Chukku in front of everyone. Someone stops Mukundilal from beating Chukku. Who could it be?

videos.title: The Fake Inspector
videos.overview: Dolly tells everyone about her acting career. Everyone is happy for her. Lakhan who is still acting as the police comes to Mukundilal's house to see Mary.

videos.title: Mary's Smart Move
videos.overview: In order to impress Mary, the policeman presents a number of cellphones in front of her. When she reveals that she already has her phone, his plan backfires.

videos.title: Dolly is In a Movie
videos.overview: Dolly is the center of attention for everyone in Lapataganj as her movie is going to release. Together, they go to the theatre along with Dolly to watch her on the big screen.

videos.title: Heatbroken Dolly
videos.overview: Dolly rushes out of the theatre crying as she is hardly seen in the movie. Lallan calls up the director to question him regarding Dolly's part in the movie.

videos.title: Elections On Head
videos.overview: As elections are on head, the politicians distribute sweets in the Lapataganj village. The villagers are surprised seeing an actress contest for elections in Lapataganj.

videos.title: Dirty Politics
videos.overview: People in Lapataganj are unable to decide who to vote for in the elections. All the contesting politicians try to convince the villagers to vote for them.

videos.title: Mukundi Refuses to Vote
videos.overview: Mukundi is upset as he fails to convince Indu to cast a vote for the elections. When Mary asks him to accompany him to cast his vote, he refuses.

videos.title: The Election Day
videos.overview: Lallan is taken under arrest for illegal voting. Mukundi is relieved to see Indu vote and follows her to cast his vote as well.

videos.title: Bajrang Dreams About Mary
videos.overview: Bajrang follows Mary around as soon as she leaves her house. At the police station, he day-dreams about her all day.

videos.title: Bajrang Sneaks Into Mary's House
videos.overview: Bajrang enters Mary's house without her consent and tries initiating a conversation. In the night, he sneaks into her house with an intention to rob.

videos.title: Dolly's Suggestion to Bajrang
videos.overview: Dolly suggests Bajrang to start maintaining a distance from Mary so that she gets attracted to him. He sets up his workplace in the middle of Lapataganj so that he can lay his eyes on Mary all day.

videos.title: Bajrang's Plan Backfires
videos.overview: Mary is injured when Pappu's plan goes wrong and a bomb blasts in her room. Seeing Mary in a pathetic condition, Bajrang runs away.

videos.title: Chotu Makes Bajrang Furious
videos.overview: Bajrang is furious after finding out that Chotu was responsible behind giving him an electric shock. He loses his calm on seeing Chotu tries to beat him up.

videos.title: Mary is Impressed
videos.overview: Chukundi teaches Dolly how to ride a scooter but she gives everyone around her a hard time. Mary is impressed by Bajrang as he stops the scooter at the right time saving many people's lives.

videos.title: Mukundi Against Corruption
videos.overview: Mukundi yells at a man who tries to bribe him. He humiliates the corrupt man in front of everyone in Lapataganj. Seeing his loyalty, Lallan gets into a deep thought.

videos.title: Lallan Suspended From Pwd
videos.overview: When Lallan's boss talks about his suspension from PWD, he is devastated. When the villagers celebrate his fifteen years in PWD, he is silent and loses his ability to think.

videos.title: Lallan's Lie is Caught
videos.overview: Lallan lies at home saying that he is going to the office but has nowhere to go. Chotu goes to PWD for some work and is shocked to find out that Lallan has been terminated on the account of corruption.

videos.title: Lallan Accused Of Corruption
videos.overview: Lallan is suspended from PWD on the allegations of corruption. He is depressed and disturbed about the accusation. He gives up on life and decides to commit suicide.

videos.title: Cucumber Seller Blackmails Lallanji
videos.overview: A cucumber seller who figured about Lallanji's suspension blackmailed him to sell his cucumbers. Lallanji shares this with his Lapataganj friends. Mama ji heads to take care of the cucumber stall to teach the seller a lesson.

videos.title: Lallan Tries to Suicide
videos.overview: Lallan is humiliated and decides to suicide. However, he isn't able to find a way to do so. Mukundi catches him on one of his trails and yells at him to not do so. He warns everyone in Lapataganj to keep an eye on Lallanji.

videos.title: Lallan's Chacha Lashes Out
videos.overview: Lallan's Chacha visits him and finds out that Lallan has lost the job. He furiously leaves for which Lallan is depressed yet again. He continues to think of ways he can suicide.

videos.title: Lallan's Innocence is Proved
videos.overview: Lallan ji fearlessly slaps a corrupt politician, looking at his fearless and strong nature people of Lapataganj thoughtfully went on with enquiring the allegations posed at him. Lallan is proved to be innocent and the culprit is caught.

videos.title: Minister's Revenge
videos.overview: One of the ministers intends to take revenge from Mukundi and so heads to Lapataganj and informs them of a Hanuman temple that is coming up in order to preserve the heritage with a wicked plan.

videos.title: Homeless Lapataganj
videos.overview: The minister has the wicked plan of breaking homes of Lapataganj residents and construct a big grand temple in its place. Mukundi, Mausi and Elija are to leave their homes and village.

videos.title: Elija Fights Back
videos.overview: Elija is furious about losing his shop and home and so decides to step on the bulldozer and not let it break any building. The police comes down to the rescue.

videos.title: Sand Fight In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Mary mistakenly throws a sand ball on Lallanji which he in turn mistakenly throws on Mukundi, the scene changes soon into a sand fight among the villagers.

videos.title: Mukundi Gets Into Trouble
videos.overview: Champa texts Mukundi on his mobile to meet her outside his house, but then she takes his mobile and sends a text to herself to make it seem as if Mukundi asked Champa to meet her. Indumati catches Mukundi and Champa talking and giggling late at night.

videos.title: Panchaayat In Lapataganj
videos.overview: To solve Mukundi and Champa's case, the villagers decide to have a panchayat to decide who is truthful and who isn't. The villagers defend Mukundilal of not being a liar but an innocent, honest man.

videos.title: Angry Young Man, Chukundi
videos.overview: Chukundi gets to know about the allegations that have been put on Mukundi. He is super angry and comes running towards Champa to harm her. Mukundi tries to control him but Chukundi's rage reaches new heights. He has promised himself that he will not spare Champa.

videos.title: Mukundi Gets Suspended
videos.overview: Indumati cannot bear the news that Mukundi has been suspended from his office. She insists that she will talk to the higher authorities. Mukundi calms her down as nothing can be done now.

videos.title: Chukundi's Plan
videos.overview: Chukundi, Elija, Lallanji and Chotu decide to find the truth and so they plan to play the same game with the culprit. They reach her house in disguise and force her to listen to their fake plan.

videos.title: Bablu's Conversation With Dablu
videos.overview: Bablu and Dablu sit together to have a general conversation. But Dablu has a question for Bablu as he wants to know why kids get scared when they look at Bablu. Bablu does not understand that kids are scared because of Dablu's horrifying looks.

videos.title: Indumati Supports Chukundi
videos.overview: Mukundi teases Chukundi when he shows so much concern towards Mukundi. Indumati gets angry and starts yelling at Mukundi. She supports Chukundi and scolds Mukundi for spoiling her life as he does not believe her as well as Chukundi.

videos.title: Chuku's Examination Day
videos.overview: Indumati freaks out when she sees Mukundi and Chukundi sleeping instead of getting ready for examination. It takes Mukundi time to get back into his senses as he has not slept trying to teach Chukundi.

videos.title: Mukundi Slaps Chukundi
videos.overview: Chukundi comes dancing and tells everyone how good was his paper. Everyone is celebrating Chukundi's happiness except Mukundi and Indumati. Mukundi slaps Chukundi as Indu found out that Chukundi had leaked the paper a day before the examination.

videos.title: Chukundi Goes Missing
videos.overview: After being slapped, Chukundi gets upset and leaves the house without getting noticed. Indumati realises it later that Chukundi is not in the house. Everyone looks for Chukundi but does not get any news about him. Where is Chukundi?

videos.title: Chotu Steals The Diamonds
videos.overview: Mukundi's boss has given him a small pouch with diamonds. While returning home, mid-way Chotu steals the diamonds and run somewhere. Mishri is not ready to accept this.

videos.title: A Sigh Of Relief
videos.overview: Mukundi comes back home after a complete day of disappearance. Indumati is furious and questions where he was. Mukundi lies to her about being with a friend all night to avoid more confusion.

videos.title: Chotu or Raju?
videos.overview: The police have been hitting the thief in and out. Mishri and Elija reach the police station to rescue Chotu. But when they ask the police to stop hitting Chotu, the person addresses him as Raju. Who is Raju?

videos.title: A Lot Of Confusion
videos.overview: Raju runs out of the jail and the policemen follow him to some extent and then they lose his tracks. But instead, they come across Chotu who had been hiding for a while. Will Chotu be able to save himself?

videos.title: Gola Don In Lapataganj
videos.overview: Gola don is in Lapataganj with his gang. He got the news that the diamond is in Lapataganj and he has made the plan to steal it. But unknowingly, Chotu enters the house where the Gola don is residing.

videos.title: Don Interrogates Chotu
videos.overview: Chotu makes them believe that he is Raju but the don wants 100% proof. So he starts interrogating Chotu and asks him the code that he was assigned.

videos.title: The Ominous
videos.overview: Dablu asks Bablu why did he not go to the wedding that he was supposed to. Bablu tells him the ominous things that happened because of which he was asked not to come to the wedding.

videos.title: Suttilal's Shop On Stake
videos.overview: Customers complain to Suttilal after having his samosas. One of the customers gets angry and warns him that he will be complaining about him in the police station. Mirja blames Chotu for it.

videos.title: Indumati's Aspirations
videos.overview: No one in Lapataganj is crossing their doors as instructed by the priest. Indumati prays and aspires to make Mukundi a big officer in life. She insists that she will make him the prime minister one day with her prayers.

videos.title: Suttilal Gets a Big Order
videos.overview: With Baba's blessings, everyone's work is going great in Lapataganj. Suttilal gets the biggest order as he is to serve a number of people who will be attending a birthday party.

videos.title: Lallanji Finally Gets a Long Tie
videos.overview: Lallanji is super happy to get Bindumati back from her home. He elates in happiness and gives all credits to his long tie. Pappu is confused as he does not understand what is going on.

videos.title: Confused Pappu
videos.overview: Mishri welcomes Pappu with all her heart back to her house. Pappu is confused as he is not able to understand if anyone knows his truth or not. Elija does not understand Mishri's behaviour.

videos.title: Dablu's Infinite Questions
videos.overview: Bablu tells Dablu about the robbery news that took place in another village. Dablu starts asking questions and wants to know where are those stolen jewellery kept.

videos.title: Goons In Lapataganj
videos.overview: The robbers come to Lapataganj to hide as they were being chased by the policemen. For their safety, they dig a hole near Suttilal's shop and put the stolen jewellery in there and leave from Lapataganj.

videos.title: Suttilal and Mircha's Lie
videos.overview: Suttilal finds the jewellery that was hidden near his shop. He and his wife decide not to tell this to anyone and keep the treasure to themselves. Mirja lies about the jewellery that she is wearing.

videos.title: Everyone is After The Treasure
videos.overview: Everyone in Lapataganj is praying and hoping to get the treasure. No one knows about the treasure that Suttilal has. One member from each family is busy in digging to find the treasure.

videos.title: Goons are Back
videos.overview: The goons that left their stolen jewellery in Lapataganj are back, but this time in disguise. They have come back to know where are the pieces of jewellery, so they start questioning everyone.

videos.title: Lapataganj At Gunpoint
videos.overview: The robbers get very angry when no one tells them about the jewellery. They gather everyone around and point gun at each one of them. Will everyone tell the truth to save themselves?

videos.title: Saved Surprisingly
videos.overview: The robbers lose their calm and control and take Suttilal and his wife in their hands. Suddenly, the politicians come protesting and asking for votes. Everyone takes a sigh of relief as they feel they are saved.

videos.title: Mishri Hits The Goons
videos.overview: Mishri hits the goon's father and he faints. She gets scared and starts telling that she did not do it intentionally. Everyone tries to wake him up by doing something or the other.

videos.title: Dolly In Pain
videos.overview: The leader of the gang is angry and he decides to harm Suttilal and equal all that he has lost during all this time. Dolly is in pain after eating something unhygienic. How will everyone take care of her?

videos.title: Suttilal Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Everyone blames Suttilal and Mirja for giving them stale food and for which they get food poisoning. The policemen come and arrest Suttilal for selling poisonous food.

videos.title: Suttilal In Trouble
videos.overview: Suttilal is forced to shut his shop. He is accused of selling food that is dangerous for consumption. The police is trying to help them out but find no edge in the case. Mukundi then recalls and gives a lead to the police.

videos.title: Suttilals Case Solved
videos.overview: Suttilal is depressed and wishes to give up on life after losing his shop. Mukundi comforts him. The police finds the culprit, Tappu pailwan is found guilty and arrested. Everyone gathers to celebrate with him.

videos.title: Mukundi has a New Boss
videos.overview: Mukundi has a new female boss at work. She is quite impressed with his work and asks him to have lunch with her. They also spend a lot of time with each other after work. Indumati is busy waiting for him at home.

videos.title: Mukundi Fakes a Friend
