videos.overview: Mukundi comes back at home after a complete day of disappearance. Indumati is furious and questions where is was. Mukundi lies to her about being with a friend all night to avoid more confusion.

videos.title: Mukundi Brings The Fake Friend
videos.overview: Mukundi tries to arrange for a friend so Indumati doesn't check on him. He gets a friend and introduces him to Indumati. However, the same guy whom he mentions shows up.

videos.title: Mukundi's Boss Comes Home
videos.overview: Mukundi's boss comes to Lapataganj  in search of Mukundi. Indumati gets excited and welcomes her home, Mukundi cuts her out when she tries to apologise for the previous night and hides what happened that night from Indumati.

videos.title: Mukundi Confesses The Truth
videos.overview: Madam looks at the clip Indumati was wearing and asks her to return it. Indumati tells her that Mukundi got it for her and demands to know the truth. Mukundi confesses he lied because of Indumati's habit of doubting on him.

videos.title: Return Of Chammeli
videos.overview: Chammeli returns to Lapataganj. Mausi is angry with her and does not appreciate it. Mamaji opens a chat store and tells Mausi that Chammeli returned with the condition that Mamaji has to start working.

videos.title: Rich Man In Love With Dolly
videos.overview: A rich man has fallen in love with Dolly and visits Lapataganj everyday. He buys everything for everyone and distributes it among the poor. Dolly and the villagers are astonished.

videos.title: Dolly Signs a Movie
videos.overview: A director visits Lapataganj and asks Dolly to work in a movie. Dolly gets super excited. The next day everyone waits for the hero. Nanhe turns out to be the hero of the movie and the shooting begins.

videos.title: Nanhe is Jealous
videos.overview: Nanhe and Dolly are shooting the movie. Dolly is able to give a better shot with Chukku. Nanhe is angry and jealous of Dolly and Chukku's friendship.

videos.title: Nanhe and His Father Worried
videos.overview: Nanhe's father comes to Lapataganj and tells him to stop the shoot. They are shocked about the withdrawal of nine crores from their bank account. Chukku comes in at the same time in a lavish car.

videos.title: Nanhe Learns a Lesson
videos.overview: Chukku rents a car and comes in a suit to teach Nanhe a lesson. Nanhe is furious and leaves from there. Chukku reminds him that he can't buy friendship or love with money before he leaves.

videos.title: Bijji Pandey Becomes a Lawyer
videos.overview: Biji Pandey fights a case and becomes a government lawyer, After which, he wishes to take his wife home. Mausi however, refuses to let Surili go to Biji's home.

videos.title: New Guest In Lapataganj
videos.overview: There is a new guest Mukundi and Indumati await. Bulbul looks exactly like Surili and so everyone is confused but Mukundi clarifies that Bulbul just looks like Surili but isn't her.

videos.title: Biji Flirts With Bulbul
videos.overview: Bulbul goes around Lapataganj and Biji follows her and tries to flirt with her. Mukundi and Indu head to hit Biji when she stops them saying that she very well knows to take care of such boys.

videos.title: Biji Wants to Marry Bulbul
videos.overview: Biji Pandey falls in love with Bulbul and wants to marry her. Mukundi objects as Biji is married, he is asked to divorce Surili to be able to marry Bulbul.

videos.title: Biji Divorces Sureeli
videos.overview: Biji brings in divorce papers to Mukundi and Bulbul starts crying as she herself is Sureeli, Biji tells her he knew her reality and that is why he did it.

videos.title: Lalanji Fights With Suttilal
videos.overview: Lalanji had his boss come over for evening snacks. His boss gets very upset about the stale samosas and leaves. Lalanji gets angry on Suttilal for such a dish.

videos.title: Work Swap Between Suttilal and Lalanji
videos.overview: Suttilal goes to Lalanji's office and meets Bade Babu who tells him that his name is Raj Kumar. While Lalanji goes to Suttilal's shop, both of them do worst things at each other's work. What will happen to them?

videos.title: Suttilal and Lalanji Suffers
videos.overview: Suttilal and Lalanji swap houses with each other. Both of them don't feel comfortable in their houses. They pretend in front of each other and act as if everything is fine.

videos.title: Stubborn Suttilal and Lalanji
videos.overview: Mukundilal and Elija go to visit Sutti Lal where he is working as Raj Kumar. There they see that he is not doing good work. Meanwhile, Bade Babu visits Lapataganj to visit Sutti Lal's shop where Lalanji is working as Sutti Lal.

videos.title: Trouble In Work
videos.overview: Mukundilal advices Sutti Lal to go back to his shop but Suttilal is stubborn. Both of them suffer at each other's workplace. Food Inspector comes to inspect Sutti Lal's shop because of unhygienic food sold by Lalanji and Suttilal gets into trouble.

videos.title: Back to One's Own
videos.overview: Bade Babu finally figures out that Raj Kumar is Sutti lal. Everyone is shocked. And Lalanji ends up getting Sutti Lal's shop closed. They apologize to each other and go back to their own job and house.

videos.title: Increased Vegetable Price
videos.overview: The vegetable vendor comes to Lapataganj to sell vegetables but sells them for a very costly price. Each day each vegetable's price increases and decreases. The people are confused. Some people buy costly vegetables but some cannot afford it. What will the people do?

videos.title: The Brave Indumati
videos.overview: Indumati and the others join together and decide not to buy vegetables from the vendor. They chase him out of Lapataganj. So the vendor comes back the next day with more men. What will they do now?

videos.title: Indumati's Plan
videos.overview: Indumati comes up with a plan to distract the men and snatch the vegetables. They start dancing to distracting the men and take the vegetables. They even call someone important to help them stop the goons.

videos.title: Chukku's Alert About The Event
videos.overview: Chukku alerts everyone in the village about the event and everyone is excited. What could the event be? Is it something good or will it again bring sadness in Lapataganj?

videos.title: The Couple Dance
videos.overview: Mukundilal, Indumathia and Mausi return back to Lapataganj. Everyone is rehearsing for the couple dance. Everyone pairs up and goes home. Mausi doesn't have anyone.

videos.title: The Day Of The Event
videos.overview: Mausi is sad that she doesn't have anyone to participate with. Everyone is busy preparing and decorating for the event. Mukundilal hosts the flag. All the couple dance one by one. Someone gives a letter to Eliza. What could be written in the letter?

videos.title: The Best Couple
videos.overview: All the couples are done with their performance. They danced in the rain. Eliza will now announce the winner. The winner will get the title of The Best Couple. Who will be the winner?
